72:     private void handleIncomingTorrentIntent(Intent intent) {
73:         if (intent == null) return;
74:         try {
75:             String action = intent.getAction();
76:             if (Intent.ACTION_VIEW.equals(action)) {
77:                 Uri data = intent.getData();
78:                 if (data != null) {
79:                     String scheme = data.getScheme();
80:                     if ("magnet".equalsIgnoreCase(scheme)) {
81:                         pendingTorrentPayload = data.toString();
82:                         pendingTorrentName = "Magnet Link";
83:                     } else {
84:                         readTorrentUriToPending(data);
85:                     }
86:                 }
87:             } else if (Intent.ACTION_SEND.equals(action)) {
88:                 String sharedText = intent.getStringExtra(Intent.EXTRA_TEXT);
89:                 if (sharedText != null && sharedText.contains("magnet:?")) {
90:                     int idx = sharedText.indexOf("magnet:?");
91:                     String mag = sharedText.substring(idx).trim().split("\\s+")[0];
92:                     pendingTorrentPayload = mag;
93:                     pendingTorrentName = "Shared Magnet";
94:                 } else {
95:                     Uri streamUri = intent.getParcelableExtra(Intent.EXTRA_STREAM);
96:                     if (streamUri != null) {
97:                         readTorrentUriToPending(streamUri);
98:                     }
99:                 }
100:             }
101:             if (pendingTorrentPayload != null && webView != null) {
102:                 webView.postDelayed(() -> evalJs("if(window.checkAndroidPendingTorrentV114) window.checkAndroidPendingTorrentV114();"), 250);
103:                 webView.postDelayed(() -> evalJs("if(window.checkAndroidPendingTorrentV114) window.checkAndroidPendingTorrentV114();"), 1800);
104:             }
105:         } catch (Exception e) {
106:             e.printStackTrace();
107:         }
108:     }

110:     private void readTorrentUriToPending(Uri uri) {
111:         try {
112:             String displayName = "external.torrent";
113:             if ("content".equalsIgnoreCase(uri.getScheme())) {
114:                 try (Cursor cursor = getContentResolver().query(uri, null, null, null, null)) {
115:                     if (cursor != null && cursor.moveToFirst()) {
116:                         int nameIdx = cursor.getColumnIndex(OpenableColumns.DISPLAY_NAME);
117:                         if (nameIdx >= 0) {
118:                             String n = cursor.getString(nameIdx);
119:                             if (n != null && !n.isEmpty()) displayName = n;
120:                         }
121:                     }
122:                 } catch (Exception ignored) {}
123:             } else if (uri.getLastPathSegment() != null) {
124:                 displayName = uri.getLastPathSegment();
125:             }
126: 
127:             try (InputStream is = getContentResolver().openInputStream(uri)) {
128:                 if (is == null) return;
129:                 ByteArrayOutputStream buffer = new ByteArrayOutputStream();
130:                 byte[] chunk = new byte[16384];
131:                 int nRead;
132:                 while ((nRead = is.read(chunk, 0, chunk.length)) != -1) {
133:                     buffer.write(chunk, 0, nRead);
134:                 }
135:                 byte[] rawBytes = buffer.toByteArray();
136:                 if (rawBytes.length > 0) {
137:                     pendingTorrentPayload = "B64TOR:" + Base64.encodeToString(rawBytes, Base64.NO_WRAP);
138:                     pendingTorrentName = displayName;
139:                 }
140:             }
141:         } catch (Exception e) {
142:             e.printStackTrace();
143:         }
144:     }

1183:     private String resolveTreeUriToPath(Uri treeUri) {
1184:         try {
1185:             String docId = DocumentsContract.getTreeDocumentId(treeUri);
1186:             if (docId == null) return null;
1187:             if (docId.startsWith("raw:")) {
1188:                 return docId.substring(4);
1189:             }
1190:             String[] split = docId.split(":");
1191:             String type = split[0];
1192:             String relPath = split.length > 1 ? split[1] : "";
1193: 
1194:             if ("primary".equalsIgnoreCase(type)) {
1195:                 String base = Environment.getExternalStorageDirectory().getAbsolutePath();
1196:                 return relPath.isEmpty() ? base : base + "/" + relPath;
1197:             } else {
1198:                 String candidate = "/storage/" + type + (relPath.isEmpty() ? "" : "/" + relPath);
1199:                 if (new File(candidate).exists()) {
1200:                     return candidate;
1201:                 }
1202:             }
1203:         } catch (Exception e) {
1204:             e.printStackTrace();
1205:         }
1206:         return null;
1207:     }

26: typedef struct { uint8_t* data; size_t size, cap; } ByteVec;
27: static inline void bv_init(ByteVec* v, size_t c) { v->size = 0; v->cap = c ? c : 1024; v->data = (uint8_t*)malloc(v->cap); }
28: static inline void bv_free(ByteVec* v) { if (v->data) free(v->data); v->data = NULL; v->size = v->cap = 0; }
29: static inline void bv_reserve(ByteVec* v, size_t need) {
30:     if (v->size + need > v->cap) {
31:         v->cap = (v->cap * 2) + need + 1024;
32:         v->data = (uint8_t*)realloc(v->data, v->cap);
33:     }
34: }
35: static inline void bv_push(ByteVec* v, uint8_t b) { bv_reserve(v, 1); v->data[v->size++] = b; }
36: static inline void bv_append(ByteVec* v, const void* s, size_t n) { if (!n) return; bv_reserve(v, n); memcpy(v->data + v->size, s, n); v->size += n; }
37: static inline void bv_u16(ByteVec* v, uint16_t x) { bv_append(v, &x, 2); }
38: static inline void bv_u32(ByteVec* v, uint32_t x) { bv_append(v, &x, 4); }
39: static inline void bv_i32(ByteVec* v, int32_t x)  { bv_append(v, &x, 4); }

41: static inline uint8_t rd_u8(const uint8_t** p) { uint8_t v = **p; (*p) += 1; return v; }
42: static inline uint16_t rd_u16(const uint8_t** p) { uint16_t v; memcpy(&v, *p, 2); (*p) += 2; return v; }
43: static inline uint32_t rd_u32(const uint8_t** p) { uint32_t v; memcpy(&v, *p, 4); (*p) += 4; return v; }
44: static inline int32_t rd_i32(const uint8_t** p) { int32_t v; memcpy(&v, *p, 4); (*p) += 4; return v; }

46: typedef struct { ByteVec buf; uint64_t acc; int bits; } BitWriter;
47: static inline void bw_put(BitWriter* bw, uint32_t val, int n) {
48:     if (n <= 0) return;
49:     bw->acc |= ((uint64_t)val << bw->bits);
50:     bw->bits += n;
51:     while (bw->bits >= 8) { bv_push(&bw->buf, (uint8_t)(bw->acc & 0xFF)); bw->acc >>= 8; bw->bits -= 8; }
52: }
53: static inline void bw_flush(BitWriter* bw) {
54:     if (bw->bits > 0) { bv_push(&bw->buf, (uint8_t)(bw->acc & 0xFF)); bw->acc = 0; bw->bits = 0; }
55: }

57: typedef struct { const uint8_t* data; size_t size, pos; uint64_t acc; int bits; } BitReader;
58: static inline uint32_t br_get(BitReader* br, int n) {
59:     if (n <= 0) return 0;
60:     while (br->bits <= 56 && br->pos < br->size) { br->acc |= ((uint64_t)br->data[br->pos++] << br->bits); br->bits += 8; }
61:     uint32_t val = (uint32_t)(br->acc & ((1ULL << n) - 1ULL));
62:     br->acc >>= n; br->bits -= n;
63:     return val;
64: }

66: static void solve_linear_system(int n, double A[TOTAL_TAPS][TOTAL_TAPS], double b[TOTAL_TAPS], double x[TOTAL_TAPS]) {
67:     for (int i = 0; i < n; ++i) {
68:         int pivot = i;
69:         double max_v = fabs(A[i][i]);
70:         for (int r = i + 1; r < n; ++r) { double v = fabs(A[r][i]); if (v > max_v) { max_v = v; pivot = r; } }
71:         if (pivot != i) {
72:             for (int c = i; c < n; ++c) { double t = A[i][c]; A[i][c] = A[pivot][c]; A[pivot][c] = t; }
73:             double tb = b[i]; b[i] = b[pivot]; b[pivot] = tb;
74:         }
75:         double diag = fabs(A[i][i]) < 1e-12 ? 1e-12 : A[i][i];
76:         for (int r = i + 1; r < n; ++r) {
77:             double f = A[r][i] / diag;
78:             for (int c = i; c < n; ++c) A[r][c] -= f * A[i][c];
79:             b[r] -= f * b[i];
80:         }
81:     }
82:     for (int i = n - 1; i >= 0; --i) {
83:         double s = b[i];
84:         for (int c = i + 1; c < n; ++c) s -= A[i][c] * x[c];
85:         x[i] = s / (fabs(A[i][i]) < 1e-12 ? 1e-12 : A[i][i]);
86:     }
87: }

89: struct XflacBackendProfileV161 {
90:     double div_scale;
91:     int max_tz_15;
92:     int max_tz_25;
93:     int max_tz_45;
94: };

96: static XflacBackendProfileV161 resolve_backend_profile_v161(uint32_t sr, int bits) {
97:     XflacBackendProfileV161 p;
98:     if (sr <= 32000) {
99:         p.div_scale = 1.15;
100:         p.max_tz_15 = 4; p.max_tz_25 = 3; p.max_tz_45 = 2;
101:     } else if (sr <= 48000) {
102:         p.div_scale = 1.00;
103:         p.max_tz_15 = 5; p.max_tz_25 = 4; p.max_tz_45 = 3;
104:     } else if (sr <= 96000) {
105:         p.div_scale = 0.95;
106:         p.max_tz_15 = 5; p.max_tz_25 = 4; p.max_tz_45 = 3;
107:     } else if (sr <= 192000) {
108:         p.div_scale = 0.90;
109:         p.max_tz_15 = 5; p.max_tz_25 = 4; p.max_tz_45 = 3;
110:     } else {
111:         p.div_scale = 0.85;
112:         p.max_tz_15 = 6; p.max_tz_25 = 5; p.max_tz_45 = 4;
113:     }
114:     (void)bits;
115:     return p;
116: }

118: static void apply_dynamic_noise_floor_gate32(int32_t* ch, size_t n, int mode_val, int bits, uint32_t sr) {
119:     if (sr < 8000) sr = 44100;
120: 
121:     // В режиме XFLAC 1:1 (mode_val == 0) для 16-bit 0 потерь (100% Bit-Perfect Lossless)
122:     // Для 24/32-bit в режиме 1:1 убираем только 3 самых младших бита теплового шума АЦП (оставляя 21 бит)
123:     if (mode_val <= 0) {
124:         if (bits >= 24) {
125:             int tz_lossless = 3;
126:             int32_t half = 1 << (tz_lossless - 1);
127:             int32_t mask = ~((1 << tz_lossless) - 1);
128:             int32_t max_pos = 8388607 & mask;
129:             for (size_t i = 0; i < n; ++i) {
130:                 int32_t v = (ch[i] + half) & mask;
131:                 ch[i] = (v < -8388608) ? -8388608 : ((v > max_pos) ? max_pos : v);
132:             }
133:         }
134:         return;
135:     }
136: 
137:     XflacBackendProfileV161 prof = resolve_backend_profile_v161(sr, bits);
138:     double amp_scale = (bits >= 24) ? 256.0 : 1.0;
139:     int hi_res_offset = (bits >= 24) ? 4 : 0;
140:     int32_t max_lim = (bits >= 24) ? 8388607 : 32767;
141:     int32_t min_lim = (bits >= 24) ? -8388608 : -32768;
142: 
143:     double eff_div = 120.0;
144:     int base_max_tz = prof.max_tz_25;
145: 
146:     if (mode_val <= 16) {
147:         eff_div = 95.0 * prof.div_scale;
148:         base_max_tz = prof.max_tz_15;
149:     } else if (mode_val <= 26) {
150:         eff_div = 155.0 * prof.div_scale;
151:         base_max_tz = prof.max_tz_25;
152:     } else {
153:         eff_div = 240.0 * prof.div_scale;
154:         base_max_tz = prof.max_tz_45;
155:     }
156: 
157:     for (size_t s = 0; s < n; s += SUBBLOCK_SIZE) {
158:         size_t e = (s + SUBBLOCK_SIZE < n) ? (s + SUBBLOCK_SIZE) : n;
159:         size_t len = e - s;
160:         double sum_sq = 0.0;
161:         for (size_t i = s; i < e; ++i) {
162:             double v = (double)ch[i] / amp_scale;
163:             sum_sq += v * v;
164:         }
165:         double rms = sqrt(sum_sq / (double)len);
166: 
167:         int base_tz = 0;
168:         if (rms > eff_div) {
169:             base_tz = (int)floor(log2(rms / eff_div)) + 1;
170:             if (base_tz < 0) base_tz = 0;
171:             else if (base_tz > base_max_tz) base_tz = base_max_tz;
172:         }
173: 
174:         int tz = base_tz + hi_res_offset;
175:         if (tz > 0) {
176:             int32_t half = 1 << (tz - 1);
177:             int32_t mask = ~((1 << tz) - 1);
178:             int32_t max_pos = max_lim & mask;
179:             // Чистое округление БЕЗ шейпинга (0% шипения)
180:             for (size_t i = s; i < e; ++i) {
181:                 int32_t v = (ch[i] + half) & mask;
182:                 ch[i] = (v < min_lim) ? min_lim : ((v > max_pos) ? max_pos : v);
183:             }
184:         }
185:     }
186: }

188: static void strip_wasted_bits32(const int32_t* in, size_t n, int64_t* out, ByteVec* shifts) {
189:     for (size_t s = 0; s < n; s += SUBBLOCK_SIZE) {
190:         size_t e = (s + SUBBLOCK_SIZE < n) ? (s + SUBBLOCK_SIZE) : n;
191:         uint32_t orr = 0;
192:         for (size_t i = s; i < e; ++i) {
193:             orr |= (uint32_t)in[i];
194:         }
195:         int tz = (orr == 0) ? 0 : __builtin_ctz(orr);
196:         if (tz > 22) tz = 22;
197:         bv_push(shifts, (uint8_t)tz);
198:         if (tz > 0) {
199:             for (size_t i = s; i < e; ++i) {
200:                 out[i] = (int64_t)(in[i] >> tz);
201:             }
202:         } else {
203:             for (size_t i = s; i < e; ++i) {
204:                 out[i] = (int64_t)in[i];
205:             }
206:         }
207:     }
208: }

210: static void restore_wasted_bits32(const int64_t* in, size_t n, const uint8_t* shifts, int32_t* out) {
211:     size_t idx = 0;
212:     for (size_t s = 0; s < n; s += SUBBLOCK_SIZE, ++idx) {
213:         size_t e = (s + SUBBLOCK_SIZE < n) ? (s + SUBBLOCK_SIZE) : n;
214:         int tz = shifts[idx];
215:         for (size_t i = s; i < e; ++i) out[i] = (int32_t)(in[i] << tz);
216:     }
217: }

219: static void encode_channel_pitch_ols(const int64_t* x, size_t n, ByteVec* meta_q_out, ByteVec* rem_packed_out) {
220:     int64_t* res = (int64_t*)calloc(n > 0 ? n : 1, sizeof(int64_t));
221:     size_t warm = n < WARMUP ? n : WARMUP;
222:     for (size_t i = 0; i < warm; ++i) res[i] = x[i];
223:     ByteVec hdr; bv_init(&hdr, 4096);
224: 
225:     for (size_t s = WARMUP; s < n; s += BLOCK_SIZE) {
226:         size_t e = (s + BLOCK_SIZE < n) ? (s + BLOCK_SIZE) : n;
227:         if (e - s <= TOTAL_TAPS + 10) { for (size_t i = s; i < e; ++i) res[i] = x[i]; continue; }
228:         uint16_t best_lag = 50; double best_corr = -1.0;
229:         for (int lag = 20; lag < 220; lag += 4) {
230:             double c = 0.0;
231:             for (size_t i = s; i < e; i += 2) c += (double)x[i] * (double)x[i - lag];
232:             if (fabs(c) > best_corr) { best_corr = fabs(c); best_lag = (uint16_t)lag; }
233:         }
234:         double A[TOTAL_TAPS][TOTAL_TAPS], b_vec[TOTAL_TAPS], w_flt[TOTAL_TAPS];
235:         memset(A, 0, sizeof(A)); memset(b_vec, 0, sizeof(b_vec)); memset(w_flt, 0, sizeof(w_flt));
236:         for (size_t i = s; i < e; ++i) {
237:             double row[TOTAL_TAPS], target = (double)x[i];
238:             for (int k = 0; k < AR_ORDER; ++k) row[k] = (double)x[i - (k + 1)];
239:             for (int p = -2; p <= 2; ++p) row[AR_ORDER + (p + 2)] = (double)x[i - best_lag + p];
240:             for (int r = 0; r < TOTAL_TAPS; ++r) {
241:                 b_vec[r] += row[r] * target;
242:                 for (int c = r; c < TOTAL_TAPS; ++c) A[r][c] += row[r] * row[c];
243:             }
244:         }
245:         for (int r = 0; r < TOTAL_TAPS; ++r) { A[r][r] += 1e-2; for (int c = 0; c < r; ++c) A[r][c] = A[c][r]; }
246:         solve_linear_system(TOTAL_TAPS, A, b_vec, w_flt);
247:         int32_t w_int[TOTAL_TAPS];
248:         for (int k = 0; k < TOTAL_TAPS; ++k) w_int[k] = (int32_t)llround(w_flt[k] * 16384.0);
249:         for (size_t i = s; i < e; ++i) {
250:             int64_t sum = 0;
251:             for (int k = 0; k < AR_ORDER; ++k) sum += x[i - (k + 1)] * (int64_t)w_int[k];
252:             for (int p = -2; p <= 2; ++p) sum += x[i - best_lag + p] * (int64_t)w_int[AR_ORDER + (p + 2)];
253:             res[i] = x[i] - ((sum + 8192LL) >> 14);
254:         }
255:         bv_u16(&hdr, best_lag);
256:         for (int k = 0; k < TOTAL_TAPS; ++k) bv_i32(&hdr, w_int[k]);
257:     }
258: 
259:     ByteVec k_vals, esc_i, esc_v;
260:     bv_init(&k_vals, (n / RICE_BLOCK) + 16); bv_init(&esc_i, 1024); bv_init(&esc_v, 1024);
261:     uint8_t* q_bytes = (uint8_t*)malloc(n > 0 ? n : 1);
262:     BitWriter rem_bw; bv_init(&rem_bw.buf, n); rem_bw.acc = 0; rem_bw.bits = 0;
263:     uint32_t n_esc = 0;
264: 
265:     for (size_t s = 0; s < n; s += RICE_BLOCK) {
266:         size_t e = (s + RICE_BLOCK < n) ? (s + RICE_BLOCK) : n, len = e - s;
267:         uint64_t zz[RICE_BLOCK];
268:         for (size_t i = 0; i < len; ++i) { int64_t v = res[s + i]; zz[i] = (uint64_t)((v << 1) ^ (v >> 63)); }
269:         int best_k = 0; uint64_t best_b = UINT64_MAX;
270:         for (int k = 0; k < 15; ++k) {
271:             uint64_t b = (uint64_t)len * (uint64_t)(1 + k);
272:             for (size_t i = 0; i < len; ++i) b += (zz[i] >> k);
273:             if (b < best_b) { best_b = b; best_k = k; }
274:         }
275:         bv_push(&k_vals, (uint8_t)best_k);
276:         uint32_t mask = (1U << best_k) - 1U;
277:         for (size_t i = 0; i < len; ++i) {
278:             uint64_t q = zz[i] >> best_k;
279:             if (q >= 255) { bv_u32(&esc_i, (uint32_t)(s + i)); bv_u32(&esc_v, (uint32_t)q); q_bytes[s + i] = 255; n_esc++; }
280:             else q_bytes[s + i] = (uint8_t)q;
281:             if (best_k > 0) bw_put(&rem_bw, (uint32_t)zz[i] & mask, best_k);
282:         }
283:     }
284:     bw_flush(&rem_bw);
285:     *rem_packed_out = rem_bw.buf;
286: 
287:     bv_init(meta_q_out, hdr.size + k_vals.size + esc_i.size + esc_v.size + n + 32);
288:     bv_u32(meta_q_out, (uint32_t)hdr.size); bv_u32(meta_q_out, (uint32_t)k_vals.size); bv_u32(meta_q_out, n_esc);
289:     bv_append(meta_q_out, hdr.data, hdr.size); bv_append(meta_q_out, k_vals.data, k_vals.size);
290:     bv_append(meta_q_out, esc_i.data, esc_i.size); bv_append(meta_q_out, esc_v.data, esc_v.size);
291:     bv_append(meta_q_out, q_bytes, n);
292:     free(res); free(q_bytes); bv_free(&hdr); bv_free(&k_vals); bv_free(&esc_i); bv_free(&esc_v);
293: }
294: 
295: static void decode_channel_pitch_ols(const uint8_t* meta_q, size_t m_sz, const uint8_t* rem_p, size_t r_sz, size_t n, int64_t* x_out) {
296:     (void)m_sz;
297:     const uint8_t* p = meta_q;
298:     uint32_t hdr_len = rd_u32(&p), k_len = rd_u32(&p), n_esc = rd_u32(&p);
299:     const uint8_t* hdr = p; p += hdr_len;
300:     const uint8_t* k_vals = p; p += k_len;
301:     const uint8_t* esc_i = p; p += n_esc * 4;
302:     const uint8_t* esc_v = p; p += n_esc * 4;
303:     const uint8_t* q_bytes = p;
304: 
305:     uint64_t* q_full = (uint64_t*)malloc((n > 0 ? n : 1) * sizeof(uint64_t));
306:     for (size_t i = 0; i < n; ++i) q_full[i] = q_bytes[i];
307:     for (uint32_t i = 0; i < n_esc; ++i) {
308:         uint32_t idx, val; memcpy(&idx, esc_i + i * 4, 4); memcpy(&val, esc_v + i * 4, 4);
309:         if (idx < n) q_full[idx] = val;
310:     }
311:     BitReader br = { rem_p, r_sz, 0, 0, 0 };
312:     int64_t* res = (int64_t*)malloc((n > 0 ? n : 1) * sizeof(int64_t));
313:     size_t blk = 0;
314:     for (size_t s = 0; s < n; s += RICE_BLOCK, ++blk) {
315:         size_t e = (s + RICE_BLOCK < n) ? (s + RICE_BLOCK) : n;
316:         int k = k_vals[blk];
317:         for (size_t i = s; i < e; ++i) {
318:             uint64_t rem = (k > 0) ? br_get(&br, k) : 0;
319:             uint64_t zz = (q_full[i] << k) | rem;
320:             res[i] = (int64_t)(zz >> 1) ^ -(int64_t)(zz & 1);
321:         }
322:     }
323:     memset(x_out, 0, n * sizeof(int64_t));
324:     size_t warm = n < WARMUP ? n : WARMUP;
325:     for (size_t i = 0; i < warm; ++i) x_out[i] = res[i];
326:     const uint8_t* hp = hdr;
327:     for (size_t s = WARMUP; s < n; s += BLOCK_SIZE) {
328:         size_t e = (s + BLOCK_SIZE < n) ? (s + BLOCK_SIZE) : n;
329:         if (e - s <= TOTAL_TAPS + 10) { for (size_t i = s; i < e; ++i) x_out[i] = res[i]; continue; }
330:         uint16_t lag = rd_u16(&hp);
331:         int32_t w[TOTAL_TAPS];
332:         for (int k = 0; k < TOTAL_TAPS; ++k) w[k] = rd_i32(&hp);
333:         for (size_t i = s; i < e; ++i) {
334:             int64_t sum = 0;
335:             for (int k = 0; k < AR_ORDER; ++k) sum += x_out[i - (k + 1)] * (int64_t)w[k];
336:             for (int pt = -2; pt <= 2; ++pt) sum += x_out[i - lag + pt] * (int64_t)w[AR_ORDER + (pt + 2)];
337:             x_out[i] = res[i] + ((sum + 8192LL) >> 14);
338:         }
339:     }
340:     free(q_full); free(res);
341: }

343: static int find_wav_data_chunk(const uint8_t* wav, size_t sz, size_t* off, size_t* pcm_b, uint32_t* sr, uint16_t* ch, uint16_t* bits_out, uint16_t* ftag_out) {
344:     if (sz < 44 || memcmp(wav, "RIFF", 4) != 0 || memcmp(wav + 8, "WAVE", 4) != 0) return 0;
345:     size_t pos = 12; *sr = 48000; *ch = 2; *bits_out = 16; *ftag_out = 1;
346:     while (pos + 8 <= sz) {
347:         uint32_t csz = 0; memcpy(&csz, wav + pos + 4, 4);
348:         if (memcmp(wav + pos, "fmt ", 4) == 0 && pos + 24 <= sz) {
349:             uint16_t ftag = 1, bits = 16;
350:             memcpy(&ftag, wav + pos + 8, 2);
351:             memcpy(ch, wav + pos + 10, 2);
352:             memcpy(sr, wav + pos + 12, 4);
353:             memcpy(&bits, wav + pos + 22, 2);
354:             if (ftag == 0xFFFE && csz >= 40 && pos + 8 + 26 <= sz) {
355:                 memcpy(&ftag, wav + pos + 8 + 24, 2);
356:             }
357:             if ((*ch != 1 && *ch != 2) || (bits != 16 && bits != 24 && bits != 32)) return 0;
358:             *bits_out = bits;
359:             *ftag_out = ftag;
360:         } else if (memcmp(wav + pos, "data", 4) == 0) {
361:             *off = pos + 8; *pcm_b = (csz < sz - *off) ? csz : (sz - *off); return 1;
362:         }
363:         pos += 8 + csz + (csz & 1);
364:     }
365:     return 0;
366: }

368: static inline int32_t read_pcm_sample_v157(const uint8_t* p, uint16_t bits, uint16_t ftag) {
369:     if (bits == 16) {
370:         int16_t v; memcpy(&v, p, 2); return (int32_t)v;
371:     } else if (bits == 24) {
372:         int32_t v = (int32_t)p[0] | ((int32_t)p[1] << 8) | ((int32_t)((int8_t)p[2]) << 16);
373:         return v;
374:     } else if (bits == 32) {
375:         if (ftag == 3) {
376:             float fv; memcpy(&fv, p, 4);
377:             if (fv > 1.0f) fv = 1.0f; else if (fv < -1.0f) fv = -1.0f;
378:             return (int32_t)llround((double)fv * 8388607.0);
379:         } else {
380:             int32_t iv; memcpy(&iv, p, 4);
381:             return iv >> 8;
382:         }
383:     }
384:     return 0;
385: }
386: 
387: static inline void write_pcm_sample_v157(uint8_t* p, int32_t v, uint16_t bits, uint16_t ftag) {
388:     if (bits == 16) {
389:         int16_t s = (int16_t)(v < -32768 ? -32768 : (v > 32767 ? 32767 : v));
390:         memcpy(p, &s, 2);
391:     } else if (bits == 24) {
392:         int32_t c = (v < -8388608) ? -8388608 : ((v > 8388607) ? 8388607 : v);
393:         p[0] = (uint8_t)(c & 0xFF);
394:         p[1] = (uint8_t)((c >> 8) & 0xFF);
395:         p[2] = (uint8_t)((c >> 16) & 0xFF);
396:     } else if (bits == 32) {
397:         int32_t c = (v < -8388608) ? -8388608 : ((v > 8388607) ? 8388607 : v);
398:         if (ftag == 3) {
399:             float fv = (float)((double)c / 8388607.0);
400:             memcpy(p, &fv, 4);
401:         } else {
402:             int32_t iv = c << 8;
403:             memcpy(p, &iv, 4);
404:         }
405:     }
406: }

408: int xflac_encode_wav_mem(const uint8_t* wav, size_t wav_sz, uint8_t** out_d, size_t* out_sz, xflac_mode_t mode, xflac_stats_t* st) {
409:     size_t pcm_off = 0, pcm_b = 0; uint32_t sr = 48000; uint16_t ch = 2, bits = 16, ftag = 1;
410:     if (!find_wav_data_chunk(wav, wav_sz, &pcm_off, &pcm_b, &sr, &ch, &bits, &ftag)) return -1;
411:     size_t bps = bits / 8;
412:     size_t n = pcm_b / (ch * bps), suf_off = pcm_off + pcm_b, suf_len = wav_sz - suf_off;
413:     int32_t* mid = (int32_t*)malloc((n + 1) * 4), *side = (int32_t*)malloc((n + 1) * 4);
414:     const uint8_t* pcm_ptr = wav + pcm_off;
415:     int eq = 1;
416:     for (size_t i = 0; i < n; ++i) {
417:         const uint8_t* frame_p = pcm_ptr + i * ch * bps;
418:         mid[i] = read_pcm_sample_v157(frame_p, bits, ftag);
419:         side[i] = (ch == 2) ? read_pcm_sample_v157(frame_p + bps, bits, ftag) : mid[i];
420:         if (mid[i] != side[i]) eq = 0;
421:     }
422:     {
423:         int mval = (int)mode;
424:         apply_dynamic_noise_floor_gate32(mid, n, mval, (int)bits, sr);
425:         if (eq) memcpy(side, mid, n * 4); else apply_dynamic_noise_floor_gate32(side, n, mval, (int)bits, sr);
426:     }
427: 
428:     int64_t* ls = (int64_t*)malloc((n + 1) * 8);
429:     ByteVec sh_l, meta_l, rem_l; bv_init(&sh_l, (n / SUBBLOCK_SIZE) + 16);
430:     strip_wasted_bits32(mid, n, ls, &sh_l); encode_channel_pitch_ols(ls, n, &meta_l, &rem_l);
431:     free(ls); free(mid);
432: 
433:     ByteVec rm; bv_init(&rm, pcm_off + suf_len + sh_l.size + meta_l.size + 1024);
434:     bv_u32(&rm, (uint32_t)pcm_off); bv_u32(&rm, (uint32_t)suf_len); bv_u32(&rm, (uint32_t)sh_l.size); bv_u32(&rm, (uint32_t)meta_l.size);
435:     bv_append(&rm, wav, pcm_off); bv_append(&rm, wav + suf_off, suf_len); bv_append(&rm, sh_l.data, sh_l.size); bv_append(&rm, meta_l.data, meta_l.size);
436:     bv_free(&sh_l); bv_free(&meta_l);
437: 
438:     ByteVec rem_r = { NULL, 0, 0 };
439:     if (!eq) {
440:         int64_t* rs = (int64_t*)malloc((n + 1) * 8); ByteVec sh_r, meta_r; bv_init(&sh_r, (n / SUBBLOCK_SIZE) + 16);
441:         strip_wasted_bits32(side, n, rs, &sh_r); encode_channel_pitch_ols(rs, n, &meta_r, &rem_r);
442:         bv_u32(&rm, (uint32_t)sh_r.size); bv_u32(&rm, (uint32_t)meta_r.size);
443:         bv_append(&rm, sh_r.data, sh_r.size); bv_append(&rm, meta_r.data, meta_r.size);
444:         free(rs); bv_free(&sh_r); bv_free(&meta_r);
445:     }
446:     free(side);
447: 
448:     uint8_t bit_flag = (bits == 24) ? 8 : ((bits == 32) ? 16 : 0);
449:     uint8_t flags = (eq ? 1 : 0) | ((ch == 1) ? 4 : 0) | bit_flag;
450:     ByteVec fb; bv_init(&fb, 32 + rm.size + rem_l.size + rem_r.size);
451:     bv_append(&fb, "XFC3", 4); bv_push(&fb, flags); bv_u32(&fb, (uint32_t)n);
452:     bv_u32(&fb, (uint32_t)rm.size); bv_u32(&fb, (uint32_t)rm.size); bv_u32(&fb, (uint32_t)rem_l.size); bv_u32(&fb, (uint32_t)rem_r.size);
453:     bv_append(&fb, rm.data, rm.size); bv_append(&fb, rem_l.data, rem_l.size);
454:     if (rem_r.size > 0) bv_append(&fb, rem_r.data, rem_r.size);
455:     bv_free(&rm); bv_free(&rem_l); bv_free(&rem_r);
456:     *out_sz = fb.size; *out_d = fb.data;
457:     if (st) { st->original_bytes = wav_sz; st->compressed_bytes = *out_sz; st->sample_rate = sr; st->num_frames = (uint32_t)n; st->stereo_dedup = eq ? 1 : 0; st->encode_ms = 0; }
458:     return 0;
459: }

461: int xflac_decode_wav_mem(const uint8_t* xd, size_t x_sz, uint8_t** out_w, size_t* out_sz) {
462:     if (x_sz < 25 || memcmp(xd, "XFC3", 4) != 0) return -1;
463:     const uint8_t* p = xd + 4;
464:     uint8_t flags = rd_u8(&p); uint32_t n = rd_u32(&p), rm_sz = rd_u32(&p), cm_sz = rd_u32(&p), rl_sz = rd_u32(&p), rr_sz = rd_u32(&p);
465:     (void)rm_sz; (void)rr_sz;
466:     int eq = (flags & 1) != 0, mono = (flags & 4) != 0;
467:     const uint8_t* mp = p; p += cm_sz; const uint8_t* rl = p; p += rl_sz; const uint8_t* rr = p;
468:     uint32_t p_len = rd_u32(&mp), s_len = rd_u32(&mp), shl_len = rd_u32(&mp), ml_len = rd_u32(&mp);
469:     const uint8_t* w_pre = mp; mp += p_len; const uint8_t* w_suf = mp; mp += s_len;
470:     const uint8_t* sh_l = mp; mp += shl_len; const uint8_t* meta_l = mp; mp += ml_len;
471: 
472:     uint16_t bits = (flags & 8) ? 24 : ((flags & 16) ? 32 : 16);
473:     uint16_t ftag = 1;
474:     if (p_len >= 44 && memcmp(w_pre, "RIFF", 4) == 0) {
475:         size_t pos = 12;
476:         while (pos + 8 <= p_len) {
477:             uint32_t csz = 0; memcpy(&csz, w_pre + pos + 4, 4);
478:             if (memcmp(w_pre + pos, "fmt ", 4) == 0 && pos + 24 <= p_len) {
479:                 memcpy(&ftag, w_pre + pos + 8, 2);
480:                 memcpy(&bits, w_pre + pos + 22, 2);
481:                 if (ftag == 0xFFFE && csz >= 40 && pos + 8 + 26 <= p_len) {
482:                     memcpy(&ftag, w_pre + pos + 8 + 24, 2);
483:                 }
484:                 break;
485:             }
486:             pos += 8 + csz + (csz & 1);
487:         }
488:     }
489:     if (bits != 16 && bits != 24 && bits != 32) bits = 16;
490: 
491:     int64_t* ls = (int64_t*)malloc((n + 1) * 8);
492:     int32_t* mid = (int32_t*)malloc((n + 1) * 4), *side = (int32_t*)malloc((n + 1) * 4);
493:     decode_channel_pitch_ols(meta_l, ml_len, rl, rl_sz, n, ls); restore_wasted_bits32(ls, n, sh_l, mid); free(ls);
494:     if (!eq) {
495:         uint32_t shr_len = rd_u32(&mp), mr_len = rd_u32(&mp);
496:         const uint8_t* sh_r = mp; mp += shr_len; const uint8_t* meta_r = mp; mp += mr_len;
497:         int64_t* rs = (int64_t*)malloc((n + 1) * 8);
498:         decode_channel_pitch_ols(meta_r, mr_len, rr, rr_sz, n, rs); restore_wasted_bits32(rs, n, sh_r, side); free(rs);
499:     }
500:     size_t ch = mono ? 1 : 2, bps = bits / 8, pcm_b = (size_t)n * ch * bps;
501:     *out_sz = p_len + pcm_b + s_len; *out_w = (uint8_t*)malloc(*out_sz);
502:     memcpy(*out_w, w_pre, p_len);
503:     uint8_t* dst = *out_w + p_len;
504:     for (size_t i = 0; i < n; ++i) {
505:         uint8_t* frame_p = dst + i * ch * bps;
506:         write_pcm_sample_v157(frame_p, mid[i], bits, ftag);
507:         if (ch == 2) {
508:             write_pcm_sample_v157(frame_p + bps, eq ? mid[i] : side[i], bits, ftag);
509:         }
510:     }
511:     if (s_len > 0) memcpy(*out_w + p_len + pcm_b, w_suf, s_len);
512:     free(mid); free(side);
513:     return 0;
514: }

66: // Гибридный WaveShaper: Убивает писк дросселей в тишине (Ultra-Low Noise Gate) + Мягкий Tanh Soft-Clipper на пиках!
67: window.createSoftClipWaveShaper = function(ctx, bucket) {
68:     let shaper = window.trackNode(ctx.createWaveShaper(), bucket);
69:     let half = 32768;
70:     let samples = half * 2 + 1; // 65537 — строго НЕЧЁТНОЕ число с точным 0.0 в центре
71:     let curve = new Float32Array(samples);
72:     let k = 1.25;
73:     let norm = Math.tanh(k);
74:     for (let i = 0; i < samples; i++) {
75:         let x = (i - half) / half;
76:         // Идеально гладкая линейная зона в районе нуля без ступеньки gateThresh (0% искажений на тихой речи и шёпоте!)
77:         curve[i] = Math.tanh(x * k) / norm * 0.98;
78:     }
79:     curve[half] = 0.0;
80:     shaper.curve = curve;
81:     shaper.oversample = 'none';
82:     return shaper;
83: };

127:         let wPct = parseFloat(cfg.val_msWidth);
128:         if (isNaN(wPct)) wPct = 160;
129:         if (wPct > 100) {
130:             let v = Math.min(18, 20 * Math.log10(1 + (wPct - 100) / 140) * 0.68);
131:             if (v > 0.05) {
132:                 hotDb += v;
133:                 parts.push(`🎭Стерео -${v.toFixed(1)}`);
134:             }
135:         }
136:     }
137:     if (cfg.opt_crossfeed) {
138:         let cPct = parseFloat(cfg.val_crossfeed) || 0;
139:         if (cPct > 80) {
140:             let v = Math.min(6, (cPct - 80) * 0.03);
141:             if (v > 0.05) {
142:                 hotDb += v;
143:                 parts.push(`🎧Бин -${v.toFixed(1)}`);
144:             }
145:         }
146:     }
147:     if (cfg.opt_autoRms) {
148:         let tRms = parseFloat(cfg.val_autoRms);
149:         if (isNaN(tRms)) tRms = -10;
150:         if (tRms > -12) {
151:             let v = (tRms + 12) * 0.75;
152:             if (v > 0.05) {
153:                 hotDb += v;
154:                 parts.push(`⚡RMS -${v.toFixed(1)}`);
155:             }
156:         }
157:     }
158: 
159:     let padDb = -Math.max(0.5, hotDb);
160:     window.lastComputedCeilingDb = Math.round(padDb * 10) / 10;
161:     window.lastCeilingBreakdown = parts.length > 0 ? parts.join(' │ ') : 'Базовый запас -0.5 dB';
162: 
163:     const badge = document.getElementById('autoCeilStatusBadge');
164:     if (badge) {
165:         badge.innerText = cfg.opt_masterCeil
166:             ? `Авто: ${window.lastComputedCeilingDb} dB`
167:             : `ВЫКЛ`;
168:         badge.style.color = cfg.opt_masterCeil ? '#3fb950' : '#8b949e';
169:     }
170:     if (typeof window.updateTopSearchOrMonitorBar === 'function') {
171:         window.updateTopSearchOrMonitorBar();
172:     }
173:     return padDb;
174: };

176: window.computeBufferAutoGain = function(audioBuffer, targetDb) {
177:     let tDb = isNaN(parseFloat(targetDb)) ? -10.0 : parseFloat(targetDb);
178:     let refBuf = audioBuffer || window.studioBuffer;
179:     if (!refBuf) return 1.0;
180: 
181:     // Если для этого трека уже рассчитан эталонный RMS по первому куску — держим его железобетонно, чтобы громкость никогда не прыгала!
182:     if (refBuf._lockedRmsDbV72 !== undefined) {
183:         let diffLocked = Math.max(-30, Math.min(24, tDb - refBuf._lockedRmsDbV72));
184:         return Math.pow(10, diffLocked / 20);
185:     }
186: 
187:     let ch0 = refBuf.getChannelData(0);
188:     let ch1 = refBuf.numberOfChannels > 1 ? refBuf.getChannelData(1) : ch0;
189:     let len = ch0.length;
190:     let step = Math.max(1, Math.floor(len / 80000));
191:     let sumSq = 0;
192:     let count = 0;
193:     for (let i = 0; i < len; i += step) {
194:         let s0 = ch0[i], s1 = ch1[i];
195:         // Пропускаем нераспакованные нулевые области торрент-буфера
196:         if (s0 === 0 && s1 === 0) continue;
197:         let s = 0.5 * (s0 + s1);
198:         sumSq += s * s;
199:         count++;
200:     }
201:     if (count < 50) return 1.0;
202:     let rms = Math.sqrt(sumSq / count);
203:     if (rms < 0.0001) return 1.0;
204:     let currentDb = 20 * Math.log10(rms);
205:     refBuf._lockedRmsDbV72 = currentDb;
206:     let diffDb = Math.max(-30, Math.min(24, tDb - currentDb));
207:     return Math.pow(10, diffDb / 20);
208: };

210: window.createFIRImpulse = function(context, decayMs) {
211:     let sampleRate = context.sampleRate;
212:     let length = Math.max(2, Math.floor(sampleRate * ((parseFloat(decayMs) || 4) / 1000)));
213:     let impulse = context.createBuffer(2, length, sampleRate);
214:     const cfg = window.appConfig || {};
215: 
216:     let lengthNorm = Math.sqrt(192 / Math.max(16, length));
217:     let cleanDriveDb = parseFloat(cfg.val_cleanFir);
218:     if (isNaN(cleanDriveDb)) cleanDriveDb = 3.0;
219:     let cleanLinear = window.dbToLinear(cleanDriveDb);
220: 
221:     for (let channel = 0; channel < 2; channel++) {
222:         let data = impulse.getChannelData(channel);
223:         for (let i = 0; i < length; i++) {
224:             // Окно плавного затухания Хэннинга на конце хвоста, чтобы обрыв буфера никогда не гудел и не пищал!
225:             let tailWindow = 0.5 * (1 + Math.cos(Math.PI * i / length));
226:             if (i === 0) {
227:                 data[i] = 1.0;
228:             } else if (cfg.phaseFixEnabled) {
229:                 data[i] = Math.exp(-i / (length / 2.5)) * tailWindow * 0.055 * lengthNorm * Math.cos(i * 0.65) * (channel === 0 ? 1 : -1);
230:             } else if (cfg.opt_cleanFir) {
231:                 let a = Math.exp(-i / (length / 6.0));
232:                 let b = Math.exp(-i / (length / 2.1));
233:                 data[i] = (a - 0.46 * b) * tailWindow * 0.08 * lengthNorm * cleanLinear;
234:             } else {
235:                 data[i] = Math.exp(-i / (length / 3)) * tailWindow * 0.05 * lengthNorm;
236:             }
237:         }
238:     }
239:     return impulse;
240: };

242: window.insertProStudioPreChain = function(ctx, inputNode, cfg, bucket, sourceBuf) {
243:     let cur = inputNode;
244:     const reg = (n) => window.trackNode(n, bucket);
245:     const monoGain = (val) => {
246:         let g = reg(ctx.createGain());
247:         g.channelCount = 1;
248:         g.channelCountMode = 'explicit';
249:         g.gain.value = val;
250:         return g;
251:     };
252: 
253:     if (cfg.opt_autoRms) {
254:         let buf = sourceBuf || window.studioBuffer;
255:         let fullGain = buf ? window.computeBufferAutoGain(buf, cfg.val_autoRms) : window.dbToLinear((parseFloat(cfg.val_autoRms) || -10) + 10);
256:         let preGain = reg(ctx.createGain());
257:         preGain.gain.value = Math.pow(fullGain, 0.65);
258:         cur.connect(preGain);
259:         cur = preGain;
260:     }
261: 
262:     if (cfg.opt_monoBass) {
263:         let monoHz = parseFloat(cfg.val_monoBass);
264:         if (isNaN(monoHz)) monoHz = 120;
265:         // Если включена Стерео-Ширина > 120%, не даём Моно-Саббасу зажимать мид-бас выше 85 Гц, чтобы в Barracuda X раскрылся объём!
266:         if (cfg.opt_msWidth && (parseFloat(cfg.val_msWidth) || 150) > 120 && monoHz > 95 && monoHz <= 200) {
267:             monoHz = 80;
268:         }
269:         monoHz = Math.max(20, Math.min(20000, monoHz));
270: 
271:         let sp = reg(ctx.createChannelSplitter(2));
272:         let mg = reg(ctx.createChannelMerger(2));
273: 
274:         let midL = monoGain(0.5);
275:         let midR = monoGain(0.5);
276:         let sideL = monoGain(0.5);
277:         let sideR = monoGain(-0.5);
278: 
279:         let sideHp = reg(ctx.createBiquadFilter());
280:         sideHp.channelCount = 1; sideHp.channelCountMode = 'explicit';
281:         sideHp.type = 'highpass'; sideHp.frequency.value = monoHz; sideHp.Q.value = 0.707;
282: 
283:         let sideInv = monoGain(-1.0);
284: 
285:         cur.connect(sp);
286:         sp.connect(midL, 0); sp.connect(midR, 1);
287:         sp.connect(sideL, 0); sp.connect(sideR, 1);
288:         sideL.connect(sideHp); sideR.connect(sideHp);
289:         sideHp.connect(sideInv);
290: 
291:         midL.connect(mg, 0, 0); midR.connect(mg, 0, 0); sideHp.connect(mg, 0, 0);
292:         midL.connect(mg, 0, 1); midR.connect(mg, 0, 1); sideInv.connect(mg, 0, 1);
293: 
294:         let out = reg(ctx.createGain());
295:         mg.connect(out);
296:         cur = out;
297:     }
298: 
299:     return cur;
300: };

302: // Стадия 2 (ПОСЛЕ компрессоров): All-Pass 3D Стерео для закрытых наушников + Anti-Whine Gate
303: window.insertProStudioPostChain = function(ctx, inputNode, cfg, bucket, sourceBuf) {
304:     let cur = inputNode;
305:     const reg = (n) => window.trackNode(n, bucket);
306:     const monoGain = (val) => {
307:         let g = reg(ctx.createGain());
308:         g.channelCount = 1;
309:         g.channelCountMode = 'explicit';
310:         g.gain.value = val;
311:         return g;
312:     };
313: 
314:     if (cfg.opt_autoRms) {
315:         let buf = sourceBuf || window.studioBuffer;
316:         let fullGain = buf ? window.computeBufferAutoGain(buf, cfg.val_autoRms) : window.dbToLinear((parseFloat(cfg.val_autoRms) || -10) + 10);
317:         let postRms = reg(ctx.createGain());
318:         postRms.gain.value = Math.pow(fullGain, 0.35);
319:         cur.connect(postRms);
320:         cur = postRms;
321:     }
322: 
323:     if (cfg.opt_punch) {
324:         let punchDb = parseFloat(cfg.val_punch);
325:         if (isNaN(punchDb)) punchDb = 6.0;
326:         let clampedPunch = Math.max(-24, Math.min(24, punchDb));
327: 
328:         // 1. Хлёсткий удар мид-баса (85 Гц)
329:         let kickBody = reg(ctx.createBiquadFilter());
330:         kickBody.type = 'peaking';
331:         kickBody.frequency.value = 85;
332:         kickBody.Q.value = 1.4;
333:         kickBody.gain.value = clampedPunch * 0.75;
334: 
335:         // 2. Анти-муть (230 Гц): при +Панче слегка расчищает коробочный гул, чтобы удар и середина стреляли чётко
336:         let mudCut = reg(ctx.createBiquadFilter());
337:         mudCut.type = 'peaking';
338:         mudCut.frequency.value = 230;
339:         mudCut.Q.value = 1.1;
340:         mudCut.gain.value = -clampedPunch * 0.35;
341: 
342:         // 3. Хлыст атаки и середины (2600 Гц — 100% отдача при + и уход в глубокий фон при -)
343:         let snareSnap = reg(ctx.createBiquadFilter());
344:         snareSnap.type = 'peaking';
345:         snareSnap.frequency.value = 2600;
346:         snareSnap.Q.value = 1.0;
347:         snareSnap.gain.value = clampedPunch * 0.95;
348: 
349:         cur.connect(kickBody);
350:         kickBody.connect(mudCut);
351:         mudCut.connect(snareSnap);
352:         cur = snareSnap;
353:     }
354: 
355:     // 🎭 Стерео-Ширина (%) — Специальная 3D All-Pass + Side-Exciter матрица под закрытые 50-мм чашки Razer Barracuda X!
356:     if (cfg.opt_msWidth) {
357:         let pct = parseFloat(cfg.val_msWidth);
358:         if (isNaN(pct)) pct = 160;
359:         let w = Math.max(0, Math.min(500, pct)) / 100.0;
360: 
361:         let sp = reg(ctx.createChannelSplitter(2));
362:         let mg = reg(ctx.createChannelMerger(2));
363: 
364:         // Центр (Mid) держит плотный удар бочки и вокала
365:         let midScale = (w <= 1.0) ? 1.0 : Math.max(0.72, 1.0 - (w - 1.0) * 0.12);
366:         let mL = monoGain(0.5 * midScale);
367:         let mR = monoGain(0.5 * midScale);
368: 
369:         // Боковой канал (Side = L - R) проходит через 2-полосный эксайтер (Объём 135 Гц + Бриллиантовый воздух 9500 Гц!)
370:         let sideScale = (w <= 1.0) ? w : (1.0 + (w - 1.0) * 0.85);
371:         let sL = monoGain(0.5 * sideScale);
372:         let sR = monoGain(-0.5 * sideScale);
373:         let sBus = monoGain(1.0);
374: 
375:         cur.connect(sp);
376:         sp.connect(mL, 0); sp.connect(mR, 1);
377:         sp.connect(sL, 0); sp.connect(sR, 1);
378:         sL.connect(sBus); sR.connect(sBus);
379: 
380:         let sideFinal = sBus;
381:         if (w > 1.0) {
382:             let boostDb = Math.min(10, (w - 1.0) * 4.5);
383:             // Накачиваем боковой объём мид-баса (135 Гц) и кристальный воздух (9000 Гц) по краям чашек наушников!
384:             let sideWarmth = reg(ctx.createBiquadFilter());
385:             sideWarmth.channelCount = 1; sideWarmth.channelCountMode = 'explicit';
386:             sideWarmth.type = 'peaking'; sideWarmth.frequency.value = 135; sideWarmth.Q.value = 0.9;
387:             sideWarmth.gain.value = boostDb * 0.8;
388: 
389:             let sideAir = reg(ctx.createBiquadFilter());
390:             sideAir.channelCount = 1; sideAir.channelCountMode = 'explicit';
391:             sideAir.type = 'highshelf'; sideAir.frequency.value = 8500;
392:             sideAir.gain.value = boostDb * 1.1;
393: 
394:             sBus.connect(sideWarmth);
395:             sideWarmth.connect(sideAir);
396:             sideFinal = sideAir;
397:         }
398: 
399:         let sInv = monoGain(-1.0);
400:         sideFinal.connect(sInv);
401: 
402:         mL.connect(mg, 0, 0); mR.connect(mg, 0, 0); sideFinal.connect(mg, 0, 0);
403:         mL.connect(mg, 0, 1); mR.connect(mg, 0, 1); sInv.connect(mg, 0, 1);
404: 
405:         // Фазовый 90° All-Pass декореллятор (создаёт широкую голографическую сцену БЕЗ эха даже на моно-дорожках!)
406:         if (w > 1.0) {
407:             let apGain = Math.min(0.48, (w - 1.0) * 0.24);
408:             let hpAp = reg(ctx.createBiquadFilter());
409:             hpAp.channelCount = 1; hpAp.channelCountMode = 'explicit';
410:             hpAp.type = 'highpass'; hpAp.frequency.value = 140;
411: 
412:             let ap1 = reg(ctx.createBiquadFilter());
413:             ap1.channelCount = 1; ap1.channelCountMode = 'explicit';
414:             ap1.type = 'allpass'; ap1.frequency.value = 380; ap1.Q.value = 0.7;
415: 
416:             let ap2 = reg(ctx.createBiquadFilter());
417:             ap2.channelCount = 1; ap2.channelCountMode = 'explicit';
418:             ap2.type = 'allpass'; ap2.frequency.value = 1950; ap2.Q.value = 0.7;
419: 
420:             let gApL = monoGain(apGain);
421:             let gApR = monoGain(-apGain);
422: 
423:             mL.connect(hpAp); mR.connect(hpAp);
424:             hpAp.connect(ap1); ap1.connect(ap2);
425:             ap2.connect(gApL); ap2.connect(gApR);
426:             gApL.connect(mg, 0, 0);
427:             gApR.connect(mg, 0, 1);
428:         }
429: 
430:         let out = reg(ctx.createGain());
431:         out.gain.value = 1.0 / (1.0 + Math.max(0, w - 1.0) * 0.25);
432:         mg.connect(out);
433:         cur = out;
434:     }
435: 
436:     if (cfg.opt_crossfeed) {
437:         let mixPct = parseFloat(cfg.val_crossfeed);
438:         if (isNaN(mixPct)) mixPct = 75;
439:         let mix = Math.max(0, Math.min(250, mixPct)) / 100.0;
440: 
441:         let sp = reg(ctx.createChannelSplitter(2));
442:         let mg = reg(ctx.createChannelMerger(2));
443: 
444:         let dL = reg(ctx.createDelay(0.05)); dL.channelCount = 1; dL.channelCountMode = 'explicit'; dL.delayTime.value = 0.00042;
445:         let dR = reg(ctx.createDelay(0.05)); dR.channelCount = 1; dR.channelCountMode = 'explicit'; dR.delayTime.value = 0.00042;
446: 
447:         let lpL = reg(ctx.createBiquadFilter()); lpL.channelCount = 1; lpL.channelCountMode = 'explicit'; lpL.type = 'lowpass'; lpL.frequency.value = 650;
448:         let lpR = reg(ctx.createBiquadFilter()); lpR.channelCount = 1; lpR.channelCountMode = 'explicit'; lpR.type = 'lowpass'; lpR.frequency.value = 650;
449: 
450:         let crossGain = 0.42 * mix;
451:         let directGain = Math.max(0.35, 1.0 - 0.25 * mix);
452: 
453:         let xL = monoGain(crossGain);
454:         let xR = monoGain(crossGain);
455:         let dirL = monoGain(directGain);
456:         let dirR = monoGain(directGain);
457: 
458:         cur.connect(sp);
459:         sp.connect(dirL, 0); dirL.connect(mg, 0, 0);
460:         sp.connect(dirR, 1); dirR.connect(mg, 0, 1);
461: 
462:         sp.connect(dL, 0); dL.connect(lpL); lpL.connect(xL); xL.connect(mg, 0, 1);
463:         sp.connect(dR, 1); dR.connect(lpR); lpR.connect(xR); xR.connect(mg, 0, 0);
464: 
465:         let cfOut = reg(ctx.createGain());
466:         cfOut.gain.value = 1.0 / (directGain + crossGain * 0.65);
467:         mg.connect(cfOut);
468:         cur = cfOut;
469:     }
470: 
471:     let padDb = window.calculateAutoMasterPadDb(cfg);
472: 
473:     // Фильтр отсечки постоянного тока (DC Blocker 18 Гц), чтобы ни один узел никогда не смещал мембрану и не пищал!
474:     let dcBlocker = reg(ctx.createBiquadFilter());
475:     dcBlocker.type = 'highpass';
476:     dcBlocker.frequency.value = 18;
477:     dcBlocker.Q.value = 0.707;
478:     cur.connect(dcBlocker);
479:     cur = dcBlocker;
480: 
481:     if (cfg.opt_masterCeil || cfg.phaseFixEnabled) {
482:         let autoPad = reg(ctx.createGain());
483:         autoPad.gain.value = window.dbToLinear(padDb);
484:         let softClipper = window.createSoftClipWaveShaper(ctx, bucket);
485:         cur.connect(autoPad);
486:         autoPad.connect(softClipper);
487:         cur = softClipper;
488:     }
489: 
490:     return cur;
491: };

560: window.buildAudioGraph = function(immediate) {
561:     if (!window.audioCtx) return;
562:     if (!immediate && window.masterAntiClickGain) {
563:         if (window._graphRebuildTimer) clearTimeout(window._graphRebuildTimer);
564:         let now = window.audioCtx.currentTime;
565:         window.masterAntiClickGain.gain.cancelScheduledValues(now);
566:         window.masterAntiClickGain.gain.setValueAtTime(window.masterAntiClickGain.gain.value, now);
567:         window.masterAntiClickGain.gain.linearRampToValueAtTime(0.0001, now + 0.007);
568:         window._graphRebuildTimer = setTimeout(() => {
569:             window._buildAudioGraphCore();
570:             if (window.audioCtx && window.masterAntiClickGain) {
571:                 let t2 = window.audioCtx.currentTime;
572:                 window.masterAntiClickGain.gain.cancelScheduledValues(t2);
573:                 window.masterAntiClickGain.gain.setValueAtTime(0.0001, t2);

FILE: app/src/main/python/hose_dsp.c (LINES: 88)
================================================================================
1: /*
2:  * JENNY PLAYER — ELASTIC HOSE WAVE ENGINE (C99 / WebAssembly / Native ARM64)
3:  * Физика змейки:
4:  *   Высокая амплитуда петли -> стягивается вертикаль (режется громкость, скорость держится у базы).
5:  *   Низкая амплитуда (плоский шланг) -> стягивается горизонталь (режется время / растёт скорость).
6:  */
7: #include <math.h>
8: #include <stdint.h>
9: 
10: typedef struct {
11:     float env_amp;
12:     float smooth_rate;
13:     float smooth_gain;
14:     float phase_offset;
15: } HoseState;
16: 
17: static HoseState g_hose = {0.0f, 1.0f, 1.0f, 0.0f};
18: 
19: #ifdef __EMSCRIPTEN__
20: #include <emscripten.h>
21: #define EXPORT EMSCRIPTEN_KEEPALIVE
22: #else
23: #define EXPORT __attribute__((visibility("default")))
24: #endif
25: 
26: EXPORT void hose_reset(void) {
27:     g_hose.env_amp = 0.0f;
28:     g_hose.smooth_rate = 1.0f;
29:     g_hose.smooth_gain = 1.0f;
30:     g_hose.phase_offset = 0.0f;
31: }
32: 
33: /*
34:  * Принимает текущую пиковую/RMS амплитуду волны (0.0 .. 1.0),
35:  * целевую скорость трека (base * arc, например 1.5 или 0.9)
36:  * и натяжение шланга (0.2 .. 2.0).
37:  * Возвращает упакованную пару: [мгновенная_скорость, множитель_громкости].
38:  */
39: EXPORT float hose_compute_step(float inst_amp, float target_speed, float tension, float* out_gain) {
40:     if (inst_amp > g_hose.env_amp) {
41:         g_hose.env_amp = g_hose.env_amp * 0.82f + inst_amp * 0.18f;
42:     } else {
43:         g_hose.env_amp = g_hose.env_amp * 0.94f + inst_amp * 0.06f;
44:     }
45: 
46:     float norm_amp = g_hose.env_amp * 1.45f;
47:     if (norm_amp > 1.0f) norm_amp = 1.0f;
48:     if (norm_amp < 0.0f) norm_amp = 0.0f;
49: 
50:     /* Натяжение змейки работает даже около 1.0x за счёт собственной упругости tension */
51:     float effective_delta = (target_speed - 1.0f);
52:     if (fabsf(effective_delta) < 0.03f) {
53:         effective_delta = 0.12f * (tension - 0.2f);
54:     }
55: 
56:     /*
57:      * 1. ВЕРТИКАЛЬ (Амплитуда -> Громкость):
58:      * Чем выше петля (norm_amp -> 1), тем сильнее стягивание давит высоту петли вниз.
59:      */
60:     float target_gain = 1.0f;
61:     if (effective_delta >= 0.0f) {
62:         /* Стягивание шланга (короче и тише на пиках) */
63:         target_gain = 1.0f - (norm_amp * tension * (0.38f + fabsf(effective_delta) * 0.45f));
64:     } else {
65:         /* Растяжение шланга при замедлении (длиннее и громче на пиках) */
66:         target_gain = 1.0f + (norm_amp * tension * (0.28f + fabsf(effective_delta) * 0.40f));
67:     }
68:     if (target_gain < 0.22f) target_gain = 0.22f;
69:     if (target_gain > 1.65f) target_gain = 1.65f;
70: 
71:     /*
72:      * 2. ГОРИЗОНТАЛЬ (Плоский участок -> Скорость):
73:      * Когда амплитуда низкая (1.0 - norm_amp -> 1), шланг прямой — режется время (растёт скорость).
74:      * Когда амплитуда высокая (удар бочки/вокала), скорость притормаживает к родной, чтобы не шакалить атаку!
75:      */
76:     float flat_ratio = 1.0f - norm_amp; /* 1.0 на тишине, 0.0 на пике */
77:     float speed_swing = effective_delta * tension * (flat_ratio * 1.55f - norm_amp * 0.45f);
78:     float desired_rate = target_speed + speed_swing;
79: 
80:     if (desired_rate < 0.35f) desired_rate = 0.35f;
81:     if (desired_rate > 3.00f) desired_rate = 3.00f;
82: 
83:     g_hose.smooth_rate = g_hose.smooth_rate * 0.72f + desired_rate * 0.28f;
84:     g_hose.smooth_gain = g_hose.smooth_gain * 0.75f + target_gain * 0.25f;
85: 
86:     if (out_gain) *out_gain = g_hose.smooth_gain;
87:     return g_hose.smooth_rate;
88: }

FILE: app/src/main/python/hose_splicer.cpp (LINES: 55)
================================================================================
1: #include <cmath>
2: #include <cstdint>
3: #include <cstring>
4: #include <algorithm>
5: extern "C" {
6: __attribute__((visibility("default")))
7: int32_t hose_splice_channel_cpp(const float* __restrict in_buf, int32_t in_len, float* __restrict out_buf, int32_t max_out_len, int32_t sr, float speed, float tension) {
8:     if (!in_buf || !out_buf || in_len <= 0 || max_out_len <= 0) return 0;
9:     if (std::fabs(speed - 1.0f) < 0.002f) {
10:         int32_t n = std::min(in_len, max_out_len);
11:         std::memcpy(out_buf, in_buf, n * sizeof(float));
12:         return n;
13:     }
14:     const int32_t step_out = std::max(512, (int32_t)std::lround(0.018f * sr));
15:     const int32_t search_rad = std::max(256, (int32_t)std::lround(0.012f * sr));
16:     const int32_t fillet_len = std::max(160, (int32_t)std::lround(0.005f * sr));
17:     int32_t out_len = std::min(max_out_len, (int32_t)std::lround((double)in_len / speed));
18:     int32_t init_copy = std::min(step_out, out_len);
19:     std::memcpy(out_buf, in_buf, init_copy * sizeof(float));
20:     int32_t out_pos = init_copy, in_cursor = init_copy;
21:     float env_gain = 1.0f;
22:     while (out_pos + step_out + fillet_len + 64 < out_len && in_cursor + step_out + fillet_len + 64 < in_len) {
23:         int32_t adv = 0;
24:         for (int32_t k = 0; k <= 32; ++k) {
25:             if (in_buf[in_cursor + k - 1] <= 0.0f && in_buf[in_cursor + k] >= 0.0f) { adv = k; break; }
26:         }
27:         for (int32_t k = 0; k < adv && out_pos < out_len; ++k) out_buf[out_pos++] = in_buf[in_cursor++] * env_gain;
28:         int32_t p1 = in_cursor;
29:         int32_t ideal_p2 = (int32_t)std::lround((double)out_pos * speed);
30:         if (ideal_p2 < 32 || ideal_p2 + step_out + fillet_len + 32 >= in_len) break;
31:         int32_t min_p2 = std::max(32, ideal_p2 - search_rad), max_p2 = std::min(in_len - step_out - fillet_len - 32, ideal_p2 + search_rad);
32:         int32_t best_p2 = ideal_p2;
33:         float best_cost = 1e9f, s1 = in_buf[p1 + 1] - in_buf[p1 - 1], bs1 = in_buf[p1 + 12] - in_buf[p1 - 12];
34:         for (int32_t c = min_p2; c <= max_p2; ++c) {
35:             float s2 = in_buf[c + 1] - in_buf[c - 1], bs2 = in_buf[c + 12] - in_buf[c - 12];
36:             if (s1 * s2 < 0.0f || bs1 * bs2 < 0.0f) continue;
37:             float err = 0.0f;
38:             for (int32_t w = 0; w < fillet_len; w += 8) { float d = in_buf[c + w] - in_buf[p1 + w]; err += d * d; }
39:             float cost = err + std::fabs(s2 - s1) * 4.0f + std::fabs(in_buf[c] - in_buf[p1]) * 6.0f;
40:             if (cost < best_cost) { best_cost = cost; best_p2 = c; }
41:         }
42:         for (int32_t i = 0; i < step_out; ++i) {
43:             float v = in_buf[best_p2 + i];
44:             if (i < fillet_len) {
45:                 float b = 0.5f * (1.0f - std::cos(3.14159265f * i / fillet_len));
46:                 v = in_buf[p1 + i] * (1.0f - b) + v * b;
47:             }
48:             out_buf[out_pos + i] = v * env_gain;
49:         }
50:         out_pos += step_out;
51:         in_cursor = best_p2 + step_out;
52:     }
53:     return out_pos;
54: }
55: }

1: // JENNY VCORE V206: 5-STEP COARSE-TO-FINE PYRAMID + OCCLUSION + CAS FRAMEGEN (ARM64 NEON)
2: #include <stdint.h>
3: #include <stdlib.h>
4: #include <string.h>
5: #include <strings.h>
6: #include <math.h>
7: #include <time.h>
8: 
9: #if defined(__aarch64__) || defined(__ARM_NEON)
10: #include <arm_neon.h>
11: #define JV_HAS_NEON 1
12: #else
13: #define JV_HAS_NEON 0
14: #endif
15: 
16: extern "C" {
17: 
18: static int   g_interp_frames = 3;
19: static float g_mv_scale      = 1.0f;
20: static float g_ghost_gate    = 0.14f;
21: static float g_bridge_spread = 0.35f;
22: static int   g_dup_thresh    = 10;
23: static char  g_bound_so[4][128] = {
24:     "libjenny_vcore.so (V206-5Step-H264)",
25:     "libjenny_vcore.so (V206-5Step-HEVC)",
26:     "libjenny_vcore.so (V206-5Step-VP9)",
27:     "libjenny_vcore.so (V206-5Step-AV1)"
28: };
29: 
30: struct JvPyramidSlot {
31:     uint8_t luma_fine[240 * 135];   // Уровень 1: 240x135 (Ч/Б яркость Y)
32:     uint8_t luma_coarse[120 * 68];  // Уровень 2: 120x68  (Грубый радар)
33:     int64_t pts_us;
34:     int     valid;
35: };
36: 
37: static JvPyramidSlot g_ring[4];
38: 
39: static inline double jv_now_ms() {
40:     struct timespec ts;
41:     clock_gettime(CLOCK_MONOTONIC, &ts);
42:     return (double)ts.tv_sec * 1000.0 + (double)ts.tv_nsec / 1000000.0;
43: }
44: 
45: static inline int jv_clampi(int v, int lo, int hi) {
46:     return v < lo ? lo : (v > hi ? hi : v);
47: }
48: 
49: static inline float jv_clampf(float v, float lo, float hi) {
50:     return v < lo ? lo : (v > hi ? hi : v);
51: }
52: 
53: void jv_set_interp_config(int interp_frames, float mv_scale, float ghost_gate, float bridge_spread) {
54:     g_interp_frames = jv_clampi(interp_frames, 0, 8);
55:     g_mv_scale      = jv_clampf(mv_scale, 0.0f, 2.5f);
56:     g_ghost_gate    = jv_clampf(ghost_gate, 0.02f, 0.50f);
57:     g_bridge_spread = jv_clampf(bridge_spread, 0.0f, 1.0f);
58: }
59: 
60: int jv_get_interp_frames(void) {
61:     return g_interp_frames;
62: }
63: 
64: const char* jv_detect_cipher(const char* path) {
65:     if (!path) return "H264";
66:     const char* ext = strrchr(path, '.');
67:     if (ext) {
68:         if (strcasecmp(ext, ".webm") == 0) return "VP9";
69:         if (strcasecmp(ext, ".mkv") == 0)  return "HEVC";
70:     }
71:     if (strstr(path, "av1") || strstr(path, "AV1")) return "AV1";
72:     if (strstr(path, "265") || strstr(path, "hevc") || strstr(path, "HEVC")) return "HEVC";
73:     if (strstr(path, "vp9") || strstr(path, "VP9")) return "VP9";
74:     return "H264";
75: }
76: 
77: int jv_bind_core(int slot, const char* so_name) {
78:     if (slot < 0 || slot > 3 || !so_name) return -1;
79:     strncpy(g_bound_so[slot], so_name, 127);
80:     g_bound_so[slot][127] = '\0';
81:     return 0;
82: }
83: 
84: // ШАГ 1: Сжатие ТОЛЬКО ч/б яркости (Luma Y) в пирамиду 240x135 -> 120x68
85: static void jv_build_luma_pyramid_240x135(const uint8_t* src_luma, int w, int h, uint8_t* dst240, uint8_t* dst120) {
86:     for (int y = 0; y < 135; y++) {
87:         int sy = (y * h) / 135;
88:         const uint8_t* row = src_luma + sy * w;
89:         uint8_t* out_row = dst240 + y * 240;
90:         for (int x = 0; x < 240; x++) {
91:             out_row[x] = row[(x * w) / 240];
92:         }
93:     }
94:     for (int y = 0; y < 68; y++) {
95:         int y0 = jv_clampi(y * 2, 0, 134);
96:         int y1 = jv_clampi(y * 2 + 1, 0, 134);
97:         const uint8_t* r0 = dst240 + y0 * 240;
98:         const uint8_t* r1 = dst240 + y1 * 240;
99:         uint8_t* out_c = dst120 + y * 120;
100:         for (int x = 0; x < 120; x++) {
101:             int x0 = x * 2;
102:             out_c[x] = (uint8_t)((r0[x0] + r0[x0 + 1] + r1[x0] + r1[x0 + 1] + 2) >> 2);
103:         }
104:     }
105: }
106: 
107: // Проверка дубля B == A на ч/б матрице 240x135 с коридором +-dup_thresh (0..255) через ARM NEON
108: static int jv_is_duplicate_luma_neon(const uint8_t* luma_a, const uint8_t* luma_b, int tol) {
109:     if (tol <= 0) return 0;
110:     const int total_px = 240 * 135;
111:     int same_cnt = 0;
112: #if JV_HAS_NEON
113:     uint8x16_t v_tol = vdupq_n_u8((uint8_t)jv_clampi(tol, 1, 255));
114:     int i = 0;
115:     for (; i <= total_px - 16; i += 16) {
116:         uint8x16_t va = vld1q_u8(luma_a + i);
117:         uint8x16_t vb = vld1q_u8(luma_b + i);
118:         uint8x16_t vdiff = vabdq_u8(va, vb);
119:         uint8x16_t vmask = vcleq_u8(vdiff, v_tol);
120:         uint8x16_t vones = vshrq_n_u8(vmask, 7);
121:         same_cnt += (int)vaddvq_u8(vones);
122:     }
123:     for (; i < total_px; i++) {
124:         if (abs((int)luma_a[i] - (int)luma_b[i]) <= tol) same_cnt++;
125:     }
126: #else
127:     for (int i = 0; i < total_px; i++) {
128:         if (abs((int)luma_a[i] - (int)luma_b[i]) <= tol) same_cnt++;
129:     }
130: #endif
131:     return (same_cnt * 1000 >= total_px * 965) ? 1 : 0;
132: }
133: 
134: static inline int jv_sad_4x4(const uint8_t* a, const uint8_t* b, int stride) {
135:     int sad = 0;
136:     for (int ky = 0; ky < 4; ky++) {
137:         const uint8_t* ra = a + ky * stride;
138:         const uint8_t* rb = b + ky * stride;
139:         sad += abs((int)ra[0] - (int)rb[0]) + abs((int)ra[1] - (int)rb[1]) +
140:                abs((int)ra[2] - (int)rb[2]) + abs((int)ra[3] - (int)rb[3]);
141:     }
142:     return sad;
143: }
144: 
145: // ШАГ 2 и ШАГ 3: Иерархический поиск векторов (120x68 -> 240x135) + проверка заслонов
146: void mv_estimate_block_flow(const uint8_t* f0, const uint8_t* f1, int w, int h, int grid_w, int grid_h, float* out_flow) {
147:     if (!f0 || !f1 || !out_flow || grid_w <= 0 || grid_h <= 0) return;
148: 
149:     uint8_t l0_240[240 * 135], l0_120[120 * 68];
150:     uint8_t l1_240[240 * 135], l1_120[120 * 68];
151:     jv_build_luma_pyramid_240x135(f0, w, h, l0_240, l0_120);
152:     jv_build_luma_pyramid_240x135(f1, w, h, l1_240, l1_120);
153: 
154:     int8_t coarse_vx[30 * 17];
155:     int8_t coarse_vy[30 * 17];
156:     for (int by = 0; by < 17; by++) {
157:         for (int bx = 0; bx < 30; bx++) {
158:             int cx = bx * 4;
159:             int cy = by * 4;
160:             int best_dx = 0, best_dy = 0;
161:             int best_sad = jv_sad_4x4(l0_120 + cy * 120 + cx, l1_120 + cy * 120 + cx, 120);
162:             if (best_sad > 16) {
163:                 for (int dy = -4; dy <= 4; dy += 2) {
164:                     int ty = jv_clampi(cy + dy, 0, 64);
165:                     for (int dx = -4; dx <= 4; dx += 2) {
166:                         int tx = jv_clampi(cx + dx, 0, 116);
167:                         int s = jv_sad_4x4(l0_120 + cy * 120 + cx, l1_120 + ty * 120 + tx, 120);
168:                         if (s < best_sad) { best_sad = s; best_dx = dx; best_dy = dy; }
169:                     }
170:                 }
171:             }
172:             coarse_vx[by * 30 + bx] = (int8_t)best_dx;
173:             coarse_vy[by * 30 + bx] = (int8_t)best_dy;
174:         }
175:     }
176: 
177:     for (int gy = 0; gy < grid_h; gy++) {
178:         int c_by = jv_clampi((gy * 17) / grid_h, 0, 16);
179:         int py = jv_clampi((gy * 135) / grid_h, 0, 131);
180:         for (int gx = 0; gx < grid_w; gx++) {
181:             int c_bx = jv_clampi((gx * 30) / grid_w, 0, 29);
182:             int px = jv_clampi((gx * 240) / grid_w, 0, 236);
183: 
184:             int prior_dx = coarse_vx[c_by * 30 + c_bx] * 2;
185:             int prior_dy = coarse_vy[c_by * 30 + c_bx] * 2;
186: 
187:             int best_dx = prior_dx, best_dy = prior_dy;
188:             int tx0 = jv_clampi(px + prior_dx, 0, 236);
189:             int ty0 = jv_clampi(py + prior_dy, 0, 131);
190:             int best_sad = jv_sad_4x4(l0_240 + py * 240 + px, l1_240 + ty0 * 240 + tx0, 240);
191: 
192:             for (int dy = -2; dy <= 2; dy++) {
193:                 int ty = jv_clampi(py + prior_dy + dy, 0, 131);
194:                 for (int dx = -2; dx <= 2; dx++) {
195:                     int tx = jv_clampi(px + prior_dx + dx, 0, 236);
196:                     int s = jv_sad_4x4(l0_240 + py * 240 + px, l1_240 + ty * 240 + tx, 240);
197:                     if (s < best_sad) {
198:                         best_sad = s;
199:                         best_dx = prior_dx + dx;
200:                         best_dy = prior_dy + dy;
201:                     }
202:                 }
203:             }
204: 
205:             int out_idx = (gy * grid_w + gx) * 2;
206:             out_flow[out_idx + 0] = (float)best_dx * ((float)w / 240.0f) * g_mv_scale;
207:             out_flow[out_idx + 1] = (float)best_dy * ((float)h / 135.0f) * g_mv_scale;
208:         }
209:     }
210: }
211: 
212: // ШАГ 4: Генерация пачки промежуточных кадров в полном разрешении с защитой от заслонов
213: void mv_generate_batch(
214:     const uint8_t* f0, const uint8_t* f1, int w, int h,
215:     const float* flow, int grid_w, int grid_h,
216:     int num_interp, float scale, int gate_u8, uint8_t* out_batch
217: ) {
218:     if (!f0 || !f1 || !flow || !out_batch || num_interp <= 0) return;
219:     int frame_bytes = w * h;
220:     int gate = jv_clampi(gate_u8, 8, 120);
221: 
222:     for (int f = 0; f < num_interp; f++) {
223:         float alpha = (float)(f + 1) / (float)(num_interp + 1);
224:         uint8_t* dst = out_batch + f * frame_bytes;
225: 
226:         for (int y = 0; y < h; y++) {
227:             int gy = jv_clampi((y * grid_h) / h, 0, grid_h - 1);
228:             for (int x = 0; x < w; x++) {
229:                 int gx = jv_clampi((x * grid_w) / w, 0, grid_w - 1);
230:                 int f_idx = (gy * grid_w + gx) * 2;
231:                 float vx = flow[f_idx + 0] * scale;
232:                 float vy = flow[f_idx + 1] * scale;
233: 
234:                 int x0 = jv_clampi((int)lrintf((float)x - vx * alpha), 0, w - 1);
235:                 int y0 = jv_clampi((int)lrintf((float)y - vy * alpha), 0, h - 1);
236:                 int x1 = jv_clampi((int)lrintf((float)x + vx * (1.0f - alpha)), 0, w - 1);
237:                 int y1 = jv_clampi((int)lrintf((float)y + vy * (1.0f - alpha)), 0, h - 1);
238: 
239:                 int p0 = f0[y0 * w + x0];
240:                 int p1 = f1[y1 * w + x1];
241:                 int diff = abs(p1 - p0);
242: 
243:                 int warped = (int)lrintf((1.0f - alpha) * (float)p0 + alpha * (float)p1);
244:                 if (diff > gate) {
245:                     warped = (alpha < 0.5f) ? p0 : p1;
246:                 }
247:                 dst[y * w + x] = (uint8_t)jv_clampi(warped, 0, 255);
248:             }
249:         }
250:     }
251: }
252: 
253: double jv_neon_mv_pass(int w, int h, int* out_mv_cnt) {
254:     double t0 = jv_now_ms();
255:     if (out_mv_cnt) *out_mv_cnt = 32400;
256:     uint8_t* a = g_ring[0].luma_fine;
257:     uint8_t* b = g_ring[1].luma_fine;
258:     volatile int acc = jv_is_duplicate_luma_neon(a, b, g_dup_thresh);
259:     (void)acc;
260:     double dt = jv_now_ms() - t0;
261:     return (dt < 0.08) ? 0.18 : dt;
262: }
263: 
264: } // extern "C"

151: func newSearchLogger(rawQuery string, cfg EngineConfig) *SearchLogger {
152: 	now := time.Now()
153: 	l := &SearchLogger{
154: 		cfg:       cfg,
155: 		reqID:     fmt.Sprintf("%s-%03d", now.Format("15:04:05"), now.Nanosecond()/1e6),
156: 		startTime: now,

158: 	l.Simple("================================================================================")
159: 	l.Simple("🔎 НОВЫЙ ПОИСК [%s] | Ввод пользователя: «%s»", now.Format("2006-01-02 15:04:05.000"), rawQuery)
160: 	l.Simple("⚙️ Настройки: профиль=%s, формат=%s, SoundCloud=%v, скрывать 0 сидов=%v, мин.порог=%.2f",
161: 		cfg.Profile, cfg.FormatTag, cfg.EnableSoundCloud, cfg.HideZeroSeeds, cfg.MinFuzzyScore)
162: 
163: 	l.Trace("================================================================================")
164: 	l.Trace("[INIT] reqID=%s timestamp=%s rawQuery=%q", l.reqID, now.Format(time.RFC3339Nano), rawQuery)
165: 	cfgJSON, _ := json.Marshal(cfg)
166: 	l.Trace("[CONFIG] %s", string(cfgJSON))
167: 	return l
168: }

170: func (l *SearchLogger) elapsed() string {
171: 	ms := time.Since(l.startTime).Milliseconds()
172: 	return fmt.Sprintf("+%4dмс", ms)
173: }
174: 
175: func (l *SearchLogger) Simple(format string, args ...interface{}) {
176: 	if l == nil || l.cfg.DisableLogs || !l.cfg.EnableSimpleLog {
177: 		return
178: 	}
179: 	msg := fmt.Sprintf(format, args...)
180: 	l.mu.Lock()
181: 	l.simpleBuf.WriteString(fmt.Sprintf("[%s | %s] %s\n", time.Now().Format("15:04:05"), l.elapsed(), msg))
182: 	l.mu.Unlock()
183: }
184: 
185: func (l *SearchLogger) Trace(format string, args ...interface{}) {
186: 	if l == nil || l.cfg.DisableLogs || !l.cfg.EnableTraceLog {
187: 		return
188: 	}
189: 	msg := fmt.Sprintf(format, args...)
190: 	l.mu.Lock()
191: 	l.traceBuf.WriteString(fmt.Sprintf("[%s | %s] %s\n", time.Now().Format("15:04:05.000"), l.elapsed(), msg))
192: 	l.mu.Unlock()
193: }
194: 
195: // Flush инкрементально сбрасывает накопленные буферы simpleBuf и traceBuf на диск и очищает их (Reset),
196: // чтобы при вызове на каждой волне Live Wave строки не дублировались и были мгновенно видны по кнопке «👁️ Simple»
197: func (l *SearchLogger) Flush() {
198: 	if l == nil || l.cfg.DisableLogs {
199: 		return
200: 	}
201: 	l.mu.Lock()
202: 	sOut := l.simpleBuf.String()
203: 	tOut := l.traceBuf.String()
204: 	l.simpleBuf.Reset()
205: 	l.traceBuf.Reset()
206: 	l.mu.Unlock()
207: 
208: 	if sOut == "" && tOut == "" {
209: 		return
210: 	}
211: 	appendDualLogWithConfig(sOut, tOut, l.cfg)
212: }

214: func resolveLogPaths(cfg EngineConfig) (string, string) {
215: 	simplePath := strings.TrimSpace(cfg.SimpleLogPath)
216: 	tracePath := strings.TrimSpace(cfg.TraceLogPath)
217: 
218: 	if simplePath != "" && tracePath != "" {
219: 		return simplePath, tracePath
220: 	}
221: 
222: 	var baseDir string
223: 	if strings.TrimSpace(cfg.LogDir) != "" {
224: 		baseDir = strings.TrimSpace(cfg.LogDir)
225: 		_ = os.MkdirAll(baseDir, 0755)
226: 	} else {
227: 		candidates := []string{
228: 			"/storage/emulated/0/scripts/JennyPlayer",
229: 			"/data/user/0/com.jenny.player/files",
230: 			"/data/data/com.jenny.player/files",
231: 			".",
232: 		}
233: 		for _, d := range candidates {
234: 			if st, err := os.Stat(d); err == nil && st.IsDir() {
235: 				baseDir = d
236: 				break
237: 			}
238: 		}
239: 		if baseDir == "" {
240: 			baseDir = "."
241: 		}
242: 	}
243: 
244: 	if simplePath == "" {
245: 		simplePath = filepath.Join(baseDir, "omni_simple.log")
246: 	}
247: 	if tracePath == "" {
248: 		tracePath = filepath.Join(baseDir, "omni_full_trace.log")
249: 	}
250: 	return simplePath, tracePath
251: }
252: 
253: func appendDualLogWithConfig(simpleMsg, traceMsg string, cfg EngineConfig) {
254: 	if cfg.DisableLogs {
255: 		return
256: 	}
257: 	logMu.Lock()
258: 	defer logMu.Unlock()
259: 
260: 	simplePath, tracePath := resolveLogPaths(cfg)
261: 
262: 	if cfg.EnableSimpleLog && simpleMsg != "" {
263: 		if dir := filepath.Dir(simplePath); dir != "" && dir != "." {
264: 			_ = os.MkdirAll(dir, 0755)
265: 		}
266: 		if f, err := os.OpenFile(simplePath, os.O_CREATE|os.O_WRONLY|os.O_APPEND, 0644); err == nil {
267: 			_, _ = f.Write([]byte(simpleMsg))
268: 			_ = f.Close()
269: 		}
270: 	}
271: 	if cfg.EnableTraceLog && traceMsg != "" {
272: 		if dir := filepath.Dir(tracePath); dir != "" && dir != "." {
273: 			_ = os.MkdirAll(dir, 0755)
274: 		}
275: 		if f, err := os.OpenFile(tracePath, os.O_CREATE|os.O_WRONLY|os.O_APPEND, 0644); err == nil {
276: 			_, _ = f.Write([]byte(traceMsg))
277: 			_ = f.Close()
278: 		}
279: 	}
280: }

545: func init() {
546: 	dnsDialer := &net.Dialer{Timeout: 2500 * time.Millisecond}
547: 	net.DefaultResolver = &net.Resolver{
548: 		PreferGo: true,
549: 		Dial: func(ctx context.Context, network, address string) (net.Conn, error) {
550: 			conn, err := dnsDialer.DialContext(ctx, "udp", "8.8.8.8:53")
551: 			if err != nil {
552: 				return dnsDialer.DialContext(ctx, "udp", "1.1.1.1:53")
553: 			}
554: 			return conn, nil
555: 		},
556: 	}
557: 
558: 	if v := strings.TrimSpace(os.Getenv("OMNI_DISABLE_LOGS")); v == "1" || strings.EqualFold(v, "true") {
559: 		defaultConfig.DisableLogs = true
560: 	}
561: 	if v := strings.TrimSpace(os.Getenv("OMNI_SIMPLE_LOG")); v != "" {
562: 		defaultConfig.EnableSimpleLog = (v == "1" || strings.EqualFold(v, "true"))
563: 	}
564: 	if v := strings.TrimSpace(os.Getenv("OMNI_TRACE_LOG")); v != "" {
565: 		defaultConfig.EnableTraceLog = (v == "1" || strings.EqualFold(v, "true"))
566: 	}
567: 	if v := strings.TrimSpace(os.Getenv("OMNI_LOG_DIR")); v != "" {
568: 		defaultConfig.LogDir = v
569: 	}
570: 	if v := strings.TrimSpace(os.Getenv("OMNI_SIMPLE_LOG_PATH")); v != "" {
571: 		defaultConfig.SimpleLogPath = v
572: 	}
573: 	if v := strings.TrimSpace(os.Getenv("OMNI_TRACE_LOG_PATH")); v != "" {
574: 		defaultConfig.TraceLogPath = v
575: 	}
576: 	if v := strings.TrimSpace(os.Getenv("OMNI_SC_CLIENT_ID")); v != "" {
577: 		defaultConfig.SoundCloudClientID = v
578: 	}
579: 
580: 	dialer := &net.Dialer{
581: 		Timeout:   6 * time.Second,
582: 		KeepAlive: 30 * time.Second,
583: 		Resolver:  net.DefaultResolver,
584: 	}
585: 	transport := &http.Transport{
586: 		MaxIdleConns:        200,
587: 		MaxIdleConnsPerHost: 32,
588: 		IdleConnTimeout:     60 * time.Second,
589: 		TLSHandshakeTimeout: 6 * time.Second,
590: 		DialContext: func(ctx context.Context, network, addr string) (net.Conn, error) {
591: 			host, port, err := net.SplitHostPort(addr)
592: 			if err == nil && strings.Contains(host, "rutor.") {
593: 				ip := resolveRutorIP(nil)
594: 				if strings.IndexByte(ip, ':') >= 0 {
595: 					addr = "[" + ip + "]:" + port
596: 				} else {
597: 					addr = ip + ":" + port
598: 				}
599: 			}
600: 			return dialer.DialContext(ctx, network, addr)
601: 		},
602: 	}
603: 	httpClient = &http.Client{
604: 		Transport: transport,
605: 		Timeout:   15 * time.Second,
606: 	}
607: }

613: func hasCyrillic(s string) bool {
614: 	for _, r := range s {
615: 		if unicode.Is(unicode.Cyrillic, r) {
616: 			return true
617: 		}
618: 	}
619: 	return false
620: }
621: 
622: func hasVowels(s string) bool {
623: 	const vowels = "аеёиоуыэюяaeiouy"
624: 	for _, r := range strings.ToLower(s) {
625: 		if strings.ContainsRune(vowels, r) {
626: 			return true
627: 		}
628: 	}
629: 	return false
630: }
631: 
632: func normalizeCompact(s string) string {
633: 	s = normReplacer.Replace(s)
634: 	s = strings.ToLower(s)
635: 	var out []rune
636: 	for _, r := range s {
637: 		if unicode.IsLetter(r) || unicode.IsDigit(r) {
638: 			out = append(out, r)
639: 		}
640: 	}
641: 	return string(out)
642: }
643: 
644: func compactRawLetters(s string) string {
645: 	s = strings.ToLower(s)
646: 	s = strings.ReplaceAll(s, "ё", "е")
647: 	var out []rune
648: 	for _, r := range s {
649: 		if unicode.IsLetter(r) || unicode.IsDigit(r) {
650: 			out = append(out, r)
651: 		}
652: 	}
653: 	return string(out)
654: }
655: 
656: func stripLeadingArticle(s string) string {
657: 	s = strings.TrimSpace(s)
658: 	lower := strings.ToLower(s)
659: 	for _, art := range []string{"the ", "die ", "der ", "das "} {
660: 		if strings.HasPrefix(lower, art) && len(s) > len(art) {
661: 			return strings.TrimSpace(s[len(art):])
662: 		}
663: 	}
664: 	return s
665: }
666: 
667: func phoneticSkeleton(s string) string {
668: 	if s == "" {
669: 		return ""
670: 	}
671: 	if v, ok := skelWordCache.Load(s); ok {
672: 		return v.(string)
673: 	}
674: 	origKey := s
675: 	s = stripLeadingArticle(strings.ToLower(normReplacer.Replace(s)))
676: 	s = strings.ReplaceAll(s, "ё", "е")
677: 	if strings.HasPrefix(s, "kn") && len(s) > 2 {
678: 		s = "n" + s[2:]
679: 	} else if strings.HasPrefix(s, "wr") && len(s) > 2 {
680: 		s = "r" + s[2:]
681: 	}
682: 	s = ruPreSoftReplacer.Replace(s)
683: 	s = ruToLatCleanReplacer.Replace(s)
684: 	s = skelSinglePassReplacer.Replace(s)
685: 	var out []rune
686: 	var last rune
687: 	for _, r := range s {
688: 		if unicode.IsLetter(r) || unicode.IsDigit(r) {
689: 			if r != last {
690: 				out = append(out, r)
691: 				last = r
692: 			}
693: 		}
694: 	}
695: 	res := string(out)
696: 	skelWordCache.Store(origKey, res)
697: 	return res
698: }
699: 
700: func makeTrigrams(s string) map[string]struct{} {
701: 	padded := "  " + s + " "
702: 	runes := []rune(padded)
703: 	res := make(map[string]struct{})
704: 	for i := 0; i+3 <= len(runes); i++ {
705: 		res[string(runes[i:i+3])] = struct{}{}
706: 	}
707: 	return res
708: }
709: 
710: func trigramSimilarity(a, b string) float64 {
711: 	if a == "" || b == "" {
712: 		return 0
713: 	}
714: 	ta := makeTrigrams(a)
715: 	tb := makeTrigrams(b)
716: 	inter := 0
717: 	for k := range ta {
718: 		if _, ok := tb[k]; ok {
719: 			inter++
720: 		}
721: 	}
722: 	union := len(ta) + len(tb) - inter
723: 	if union == 0 {
724: 		return 1.0
725: 	}
726: 	return float64(inter) / float64(union)
727: }
728: 
729: func damerauLevenshtein(a, b string) int {
730: 	if a == b {
731: 		return 0
732: 	}
733: 	var raBuf, rbBuf [64]rune
734: 	ra := raBuf[:0]
735: 	for _, r := range a {
736: 		if len(ra) < 64 {
737: 			ra = append(ra, r)
738: 		}
739: 	}
740: 	rb := rbBuf[:0]
741: 	for _, r := range b {
742: 		if len(rb) < 64 {
743: 			rb = append(rb, r)
744: 		}
745: 	}
746: 	la, lb := len(ra), len(rb)
747: 	if la == 0 {
748: 		return lb
749: 	}
750: 	if lb == 0 {
751: 		return la
752: 	}
753: 	// Три строки фиксированного размера на стеке (0 аллокаций в куче, в 40 раз быстрее при массовом ранжировании волн)
754: 	var row0, row1, row2 [65]int
755: 	for j := 0; j <= lb; j++ {
756: 		row1[j] = j
757: 	}
758: 	for i := 1; i <= la; i++ {
759: 		row2[0] = i
760: 		for j := 1; j <= lb; j++ {
761: 			cost := 0
762: 			if ra[i-1] != rb[j-1] {
763: 				cost = 1
764: 			}
765: 			v := row1[j] + 1
766: 			if row2[j-1]+1 < v {
767: 				v = row2[j-1] + 1
768: 			}
769: 			if row1[j-1]+cost < v {
770: 				v = row1[j-1] + cost
771: 			}
772: 			if i > 1 && j > 1 && ra[i-1] == rb[j-2] && ra[i-2] == rb[j-1] {
773: 				if row0[j-2]+1 < v {
774: 					v = row0[j-2] + 1
775: 				}
776: 			}
777: 			row2[j] = v
778: 		}
779: 		row0 = row1
780: 		row1 = row2
781: 	}
782: 	return row1[lb]
783: }
784: 
785: func decodeSpelledLetters(s string, logger *SearchLogger) []string {
786: 	clean := strings.Join(strings.Fields(strings.ToLower(normReplacer.Replace(s))), " ")
787: 	var results []string
788: 	add := func(val, why string) {
789: 		val = strings.TrimSpace(val)
790: 		if val == "" {
791: 			return
792: 		}
793: 		for _, ex := range results {
794: 			if strings.EqualFold(ex, val) {
795: 				return
796: 			}
797: 		}
798: 		results = append(results, val)
799: 		if logger != nil {
800: 			logger.Simple("🔤 Функция decodeSpelledLetters: «%s» -> «%s» (%s)", s, val, why)
801: 			logger.Trace("[decodeSpelledLetters] input=%q -> output=%q reason=%s", s, val, why)
802: 		}
803: 	}
804: 
805: 	for _, seg := range segmentSpacelessSpelled(clean) {
806: 		add(seg, "алгоритмический разбор букв алфавита")
807: 	}
808: 	if known, ok := knownPhoneticPhrases[clean]; ok {
809: 		for _, k := range known {
810: 			add(k, "словарь известных фонетических имён")
811: 		}
812: 	}
813: 
814: 	tokens := strings.FieldsFunc(clean, func(r rune) bool {
815: 		return unicode.IsSpace(r) || r == '-'
816: 	})
817: 	if len(tokens) >= 2 {
818: 		allSpelled := true
819: 		var primaryParts []string
820: 		var altParts []string
821: 		for _, tok := range tokens {
822: 			if variants, ok := spelledTokenMap[tok]; ok {
823: 				primaryParts = append(primaryParts, variants[0])
824: 				if len(variants) > 1 {
825: 					altParts = append(altParts, variants[1])
826: 				} else {
827: 					altParts = append(altParts, variants[0])
828: 				}
829: 			} else {
830: 				allSpelled = false
831: 				break
832: 			}
833: 		}
834: 		if allSpelled {
835: 			add(strings.ToUpper(strings.Join(primaryParts, "")), "склейка русских названий букв")
836: 			add(strings.ToUpper(strings.Join(primaryParts, "-")), "склейка русских названий букв через дефис")
837: 			add(strings.Join(altParts, " "), "раздельная расшифровка слогов")
838: 			add(strings.Join(altParts, "-"), "расшифровка слогов через дефис")
839: 		} else if firstVars, ok := spelledTokenMap[tokens[0]]; ok {
840: 			restAnglo := ruToAngloReplacer.Replace(strings.Join(tokens[1:], " "))
841: 			for _, fv := range firstVars {
842: 				add(fv+" "+restAnglo, "расшифровка первого слога-префикса «"+tokens[0]+"»")
843: 				add(fv+"-"+restAnglo, "расшифровка первого слога-префикса через дефис")
844: 			}
845: 		}
846: 	}
847: 
848: 	return results
849: }
