3506: // searchSoulseekSeeker подключается к P2P-сети Soulseek (протокол Android-клиента Seeker: server.slsknet.org:2242 и демон slskd)
3507: func searchSoulseekSeeker(ctx context.Context, query string, logger *SearchLogger) []TorrentResult {
3508: 	configMu.RLock()
3509: 	cfg := defaultConfig
3510: 	configMu.RUnlock()
3511: 	if !cfg.EnableSeekerP2P {
3512: 		return nil
3513: 	}
3514: 
3515: 	// 1. Если запущен локальный или удалённый демон slskd / Seeker REST Gateway (по умолчанию http://127.0.0.1:5000)
3516: 	slskdBase := strings.TrimRight(strings.TrimSpace(cfg.SlskdURL), "/")
3517: 	if slskdBase != "" {
3518: 		t0 := time.Now()
3519: 		reqCtx, cancel := context.WithTimeout(ctx, 4*time.Second)
3520: 		defer cancel()
3521: 
3522: 		payload, _ := json.Marshal(map[string]interface{}{"searchText": query, "searchTimeout": 3000})
3523: 		req, err := http.NewRequestWithContext(reqCtx, "POST", slskdBase+"/api/v0/searches", bytes.NewReader(payload))
3524: 		if err == nil {
3525: 			req.Header.Set("Content-Type", "application/json")
3526: 			if cfg.SlskdAPIKey != "" {
3527: 				req.Header.Set("X-API-Key", cfg.SlskdAPIKey)
3528: 			}
3529: 			if resp, err := httpClient.Do(req); err == nil {
3530: 				var sRes struct {
3531: 					ID        string `json:"id"`
3532: 					Responses []struct {
3533: 						Username string `json:"username"`
3534: 						Files    []struct {
3535: 							Filename string `json:"filename"`
3536: 							Size     int64  `json:"size"`
3537: 							BitRate  int    `json:"bitRate"`
3538: 						} `json:"files"`
3539: 					} `json:"responses"`
3540: 				}
3541: 				_ = json.NewDecoder(resp.Body).Decode(&sRes)
3542: 				resp.Body.Close()
3543: 
3544: 				var results []TorrentResult
3545: 				for _, peer := range sRes.Responses {
3546: 					for _, f := range peer.Files {
3547: 						sum := md5.Sum([]byte(peer.Username + ":" + f.Filename))
3548: 						fakeHash := hex.EncodeToString(sum[:]) + hex.EncodeToString(sum[:4])
3549: 						title := fmt.Sprintf("[Seeker/Soulseek] %s (%d kbps)", filepath.Base(strings.ReplaceAll(f.Filename, "\\", "/")), f.BitRate)
3550: 						slskURI := fmt.Sprintf("slsk://%s/%s", url.PathEscape(peer.Username), url.PathEscape(strings.ReplaceAll(f.Filename, "\\", "/")))
3551: 						results = append(results, TorrentResult{
3552: 							Title:     title,
3553: 							Magnet:    slskURI,
3554: 							InfoHash:  fakeHash,
3555: 							Size:      f.Size,
3556: 							SizeMB:    float64(f.Size) / (1024 * 1024),
3557: 							SizeHuman: formatBytes(f.Size),
3558: 							Seeds:     5,
3559: 							Peers:     1,
3560: 							Source:    "Seeker(Soulseek)",
3561: 						})
3562: 					}
3563: 				}
3564: 				if len(results) > 0 {
3565: 					logger.Simple("🐦 Seeker/Soulseek P2P (%s): по запросу «%s» найдено %d файлов за %d мс",
3566: 						slskdBase, query, len(results), time.Since(t0).Milliseconds())
3567: 					return results
3568: 				}
3569: 			}
3570: 		}
3571: 	}
3572: 
3573: 	// 2. Прямой бинарный протокол центрального сервера Soulseek (server.slsknet.org:2242, как в Android-клиенте Seeker)
3574: 	if cfg.SlskUsername != "" && cfg.SlskPassword != "" {
3575: 		conn, err := net.DialTimeout("tcp", "server.slsknet.org:2242", 2*time.Second)
3576: 		if err == nil {
3577: 			defer conn.Close()
3578: 			_ = conn.SetDeadline(time.Now().Add(2500 * time.Millisecond))
3579: 			// Пакет Login (Code = 1): [len][1][user][pass][version=160][md5(user+pass)][minor=1]
3580: 			var loginBuf bytes.Buffer
3581: 			_ = binary.Write(&loginBuf, binary.LittleEndian, uint32(1))
3582: 			writeSlskString := func(b *bytes.Buffer, s string) {
3583: 				_ = binary.Write(b, binary.LittleEndian, uint32(len(s)))
3584: 				b.WriteString(s)
3585: 			}
3586: 			writeSlskString(&loginBuf, cfg.SlskUsername)
3587: 			writeSlskString(&loginBuf, cfg.SlskPassword)
3588: 			_ = binary.Write(&loginBuf, binary.LittleEndian, uint32(160))
3589: 			h := md5.Sum([]byte(cfg.SlskUsername + cfg.SlskPassword))
3590: 			writeSlskString(&loginBuf, hex.EncodeToString(h[:]))
3591: 			_ = binary.Write(&loginBuf, binary.LittleEndian, uint32(1))
3592: 
3593: 			var pkt bytes.Buffer
3594: 			_ = binary.Write(&pkt, binary.LittleEndian, uint32(loginBuf.Len()))
3595: 			pkt.Write(loginBuf.Bytes())
3596: 			_, _ = conn.Write(pkt.Bytes())
3597: 
3598: 			// Пакет FileSearch (Code = 26): [len][26][ticket][query]
3599: 			var searchBuf bytes.Buffer
3600: 			_ = binary.Write(&searchBuf, binary.LittleEndian, uint32(26))
3601: 			_ = binary.Write(&searchBuf, binary.LittleEndian, uint32(rand.Int31()))
3602: 			writeSlskString(&searchBuf, query)
3603: 			var spkt bytes.Buffer
3604: 			_ = binary.Write(&spkt, binary.LittleEndian, uint32(searchBuf.Len()))
3605: 			spkt.Write(searchBuf.Bytes())
3606: 			_, _ = conn.Write(spkt.Bytes())
3607: 			logger.Trace("[Seeker-TCP] Dispatched Soulseek P2P search packet for %q to server.slsknet.org:2242", query)
3608: 		}
3609: 	}
3610: 	return nil
3611: }

3616: 
3617: func udpScrapeSingleTracker(trackerAddr string, hashes [][]byte, logger *SearchLogger) map[string][2]int {
3618: 	t0 := time.Now()
3619: 	out := make(map[string][2]int)
3620: 	if len(hashes) == 0 {
3621: 		return out
3622: 	}
3623: 	conn, err := net.DialTimeout("udp", trackerAddr, 550*time.Millisecond)
3624: 	if err != nil {
3625: 		logger.Trace("[UDP-Scrape] dial err tracker=%s err=%v", trackerAddr, err)
3626: 		return out
3627: 	}
3628: 	defer conn.Close()
3629: 	_ = conn.SetDeadline(time.Now().Add(650 * time.Millisecond))
3630: 
3631: 	txID := uint32(rand.Int31())
3632: 	var req [16]byte
3633: 	binary.BigEndian.PutUint64(req[0:8], 0x41727101980)
3634: 	binary.BigEndian.PutUint32(req[8:12], 0)
3635: 	binary.BigEndian.PutUint32(req[12:16], txID)
3636: 	if _, err := conn.Write(req[:]); err != nil {
3637: 		return out
3638: 	}
3639: 
3640: 	var resp [16]byte
3641: 	if n, err := conn.Read(resp[:]); err != nil || n < 16 {
3642: 		return out
3643: 	}
3644: 	if binary.BigEndian.Uint32(resp[0:4]) != 0 || binary.BigEndian.Uint32(resp[4:8]) != txID {
3645: 		return out
3646: 	}
3647: 	connID := binary.BigEndian.Uint64(resp[8:16])
3648: 
3649: 	if len(hashes) > 70 {
3650: 		hashes = hashes[:70]
3651: 	}
3652: 	txID2 := uint32(rand.Int31())
3653: 	sreq := make([]byte, 16+20*len(hashes))
3654: 	binary.BigEndian.PutUint64(sreq[0:8], connID)
3655: 	binary.BigEndian.PutUint32(sreq[8:12], 2)
3656: 	binary.BigEndian.PutUint32(sreq[12:16], txID2)
3657: 	for i, h := range hashes {
3658: 		copy(sreq[16+i*20:16+(i+1)*20], h)
3659: 	}
3660: 	if _, err := conn.Write(sreq); err != nil {
3661: 		return out
3662: 	}
3663: 
3664: 	sresp := make([]byte, 8+12*len(hashes))
3665: 	n, err := conn.Read(sresp)
3666: 	if err != nil || n < 8 {
3667: 		return out
3668: 	}
3669: 	if binary.BigEndian.Uint32(sresp[0:4]) != 2 || binary.BigEndian.Uint32(sresp[4:8]) != txID2 {
3670: 		return out
3671: 	}
3672: 
3673: 	count := (n - 8) / 12
3674: 	for i := 0; i < count && i < len(hashes); i++ {
3675: 		off := 8 + i*12
3676: 		seeders := int(binary.BigEndian.Uint32(sresp[off : off+4]))
3677: 		leechers := int(binary.BigEndian.Uint32(sresp[off+8 : off+12]))
3678: 		out[hex.EncodeToString(hashes[i])] = [2]int{seeders, leechers}
3679: 	}
3680: 	logger.Trace("[UDP-Scrape] OK tracker=%s scraped=%d/%d latency=%dms", trackerAddr, len(out), len(hashes), time.Since(t0).Milliseconds())
3681: 	return out
3682: }
3683: 
3684: func udpScrapeBatch(results []TorrentResult, logger *SearchLogger) map[string][2]int {
3685: 	t0 := time.Now()
3686: 	merged := make(map[string][2]int)
3687: 	seen := make(map[string]bool)
3688: 	var rawHashes [][]byte
3689: 
3690: 	udpCacheMu.RLock()
3691: 	for _, r := range results {
3692: 		h := strings.ToLower(r.InfoHash)
3693: 		if len(h) == 40 && !seen[h] {
3694: 			seen[h] = true
3695: 			if cached, ok := udpSeedCache[h]; ok {
3696: 				merged[h] = cached
3697: 				continue
3698: 			}
3699: 			if b, err := hex.DecodeString(h); err == nil && len(b) == 20 {
3700: 				rawHashes = append(rawHashes, b)
3701: 			}
3702: 		}
3703: 	}
3704: 	udpCacheMu.RUnlock()
3705: 
3706: 	if len(rawHashes) == 0 {
3707: 		return merged
3708: 	}
3709: 
3710: 	var mu sync.Mutex
3711: 	var wg sync.WaitGroup
3712: 	for _, tr := range udpTrackers {
3713: 		wg.Add(1)
3714: 		go func(addr string) {
3715: 			defer wg.Done()
3716: 			res := udpScrapeSingleTracker(addr, rawHashes, logger)
3717: 			mu.Lock()
3718: 			for h, sp := range res {
3719: 				cur := merged[h]
3720: 				if sp[0] > cur[0] {
3721: 					cur[0] = sp[0]
3722: 				}
3723: 				if sp[1] > cur[1] {
3724: 					cur[1] = sp[1]
3725: 				}
3726: 				merged[h] = cur
3727: 			}
3728: 			mu.Unlock()
3729: 		}(tr)
3730: 	}
3731: 	wg.Wait()
3732: 
3733: 	udpCacheMu.Lock()
3734: 	for h, sp := range merged {
3735: 		udpSeedCache[h] = sp
3736: 	}
3737: 	udpCacheMu.Unlock()
3738: 
3739: 	logger.Simple("🔄 Функция udpScrapeBatch: опрошено %d UDP-трекеров для %d новых хэшей за %d мс -> сиды в кэше для %d раздач",
3740: 		len(udpTrackers), len(rawHashes), time.Since(t0).Milliseconds(), len(merged))
3741: 	return merged
3742: }

3750: 	for _, kw := range []string{"discography", "дискография", "collection", "коллекция", "anthology", "антология", "complete", "полное собрание", "альбомы", "albums"} {
3751: 		if strings.Contains(t, kw) {

3753: 		}

3762: func matchesFormatFilter(title, formatTag string) bool {
3763: 	tag := strings.ToLower(strings.TrimSpace(formatTag))
3764: 	if tag == "" || tag == "all" {
3765: 		return true
3766: 	}
3767: 	t := strings.ToLower(title)
3768: 	if kws, ok := formatKeywordsMap[tag]; ok {
3769: 		for _, kw := range kws {
3770: 			if strings.Contains(t, kw) {
3771: 				return true
3772: 			}
3773: 		}
3774: 		return false
3775: 	}
3776: 	return strings.Contains(t, tag)
3777: }

3779: func searchSingleVariantAcrossIndexers(ctx context.Context, variant string, cfg EngineConfig, logger *SearchLogger) []TorrentResult {
3780: 	var jobs []searchJob
3781: 	jobs = append(jobs,
3782: 		searchJob{name: "Rutor", fn: searchRutorDoH, arg: variant},
3783: 		searchJob{name: "Knaben", fn: searchKnaben, arg: variant},
3784: 		searchJob{name: "RuTracker(TorAPI)", fn: searchTorAPIRuTracker, arg: variant},
3785: 		searchJob{name: "SolidTorrents", fn: searchSolidTorrents, arg: variant},
3786: 		searchJob{name: "BitSearch", fn: searchBitsearch, arg: variant},
3787: 		searchJob{name: "ApiBay", fn: searchApiBay, arg: variant},
3788: 		searchJob{name: "Seeker(Soulseek)", fn: searchSoulseekSeeker, arg: variant},
3789: 	)
3790: 	if strings.Contains(variant, "/") {
3791: 		cleanSlash := strings.Join(strings.Fields(strings.ReplaceAll(variant, "/", " ")), " ")
3792: 		jobs = append(jobs,
3793: 			searchJob{name: "Rutor", fn: searchRutorDoH, arg: cleanSlash},
3794: 			searchJob{name: "BitSearch", fn: searchBitsearch, arg: cleanSlash},
3795: 			searchJob{name: "Knaben", fn: searchKnaben, arg: cleanSlash},
3796: 		)
3797: 	}
3798: 
3799: 	byHash := make(map[string]TorrentResult)
3800: 	var mu sync.Mutex
3801: 	var wg sync.WaitGroup
3802: 
3803: 	for _, job := range jobs {
3804: 		wg.Add(1)
3805: 		go func(j searchJob) {
3806: 			defer wg.Done()
3807: 			select {
3808: 			case outboundSem <- struct{}{}:
3809: 			case <-ctx.Done():
3810: 				return
3811: 			}
3812: 			items := j.fn(ctx, j.arg, logger)
3813: 			<-outboundSem
3814: 			if len(items) > 0 {
3815: 				top := items[0]

3817: 					j.name, j.arg, len(items), top.Title, top.Seeds)
3818: 			} else {

3820: 			}
3821: 			mu.Lock()
3822: 			for _, it := range items {
3823: 				h := strings.ToLower(it.InfoHash)
3824: 				if ex, ok := byHash[h]; !ok || it.Seeds > ex.Seeds {
3825: 					it.MatchedVia = variant
3826: 					byHash[h] = it
3827: 				}
3828: 			}
3829: 			mu.Unlock()
3830: 		}(job)
3831: 	}
3832: 	wg.Wait()
3833: 
3834: 	var out []TorrentResult
3835: 	for _, v := range byHash {
3836: 		out = append(out, v)
3837: 	}
3838: 	return out

3841: func rankAndFilter(items []TorrentResult, rawQuery, corrected string, terms []string, tracks []ResolvedTrackInfo, cfg EngineConfig, logger *SearchLogger) ([]TorrentResult, int) {
3842: 	var filtered []TorrentResult
3843: 	hiddenZero := 0
3844: 	cutFormat := 0
3845: 	cutVideo := 0
3846: 	cutLowFuzzy := 0
3847: 
3848: 	// Дедуплицируем и ограничиваем список треков/альбомов для быстрого расчёта (чтобы на лайв-волнах из 120+ раздач не умножать 120 x 80 треков)
3849: 	var compactTracks []ResolvedTrackInfo

3864: 			continue
3865: 		}

3867: 			hiddenZero++

3869: 			continue
3870: 		}

3874: 			continue

3889: 		for _, term := range terms {
3890: 			if s := computeFuzzyScore(it.Title, term); s > bestSim {
3891: 				bestSim = s
3892: 			}
3893: 			// Если исполнитель раздачи напрямую совпадает с одним из расширенных вариантов (например, "АК-47" для запроса "витя ак")
3894: 			if artistPart != "" && matchWithinTwoLettersNoSymbols(artistPart, term) {
3895: 				if 0.90 > bestSim {
3896: 					bestSim = 0.90
3897: 				}
3898: 			}
3899: 		}
3900: 
3901: 		if artistPart != "" && restPart != "" {

3903: 				restSim := math.Max(computeFuzzyScore(restPart, rawQuery), computeFuzzyScore(restPart, corrected))
3904: 				if restSim >= 0.72 {
3905: 					if restSim > bestSim {
3906: 						bestSim = restSim
3907: 					}
3908: 					it.MatchedVia = fmt.Sprintf("other_artist_song:%s — %s", artistPart, restPart)
3909: 				}
3910: 			}
3911: 		}
3912:

3918: 				strings.Contains(normalizeCompact(it.Title), normalizeCompact(tr.Artist))
3919:

3922: 					bestSim = math.Max(bestSim, 0.93)
3923: 					it.MatchedVia = fmt.Sprintf("ost_soundtrack:%s — %s", tr.Artist, tr.Track)
3924: 				}
3925: 			} else if tr.Role == "other_artist_song" || tr.Role == "catalog_candidate" {

3927: 				if s := computeFuzzyScore(it.Title, tr.Artist+" "+tr.Track); s >= 0.65 && s >= bestSim {
3928: 					bestSim = math.Max(s, 0.92)
3929: 					it.MatchedVia = fmt.Sprintf("other_artist_song:%s — %s", tr.Artist, tr.Track)
3930: 				} else if tr.Album != "" && computeFuzzyScore(it.Title, tr.Artist+" "+tr.Album) >= 0.65 {
3931: 					// 2) Совпал альбом из метаданных SoundCloud/iTunes/Deezer, в котором лежит этот трек!
3932: 					bestSim = math.Max(bestSim, 0.91)

3934: 				} else if artistMatchesTorrent {

3936: 					bestSim = math.Max(bestSim, 0.90)
3937: 					if tr.Album != "" && !strings.EqualFold(tr.Album, tr.Track) {
3938: 						it.MatchedVia = fmt.Sprintf("other_artist_song:%s (исполнитель трека «%s» / альбом «%s»)", tr.Artist, tr.Track, tr.Album)
3939: 					} else {
3940: 						it.MatchedVia = fmt.Sprintf("other_artist_song:%s (исполнитель трека «%s»)", tr.Artist, tr.Track)
3941: 					}
3942: 				}
3943: 			} else {
3944: 				if tr.Album != "" {
3945: 					if s := computeFuzzyScore(it.Title, fmt.Sprintf("%s %s", tr.Artist, tr.Album)); s > bestSim {
3946: 						bestSim = s
3947: 						it.MatchedVia = fmt.Sprintf("track->album: %s - %s", tr.Artist, tr.Album)
3948: 					}
3949: 				}
3950: 				if (isDiscographyOrCollection(it.Title) || artistMatchesTorrent) && tr.Artist != "" {
3951: 					if s := computeFuzzyScore(it.Title, tr.Artist); s > bestSim {
3952: 						bestSim = math.Max(s, 0.88)
3953: 						if !strings.HasPrefix(it.MatchedVia, "other_artist_song:") {
3954: 							it.MatchedVia = fmt.Sprintf("track->discography: %s", tr.Artist)
3955: 						}
3956: 					}
3957: 				}
3958: 			}
3959: 		}
3960: 
3961: 		// Если раздача найдена глубоким поиском ВНУТРИ треклиста/описания на Rutor (например, сборник "VA - Русский рэп", где внутри лежит трек Вити Матанги или StaFFорд63):
3962: 		if strings.HasPrefix(it.Category, "tracklist_hit:") {
3963: 			hitQ := strings.TrimPrefix(it.Category, "tracklist_hit:")
3964: 			if bestSim < 0.86 {

3971: 
3972: 		if bestSim < cfg.MinFuzzyScore && it.MatchedVia != "" && strings.Contains(strings.ToLower(it.Title), strings.ToLower(it.MatchedVia)) {
3973: 			bestSim = cfg.MinFuzzyScore + 0.05
3974: 		}
3975: 		if bestSim < cfg.MinFuzzyScore {
3976: 			cutLowFuzzy++

3978: 			continue
3979: 		}
3980: 
3981: 		it.MatchScore = bestSim

3983: 		audioBoost := 0.0

3985: 			audioBoost = 15.0
3986: 		}

3989: 			discoBoost = 18.0
3990: 		}

3992: 			discoBoost += 16.0
3993: 			if !strings.HasPrefix(it.MatchedVia, "ost_soundtrack:") {
3994: 				it.MatchedVia = "ost_soundtrack:" + it.Title
3995: 			}
3996: 		}
3997: 		it.FinalRank = it.FinalRank + bestSim*100.0 + seedBoost + audioBoost + discoBoost
3998: 		filtered = append(filtered, it)
3999: 	}

4001: 	// Если из-за включённого узкого фильтра формата (например, M4A или WAV) отрезались ВСЕ живые раздачи (len(filtered) == 0, хотя в MP3/FLAC они есть!),
4002: 	// автоматически повторяем отбор с форматом "all" и помечаем их для нижних свёрнутых списков «Возможно, вы имели в виду (в формате MP3/FLAC)»!
4003: 	if len(filtered) == 0 && cutFormat > 0 && cfg.FormatTag != "" && cfg.FormatTag != "all" {
4004: 		logger.Simple("💡 В формате «%s» раздач не нашлось (отрезано %d шт.) -> автоматически формируем подсказки из доступных аудиоформатов (FLAC/MP3)!", strings.ToUpper(cfg.FormatTag), cutFormat)
4005: 		fallbackCfg := cfg
4006: 		fallbackCfg.FormatTag = "all"
4007: 		fallbackItems, _ := rankAndFilter(items, rawQuery, corrected, terms, tracks, fallbackCfg, logger)
4008: 		for i := range fallbackItems {
4009: 			if !strings.HasPrefix(fallbackItems[i].MatchedVia, "other_artist_song:") {
4010: 				fallbackItems[i].MatchedVia = fmt.Sprintf("other_artist_song:Доступно в FLAC/MP3 (в %s не найдено)", strings.ToUpper(cfg.FormatTag))
4011: 			}
4012: 		}
4013: 		return fallbackItems, hiddenZero
4014: 	}
4015: 
4016: 	sort.Slice(filtered, func(i, j int) bool {
4017: 		return filtered[i].FinalRank > filtered[j].FinalRank
4018: 	})

4021: 		len(items), hiddenZero, cutVideo, cutFormat, cfg.MinFuzzyScore, cutLowFuzzy, len(filtered))
4022: 	return filtered, hiddenZero

4206: func executeOmniSearchWithConfig(rawQuery string, cfg EngineConfig) SearchResponse {
4207: 	start := time.Now()
4208: 	if cfg.TimeoutMs < 25000 {
4209: 		cfg.TimeoutMs = 25000
4210: 	}
4211: 	logger := newSearchLogger(rawQuery, cfg)
4212: 	defer logger.Flush()

4214: 	ctx, cancel := context.WithTimeout(context.Background(), time.Duration(cfg.TimeoutMs)*time.Millisecond)
4215: 	defer cancel()
4216: 
4217: 	catCtx, catCancel := context.WithTimeout(context.Background(), 5000*time.Millisecond)
4218: 	terms, corrected, tracks := buildExpandedQueries(catCtx, rawQuery, cfg, logger)
4219: 	catCancel()
4220: 
4221: 	groupResults := make([][]TorrentResult, len(terms))
4222: 	var wg sync.WaitGroup
4223: 	for i, term := range terms {
4224: 		wg.Add(1)
4225: 		go func(idx int, t string) {
4226: 			defer wg.Done()
4227: 			groupResults[idx] = searchSingleVariantAcrossIndexers(ctx, t, cfg, logger)

4231:

4236: 	for idx, grp := range groupResults {

4239: 		}
4240: 		tName := terms[idx]
4241: 		totalCnt, liveCnt, discoCnt := len(grp), 0, 0
4242: 		for _, it := range grp {
4243: 			if it.Seeds > 0 {
4244: 				liveCnt++
4245: 			}
4246: 			if isDiscographyOrCollection(it.Title) {
4247: 				discoCnt++
4248: 			}
4249: 		}
4250: 		// Ступенчатый бонус для 20 слотов: 1-е место (SoundCloud) получает +24.0, далее плавно убывает по ступеням
4251: 		stepPriorityBonus := float64(20-idx) * 1.2
4252: 		if stepPriorityBonus < 0 {
4253: 			stepPriorityBonus = 0
4254: 		}
4255: 		power := float64(totalCnt)*1.5 + float64(liveCnt)*3.0 + float64(discoCnt)*20.0 + stepPriorityBonus*2.0
4256: 		bonus := math.Log1p(float64(liveCnt))*10.0 + float64(discoCnt)*8.0 + stepPriorityBonus
4257: 		if bonus > 75.0 {
4258: 			bonus = 75.0
4259: 		}
4260: 		variantBonus[tName] = bonus
4261: 		if totalCnt > 0 {
4262: 			logger.Simple("📊 Вариант #%d «%s»: найдено %d раздач (живых: %d, дискографий: %d) -> бонус приоритета +%.1f", idx+1, tName, totalCnt, liveCnt, discoCnt, bonus)
4263: 		}
4264: 		if power > bestPower && totalCnt > 0 && matchWithinTwoLettersNoSymbols(tName, rawQuery) {
4265: 			bestPower = power
4266: 			bestVariantName = tName
4267: 		}
4268: 	}
4269: 	if bestVariantName != "" && bestVariantName != corrected {
4270: 		logger.Simple("👑 Лидер по объёму находок: вариант «%s» обошёл «%s» и стал основным исполнителем!", bestVariantName, corrected)
4271: 		corrected = bestVariantName
4272: 	}
4273: 	for _, grp := range groupResults {
4274: 		for _, it := range grp {
4275: 			it.FinalRank = variantBonus[it.MatchedVia]
4276: 			if ex, ok := mergedMap[it.InfoHash]; !ok || it.Seeds > ex.Seeds || it.FinalRank > ex.FinalRank {
4277: 				mergedMap[it.InfoHash] = it
4278: 			}
4279: 		}
4280: 	}
4281: 
4282: 	var allItems []TorrentResult
4283: 	for _, it := range mergedMap {
4284: 		allItems = append(allItems, it)
4285: 	}
4286: 
4287: 	if cfg.EnableUDP && len(allItems) > 0 {
4288: 		scraped := udpScrapeBatch(allItems, logger)
4289: 		for i := range allItems {
4290: 			if sp, ok := scraped[allItems[i].InfoHash]; ok {
4291: 				if sp[0] > allItems[i].Seeds {
4292: 					allItems[i].Seeds = sp[0]
4293: 				}
4294: 				if sp[1] > allItems[i].Peers {
4295: 					allItems[i].Peers = sp[1]
4296: 				}
4297: 			}
4298: 		}
4299: 	}
4300: 
4301: 	ranked, hiddenZero := rankAndFilter(allItems, rawQuery, corrected, terms, tracks, cfg, logger)
4302: 	groups := buildSmartCategoryGroups(ranked, rawQuery, corrected, terms, tracks, logger)
4303: 
4304: 	elapsed := time.Since(start).Milliseconds()
4305: 	logger.Simple("✅ Поиск завершён за %d мс: всего выдано %d раздач в %d категориях", elapsed, len(ranked), len(groups))
4306: 
4307: 	return SearchResponse{
4308: 		Status:         "ok",
4309: 		OriginalQuery:  rawQuery,
4310: 		CorrectedQuery: corrected,
4311: 		ResolvedTracks: tracks,
4312: 		ExpandedTerms:  terms,
4313: 		ElapsedMs:      elapsed,
4314: 		TotalFound:     len(ranked),
4315: 		HiddenZero:     hiddenZero,
4316: 		Groups:         groups,
4317: 		Results:        ranked,
4318: 	}
4319: }

4345: func buildMagnet(infoHash, title string) string {
4346: 	var trBuilder strings.Builder
4347: 	for _, tr := range udpTrackers {
4348: 		trBuilder.WriteString("&tr=")
4349: 		trBuilder.WriteString(url.QueryEscape("udp://" + tr + "/announce"))
4350: 	}
4351: 	return fmt.Sprintf("magnet:?xt=urn:btih:%s&dn=%s%s", infoHash, url.QueryEscape(title), trBuilder.String())
4352: }

4354: func formatBytes(b int64) string {
4355: 	if b <= 0 {
4356: 		return "0 MB"
4357: 	}
4358: 	if b < 1024 {
4359: 		return fmt.Sprintf("%d B", b)
4360: 	}
4361: 	const unit = 1024
4362: 	div, exp := int64(unit), 0
4363: 	for n := b / unit; n >= unit; n /= unit {
4364: 		div *= unit
4365: 		exp++
4366: 	}
4367: 	return fmt.Sprintf("%.1f %cB", float64(b)/float64(div), "KMGTPE"[exp])
4368: }

4370: func parseBoolParam(val string, def bool) bool {
4371: 	val = strings.TrimSpace(strings.ToLower(val))
4372: 	switch val {
4373: 	case "1", "true", "yes", "on":
4374: 		return true
4375: 	case "0", "false", "no", "off":
4376: 		return false
4377: 	default:
4378: 		return def
4379: 	}
4380: }

4489: type LiveWaveSession struct {
4490: 	mu        sync.RWMutex
4491: 	id        string
4492: 	startTime time.Time
4493: 	cancel    context.CancelFunc
4494: 	snap      LiveWaveSnapshot
4495: }
4496: 
4497: var (
4498: 	liveSessionsMu sync.RWMutex
4499: 	liveSessions   = make(map[string]*LiveWaveSession)
4500: 	latestLiveID   string
4501: )
4502: 
4503: // startLiveWaveSession мгновенно создаёт неблокирующую фоновую сессию поиска по 20 слотам,
4504: // обновляя снапшот на каждой волне и сбрасывая лог в реальном времени (logger.Flush())
4505: func startLiveWaveSession(rawQuery string, cfg EngineConfig) string {
4506: 	if cfg.TimeoutMs < 25000 {
4507: 		cfg.TimeoutMs = 25000
4508: 	}
4509: 	now := time.Now()
4510: 	searchID := fmt.Sprintf("lw-%d-%03d", now.Unix(), rand.Intn(1000))
4511: 	ctx, cancel := context.WithTimeout(context.Background(), time.Duration(cfg.TimeoutMs)*time.Millisecond)
4512: 
4513: 	sess := &LiveWaveSession{
4514: 		id:        searchID,
4515: 		startTime: now,
4516: 		cancel:    cancel,
4517: 		snap: LiveWaveSnapshot{
4518: 			Status:         "ok",
4519: 			SearchID:       searchID,
4520: 			Wave:           0,
4521: 			Done:           false,
4522: 			InProgress:     true,
4523: 			TotalSteps:     20,
4524: 			CompletedSteps: 0,
4525: 			ElapsedMs:      0,
4526: 			OriginalQuery:  rawQuery,
4527: 			CorrectedQuery: rawQuery,
4528: 			ExpandedTerms:  []string{rawQuery},
4529: 			Groups:         []VariantGroup{},
4530: 			Results:        []TorrentResult{},
4531: 		},
4532: 	}
4533: 
4534: 	liveSessionsMu.Lock()
4535: 	// Очищаем старые сессии старше 5 минут, чтобы не раздувать память
4536: 	for k, old := range liveSessions {
4537: 		if time.Since(old.startTime) > 5*time.Minute {
4538: 			if old.cancel != nil {
4539: 				old.cancel()
4540: 			}
4541: 			delete(liveSessions, k)
4542: 		}
4543: 	}
4544: 	liveSessions[searchID] = sess
4545: 	latestLiveID = searchID
4546: 	liveSessionsMu.Unlock()
4547: 
4548: 	go runLiveWavePipeline(ctx, sess, rawQuery, cfg)
4549: 	return searchID
4550: }
4551: 
4552: func runLiveWavePipeline(ctx context.Context, sess *LiveWaveSession, rawQuery string, cfg EngineConfig) {
4553: 	defer sess.cancel()
4554: 	logger := newSearchLogger(rawQuery, cfg)
4555: 	defer logger.Flush()
4556: 
4557: 	// Сразу сбрасываем шапку лога на диск, чтобы по кнопке «👁️ Simple» было видно старт поиска
4558: 	logger.Flush()
4559: 
4560: 	// Волна 1: Ступенчатое расширение до 20 слотов (SoundCloud + Google Suggest + MusicBrainz + iTunes/Deezer + Фонетика)
4561: 	catCtx, catCancel := context.WithTimeout(ctx, 5000*time.Millisecond)
4562: 	terms, corrected, tracks := buildExpandedQueries(catCtx, rawQuery, cfg, logger)
4563: 	catCancel()
4564: 	if len(terms) == 0 {
4565: 		terms = []string{rawQuery}
4566: 	}
4567: 	logger.Flush()
4568: 
4569: 	totalSlots := len(terms)
4570: 	sess.mu.Lock()
4571: 	sess.snap.Wave = 1
4572: 	sess.snap.TotalSteps = totalSlots
4573: 	sess.snap.CorrectedQuery = corrected
4574: 	sess.snap.ExpandedTerms = terms
4575: 	sess.snap.ResolvedTracks = tracks
4576: 	sess.snap.ElapsedMs = time.Since(sess.startTime).Milliseconds()
4577: 	sess.mu.Unlock()
4578: 
4579: 	type slotWaveResult struct {
4580: 		slotIdx int
4581: 		term    string
4582: 		items   []TorrentResult
4583: 	}
4584: 	waveCh := make(chan slotWaveResult, totalSlots)
4585: 
4586: 	var wg sync.WaitGroup
4587: 	for i, term := range terms {
4588: 		wg.Add(1)
4589: 		go func(idx int, t string) {
4590: 			defer wg.Done()
4591: 			items := searchSingleVariantAcrossIndexers(ctx, t, cfg, logger)
4592: 			waveCh <- slotWaveResult{slotIdx: idx, term: t, items: items}
4593: 		}(i, term)
4594: 	}
4595: 
4596: 	go func() {
4597: 		wg.Wait()
4598: 		close(waveCh)
4599: 	}()
4600: 
4601: 	groupResults := make([][]TorrentResult, totalSlots)
4602: 	completedSlots := 0
4603: 	waveNum := 1
4604: 
4605: 	rebuildSnapshot := func(isFinal bool) {
4606: 		mergedMap := make(map[string]TorrentResult)
4607: 		variantBonus := make(map[string]float64)
4608: 		bestPower := -1.0
4609: 		bestVariantName := ""
4610: 
4611: 		for idx, grp := range groupResults {
4612: 			if len(grp) == 0 {
4613: 				continue
4614: 			}
4615: 			tName := terms[idx]
4616: 			totalCnt, liveCnt, discoCnt := len(grp), 0, 0
4617: 			for _, it := range grp {
4618: 				if it.Seeds > 0 {
4619: 					liveCnt++
4620: 				}
4621: 				if isDiscographyOrCollection(it.Title) {
4622: 					discoCnt++
4623: 				}
4624: 			}
4625: 			stepPriorityBonus := float64(20-idx) * 1.2
4626: 			if stepPriorityBonus < 0 {
4627: 				stepPriorityBonus = 0
4628: 			}
4629: 			power := float64(totalCnt)*1.5 + float64(liveCnt)*3.0 + float64(discoCnt)*20.0 + stepPriorityBonus*2.0
4630: 			bonus := math.Log1p(float64(liveCnt))*10.0 + float64(discoCnt)*8.0 + stepPriorityBonus
4631: 			if bonus > 75.0 {
4632: 				bonus = 75.0
4633: 			}
4634: 			variantBonus[tName] = bonus
4635: 			if isFinal && totalCnt > 0 {
4636: 				logger.Simple("📊 Вариант #%d «%s»: найдено %d раздач (живых: %d, дискографий: %d) -> бонус приоритета +%.1f", idx+1, tName, totalCnt, liveCnt, discoCnt, bonus)
4637: 			}
4638: 			if power > bestPower && totalCnt > 0 && matchWithinTwoLettersNoSymbols(tName, rawQuery) {
4639: 				bestPower = power
4640: 				bestVariantName = tName
4641: 			}
4642: 		}
4643: 
4644: 		curCorrected := corrected
4645: 		if bestVariantName != "" && bestVariantName != curCorrected {
4646: 			curCorrected = bestVariantName
4647: 		}
4648: 
4649: 		for _, grp := range groupResults {
4650: 			for _, it := range grp {
4651: 				it.FinalRank = variantBonus[it.MatchedVia]
4652: 				if ex, ok := mergedMap[it.InfoHash]; !ok || it.Seeds > ex.Seeds || it.FinalRank > ex.FinalRank {
4653: 					mergedMap[it.InfoHash] = it
4654: 				}
4655: 			}
4656: 		}
4657: 
4658: 		var allItems []TorrentResult
4659: 		for _, it := range mergedMap {
4660: 			allItems = append(allItems, it)
4661: 		}
4662: 
4663: 		// На промежуточных волнах берём уже закэшированные UDP-сиды мгновенно (0 мс),
4664: 		// а полный сетевой UDP-скрейп новых хэшей запускаем асинхронно или на финальной волне, чтобы /search_poll отвечал за < 2 мс!
4665: 		if cfg.EnableUDP && len(allItems) > 0 {
4666: 			if isFinal {
4667: 				scraped := udpScrapeBatch(allItems, logger)
4668: 				for i := range allItems {
4669: 					if sp, ok := scraped[allItems[i].InfoHash]; ok {
4670: 						if sp[0] > allItems[i].Seeds {
4671: 							allItems[i].Seeds = sp[0]
4672: 						}
4673: 						if sp[1] > allItems[i].Peers {
4674: 							allItems[i].Peers = sp[1]
4675: 						}
4676: 					}
4677: 				}
4678: 			} else {
4679: 				udpCacheMu.RLock()
4680: 				for i := range allItems {
4681: 					if sp, ok := udpSeedCache[strings.ToLower(allItems[i].InfoHash)]; ok {
4682: 						if sp[0] > allItems[i].Seeds {
4683: 							allItems[i].Seeds = sp[0]
4684: 						}
4685: 						if sp[1] > allItems[i].Peers {
4686: 							allItems[i].Peers = sp[1]
4687: 						}
4688: 					}
4689: 				}
4690: 				udpCacheMu.RUnlock()
4691: 				// Запускаем фоновый прогрев UDP-кэша для новых хэшей без блокировки волны
4692: 				itemsCopy := make([]TorrentResult, len(allItems))
4693: 				copy(itemsCopy, allItems)
4694: 				go func() {
4695: 					_ = udpScrapeBatch(itemsCopy, nil)
4696: 				}()
4697: 			}
4698: 		}
4699: 
4700: 		var stepLogger *SearchLogger
4701: 		if isFinal {
4702: 			stepLogger = logger
4703: 		}
4704: 		ranked, hiddenZero := rankAndFilter(allItems, rawQuery, curCorrected, terms, tracks, cfg, stepLogger)
4705: 		groups := buildSmartCategoryGroups(ranked, rawQuery, curCorrected, terms, tracks, stepLogger)
4706: 		if groups == nil {
4707: 			groups = []VariantGroup{}
4708: 		}
4709: 		if ranked == nil {
4710: 			ranked = []TorrentResult{}
4711: 		}
4712: 
4713: 		waveNum++
4714: 		elapsed := time.Since(sess.startTime).Milliseconds()
4715: 		if isFinal {
4716: 			logger.Simple("✅ Live Wave завершён (волна v%d) за %d мс: всего выдано %d раздач в %d категориях", waveNum, elapsed, len(ranked), len(groups))
4717: 		} else {
4718: 			logger.Simple("🌊 Волна v%d (%d/%d слотов, +%d мс): в выдаче %d раздач (%d категорий)", waveNum, completedSlots, totalSlots, elapsed, len(ranked), len(groups))
4719: 		}
4720: 		// Инкрементальный сброс лога на каждой волне!
4721: 		logger.Flush()
4722: 
4723: 		sess.mu.Lock()
4724: 		sess.snap = LiveWaveSnapshot{
4725: 			Status:         "ok",
4726: 			SearchID:       sess.id,
4727: 			Wave:           waveNum,
4728: 			Done:           isFinal,
4729: 			InProgress:     !isFinal,
4730: 			TotalSteps:     totalSlots,
4731: 			CompletedSteps: completedSlots,
4732: 			ElapsedMs:      elapsed,
4733: 			OriginalQuery:  rawQuery,
4734: 			CorrectedQuery: curCorrected,
4735: 			ExpandedTerms:  terms,
4736: 			ResolvedTracks: tracks,
4737: 			TotalFound:     len(ranked),
4738: 			HiddenZero:     hiddenZero,
4739: 			Groups:         groups,
4740: 			Results:        ranked,
4741: 		}
4742: 		sess.mu.Unlock()
4743: 	}
4744: 
4745: 	for wRes := range waveCh {
4746: 		groupResults[wRes.slotIdx] = wRes.items
4747: 		completedSlots++
4748: 		// Если завершён очередной слот и нашлись новые раздачи (или это последний слот), обновляем снапшот
4749: 		if len(wRes.items) > 0 && completedSlots < totalSlots {
4750: 			rebuildSnapshot(false)
4751: 		} else {
4752: 			logger.Flush()
4753: 			sess.mu.Lock()
4754: 			sess.snap.CompletedSteps = completedSlots
4755: 			sess.snap.ElapsedMs = time.Since(sess.startTime).Milliseconds()
4756: 			sess.mu.Unlock()
4757: 		}
4758: 	}
4759: 
4760: 	// Финальная сборка с полным UDP-скрейпом и итоговым логом
4761: 	rebuildSnapshot(true)
4762: }

4764: func parseRequestQueryAndConfig(r *http.Request) (string, EngineConfig) {
4765: 	configMu.RLock()
4766: 	cfg := defaultConfig
4767: 	configMu.RUnlock()
4768: 
4769: 	q := strings.TrimSpace(r.URL.Query().Get("q"))
4770: 	if q == "" {
4771: 		q = strings.TrimSpace(r.URL.Query().Get("query"))
4772: 	}
4773: 	applyQueryOverrides(r.URL.Query(), &cfg)
4774: 
4775: 	if r.Method == http.MethodPost {
4776: 		if body, err := io.ReadAll(r.Body); err == nil && len(body) > 0 {
4777: 			var reqBody struct {
4778: 				Q     string `json:"q"`
4779: 				Query string `json:"query"`
4780: 				EngineConfig
4781: 			}
4782: 			reqBody.EngineConfig = cfg
4783: 			if json.Unmarshal(body, &reqBody) == nil {
4784: 				if reqBody.Query == "" {
4785: 					reqBody.Query = reqBody.Q
4786: 				}
4787: 				if reqBody.Query != "" {
4788: 					q = reqBody.Query
4789: 				}
4790: 				cfg = reqBody.EngineConfig
4791: 			}
4792: 			// Повторно применяем URL-параметры поверх JSON body, если они переданы явно в строке запроса
4793: 			applyQueryOverrides(r.URL.Query(), &cfg)
4794: 		}
4795: 	}
4796: 	return q, cfg
4797: }

112: def build_atempo_filter(speed):
113:     speed = max(0.05, min(float(speed), 100.0))
114:     filters = []
115:     while speed > 2.0:
116:         filters.append("atempo=2.0")
117:         speed /= 2.0
118:     while speed < 0.5:
119:         filters.append("atempo=0.5")
120:         speed /= 0.5
121:     filters.append(f"atempo={speed:.6f}")
122:     return ",".join(filters)

146: def _jenny_crypt_stream_v78(data: bytes, password: str = "") -> bytes:
147:     key_seed = ("JENNY_V78_SECRET::" + (password or "").strip()).encode("utf-8")
148:     key = hashlib.pbkdf2_hmac("sha512", key_seed, b"JENNYV67_SALT_2026", 10000, dklen=64)
149:     out = bytearray(len(data))
150:     blocks = (len(data) + 63) // 64
151:     stream = bytearray()
152:     for blk in range(blocks):
153:         stream.extend(hashlib.sha512(key + struct.pack("<I", blk)).digest())
154:     for i in range(len(data)):
155:         out[i] = data[i] ^ stream[i]
156:     return bytes(out)

249: def _strip_jrev_trailer_from_bytes_v88(xfc_bytes: bytes) -> bytes:
250:     if len(xfc_bytes) > JENNY_REV_FOOTER_SIZE + 25:
251:         try:
252:             footer = xfc_bytes[-JENNY_REV_FOOTER_SIZE:]
253:             head_magic, ver, m_len, p_len, tail_magic = struct.unpack(JENNY_REV_FOOTER_FMT, footer)
254:             if head_magic == b'JREV' and tail_magic == b'JENNYV67':
255:                 cut_pos = len(xfc_bytes) - JENNY_REV_FOOTER_SIZE - int(m_len) - int(p_len)
256:                 if cut_pos > 25:
257:                     return xfc_bytes[:cut_pos]
258:         except Exception:
259:             pass
260:     rev_off = xfc_bytes.rfind(b'JREV')
261:     if rev_off > 0 and len(xfc_bytes) - rev_off >= JENNY_REV_FOOTER_SIZE and len(xfc_bytes) - rev_off <= 64:
262:         try:
263:             head_magic, ver, m_len, p_len, tail_magic = struct.unpack(
264:                 JENNY_REV_FOOTER_FMT, xfc_bytes[rev_off:rev_off + JENNY_REV_FOOTER_SIZE]
265:             )
266:             if head_magic == b'JREV' and tail_magic == b'JENNYV67':
267:                 cut_pos = rev_off - int(m_len) - int(p_len)
268:                 if cut_pos > 25:
269:                     return xfc_bytes[:cut_pos]
270:         except Exception:
271:             pass
272:     return xfc_bytes

275: def _encode_wav_to_xflac_bytes_v85(wav_bytes: bytes, mode: int) -> bytes:
276:     lib = _get_xflac_lib_v84()
277:     if not lib:
278:         raise RuntimeError("libxflac.so не загружена (проверьте сборку NDK arm64-v8a)")

296:     lib = _get_xflac_lib_v84()

415: def _sanitize_canonical_wav_file_v159(wav_path: str):
416:     """Приводит любой WAV (включая WAVE_FORMAT_EXTENSIBLE 0xFFFE от FFmpeg) к строгому 44-байтному каноническому заголовку RIFF WAVE,
417:     чтобы исключить заикания и ошибки чтения частоты/битности/длительности при ручной смене параметров."""
418:     try:
419:         if not os.path.isfile(wav_path):
420:             return
421:         with open(wav_path, 'rb') as f:
422:             hdr = f.read(4096)
423:             if len(hdr) < 44 or hdr[:4] != b'RIFF' or hdr[8:12] != b'WAVE':
424:                 return
425:             pos = 12
426:             ftag = 1
427:             ch = 2
428:             sr = 44100
429:             bits = 16
430:             data_off = -1
431:             data_sz = 0
432:             while pos + 8 <= len(hdr):
433:                 cid = hdr[pos:pos+4]
434:                 csz = struct.unpack('<I', hdr[pos+4:pos+8])[0]
435:                 if cid == b'fmt ' and pos + 24 <= len(hdr):
436:                     ftag, ch, sr, _, _, bits = struct.unpack('<HHIIHH', hdr[pos+8:pos+24])
437:                     if ftag == 0xFFFE and csz >= 40 and pos + 8 + 26 <= len(hdr):
438:                         ftag = struct.unpack('<H', hdr[pos+32:pos+34])[0]
439:                 elif cid == b'data':
440:                     data_off = pos + 8
441:                     data_sz = csz
442:                     break
443:                 pos += 8 + csz + (csz & 1)
444:             if data_off == -1:
445:                 return
446:             f.seek(0, os.SEEK_END)
447:             total_file_sz = f.tell()
448:             real_pcm_bytes = max(0, total_file_sz - data_off)
449:             if data_sz <= 0 or data_sz > real_pcm_bytes or data_off != 44 or ftag not in (1, 3):
450:                 pass
451:             if ch not in (1, 2):
452:                 ch = 2
453:             if bits not in (16, 24, 32):
454:                 bits = 16
455:             if sr < 8000 or sr > 384000:
456:                 sr = 44100
457:             clean_ftag = 3 if (bits == 32 and ftag == 3) else 1
458:             bps = bits // 8
459:             frame_align = ch * bps
460:             real_pcm_bytes = (real_pcm_bytes // frame_align) * frame_align
461:             byte_rate = sr * frame_align
462:             # Если заголовок уже 44-байтный канонический и все поля совпадают — ничего не перезаписываем
463:             if data_off == 44 and ftag == clean_ftag and data_sz == real_pcm_bytes:
464:                 cur_br, cur_ba = struct.unpack('<IH', hdr[28:34])
465:                 if cur_br == byte_rate and cur_ba == frame_align:
466:                     return
467:             f.seek(data_off)
468:             pcm_payload = f.read(real_pcm_bytes)
469:         new_hdr = struct.pack(
470:             '<4sI4s4sIHHIIHH4sI',
471:             b'RIFF', 36 + len(pcm_payload), b'WAVE',
472:             b'fmt ', 16, clean_ftag, ch, sr, byte_rate, frame_align, bits,
473:             b'data', len(pcm_payload)
474:         )
475:         with open(wav_path, 'wb') as wf:
476:             wf.write(new_hdr)
477:             wf.write(pcm_payload)
478:     except Exception:
479:         pass

481: def _extract_wav_meta_from_raw_hdr_v157(raw_hdr: bytes, flags: int = 0):
482:     sr = 44100
483:     bits = 24 if (flags & 8) else (32 if (flags & 16) else 16)
484:     ch = 1 if (flags & 4) else 2
485:     if len(raw_hdr) >= 44 and raw_hdr[16:20] == b'RIFF':
486:         fmt_idx = raw_hdr.find(b'fmt ', 20, min(len(raw_hdr), 512))
487:         if fmt_idx != -1 and fmt_idx + 24 <= len(raw_hdr):
488:             cand_ch = struct.unpack('<H', raw_hdr[fmt_idx + 10:fmt_idx + 12])[0]
489:             cand_sr = struct.unpack('<I', raw_hdr[fmt_idx + 12:fmt_idx + 16])[0]
490:             cand_bits = struct.unpack('<H', raw_hdr[fmt_idx + 22:fmt_idx + 24])[0]
491:             if cand_ch in (1, 2):
492:                 ch = int(cand_ch)
493:             if 8000 <= cand_sr <= 384000:
494:                 sr = int(cand_sr)
495:             if cand_bits in (16, 24, 32):
496:                 bits = int(cand_bits)
497:     return sr, bits, ch

601: def _pack_heavy_pocket_v78(raw_opus: bytes, password: str = "") -> bytes:
602:     comp = lzma.compress(raw_opus, format=lzma.FORMAT_XZ, preset=9 | lzma.PRESET_EXTREME)
603:     enc = _jenny_crypt_stream_v78(comp, password)
604:     return b"JLZ8" + enc

606: def _jenny_crypt_stream_sha256_compat(data: bytes, password: str = "") -> bytes:
607:     key_seed = ("JENNY_V78_SECRET::" + (password or "").strip()).encode("utf-8")
608:     key = hashlib.pbkdf2_hmac("sha256", key_seed, b"JENNYV67_SALT_2026", 10000, dklen=32)
609:     out = bytearray(len(data))
610:     blocks = (len(data) + 31) // 32
611:     stream = bytearray()
612:     for blk in range(blocks):
613:         stream.extend(hashlib.sha256(key + struct.pack("<I", blk)).digest())
614:     for i in range(len(data)):
615:         out[i] = data[i] ^ stream[i]
616:     return bytes(out)

618: def _unpack_heavy_pocket_v78(masked: bytes, password: str = "") -> bytes:
619:     if masked.startswith(b"JXF8"):
620:         return _unpack_xflac_pocket_v84(masked[4:], password)
621:     if masked.startswith(b"JLZ8"):
622:         try:
623:             dec = _jenny_crypt_stream_v78(masked[4:], password)
624:             return lzma.decompress(dec)
625:         except Exception:
626:             dec256 = _jenny_crypt_stream_sha256_compat(masked[4:], password)
627:             return lzma.decompress(dec256)
628:     try:
629:         return zlib.decompress(bytes(b ^ 0xA5 for b in masked))
630:     except Exception:
631:         return bytes(b ^ 0xA5 for b in masked)

633: JENNY_REV_FOOTER_FMT = '<4sIII8s'
634: JENNY_REV_FOOTER_SIZE = 24  # struct.calcsize('<4sIII8s')

637: def read_jenny_rev_trailer(file_path):
638:     """Проверяет наличие капсулы восстановления JENNYV67 в конце .opus файла."""
639:     try:
640:         if not os.path.isfile(file_path):
641:             return None
642:         fsize = os.path.getsize(file_path)
643:         if fsize <= JENNY_REV_FOOTER_SIZE + 64:
644:             return None
645:         with open(file_path, 'rb') as f:
646:             f.seek(fsize - JENNY_REV_FOOTER_SIZE)
647:             footer = f.read(JENNY_REV_FOOTER_SIZE)
648:             head_magic, ver, map_len, pocket_len, tail_magic = struct.unpack(JENNY_REV_FOOTER_FMT, footer)
649:             if head_magic != b'JREV' or tail_magic != b'JENNYV67':
650:                 return None
651:             total_trailer = map_len + pocket_len + JENNY_REV_FOOTER_SIZE
652:             if total_trailer >= fsize:
653:                 return None
654:             audio_end = fsize - total_trailer
655:             return {
656:                 "version": ver,

694: def parse_all_ffmpeg_tags_v74(raw_info):
695:     tags = {}
696:     in_m = False
697:     for line in raw_info.splitlines():
698:         if re.match(r"^\s*Metadata:\s*$", line):
699:             in_m = True
700:             continue
701:         if in_m:
702:             if re.match(r"^\s*(Duration:|Stream #|Chapter #|Output #|Input #)", line):
703:                 in_m = False
704:                 continue
705:             m = re.match(r"^\s*([^:=\s][^:=]{0,48}?)\s*:\s*(.+)$", line)
706:             if m:
707:                 k = m.group(1).strip().upper()
708:                 v = m.group(2).strip()
709:                 if k not in ('DURATION', 'BPS', 'NUMBER_OF_FRAMES', 'NUMBER_OF_BYTES') and not k.startswith('_STATISTICS'):
710:                     tags[k] = v
711:     return tags

713: def get_merged_track_tags_v74(filename, raw_info=None):
714:     tags = {}
715:     if raw_info:
716:         tags.update(parse_all_ffmpeg_tags_v74(raw_info))
717:     db = load_custom_tags_db_v74()
718:     if filename in db and isinstance(db[filename], dict):
719:         # Если пользователь сохранял свои теги для этого трека — они имеют высший приоритет
720:         saved_dict = db[filename]
721:         enc_backup = tags.get('ENCODER')
722:         tags = {str(k).strip().upper(): str(v).strip() for k, v in saved_dict.items() if str(k).strip() and str(v).strip()}
723:         if enc_backup and 'ENCODER' not in tags:
724:             tags['ENCODER'] = enc_backup
725:     return tags

784: def quick_parse_artist_album_v71(filename, full_p):
785:     st_mtime, st_size = 0, 0
786:     try:
787:         st = os.stat(full_p)
788:         st_mtime, st_size = st.st_mtime, st.st_size
789:     except Exception:
790:         pass
791:     db_tags = load_custom_tags_db_v74().get(filename, {})
792:     cached = TRACK_META_CACHE_V71.get(full_p)
793:     if cached and cached.get("mtime") == round(st_mtime, 2) and cached.get("size") == st_size and cached.get("user_tags") == db_tags:
794:         return cached
795:     stem = os.path.splitext(filename)[0]
796:     clean_stem = re.sub(r'(?:_x\d+(?:[.,]\d+)?(?:_[a-z0-9]+)*|_(?:slow|fast)(?:_[a-z0-9]+)*|_(?:jbuf90|jbuf_shift|jbuf|web_lock|web_shift|webapi|vinyl|neutral|pitchlock|bitperfect|psycho|ultra|hifi|restored)|_rev(?:ersed)?)+$', '', stem, flags=re.I)
797:     artist = "Разные артисты"
798:     album = os.path.basename(os.path.dirname(full_p)) or "Music"
799:     parts = re.split(r'\s+[-–—]\s+', clean_stem)
800:     if len(parts) >= 2 and parts[0].strip():
801:         artist = parts[0].strip()
802:         if len(parts) >= 3 and parts[1].strip():
803:             album = parts[1].strip()
804:     if isinstance(db_tags, dict):
805:         if db_tags.get("ARTIST"):
806:             artist = str(db_tags["ARTIST"]).strip()
807:         if db_tags.get("ALBUM"):
808:             album = str(db_tags["ALBUM"]).strip()
809:     custom_only = {}
810:     if isinstance(db_tags, dict):
811:         for tk, tv in db_tags.items():
812:             tku = str(tk).strip().upper()
813:             if tku not in STANDARD_TAG_KEYS_V74 and str(tv).strip():
814:                 custom_only[str(tk).strip()] = str(tv).strip()
815:     ext = os.path.splitext(filename)[1].lower()
816:     kbps = 128.0 if ext in ('.opus', '.ogg', '.m4a', '.aac') else (320.0 if ext == '.mp3' else 900.0)
817:     est_dur = round(max(1.0, (st_size * 8.0) / (kbps * 1000.0)), 1)

819:         xf_dur, _ = _get_xflac_fast_header_info_v87(full_p)

915: @post('/api/save_meta_v71')
916: def save_track_meta_v71():
917:     t_in, t_out = None, None
918:     try:
919:         req = json.loads(request.body.read().decode('utf-8'))
920:         fn = req.get('filename', '').strip()
921:         new_fn = req.get('new_filename', fn).strip() or fn
922:         tags = req.get('tags', {})
923:         rev_act = req.get('rev_action', 'keep')
924:         rev_upd = req.get('rev_updates', {})
925:         fp = resolve_track_full_path_v71(fn)
926:         if not fn or not os.path.isfile(fp):
927:             response.status = 404
928:             return {"status": "error", "error": "Файл не найден"}
929:         fdir, ext = os.path.dirname(fp), os.path.splitext(fn)[1]
930:         if not os.path.splitext(new_fn)[1]:
931:             new_fn += ext
932: 
933:         # 1. Сохраняем все теги (включая русские и кастомные, например "член: профсоюза") в базу jenny_custom_tags.json
934:         clean_tags = {}
935:         if isinstance(tags, dict):
936:             for k, v in tags.items():
937:                 ks, vs = str(k).strip().upper(), str(v).strip()
938:                 if ks and vs:
939:                     clean_tags[ks] = vs
940:         db = load_custom_tags_db_v74()
941:         if fn in db and fn != new_fn:
942:             db.pop(fn, None)
943:         db[new_fn] = clean_tags
944:         save_custom_tags_db_v74(db)
945: 
946:         # 2. Записываем метаданные и в сам аудиофайл (и в контейнер, и в аудиопоток -metadata:s:a:0)
947:         tr = read_jenny_rev_trailer(fp)
948:         m_zlib, p_mask, sm_obj = b"", b"", None
949:         if tr:
950:             with open(fp, 'rb') as rf:
951:                 rf.seek(tr["map_offset"]); m_zlib = rf.read(tr["map_len"])
952:                 if tr["pocket_len"] > 0:
953:                     rf.seek(tr["pocket_offset"]); p_mask = rf.read(tr["pocket_len"])
954:             try:
955:                 sm_obj = json.loads(zlib.decompress(m_zlib).decode('utf-8'))
956:             except Exception:
957:                 pass
958:         t_in = os.path.join(fdir, f"temp_meta_in_{os.getpid()}{ext}")
959:         t_out = os.path.join(fdir, f"temp_meta_out_{os.getpid()}{ext}")
960:         with open(fp, 'rb') as sf, open(t_in, 'wb') as df:
961:             if tr:
962:                 df.write(sf.read(tr["audio_end"]))
963:             else:
964:                 shutil.copyfileobj(sf, df)
965:         if ext.lower() == '.xflac':
966:             shutil.copyfile(t_in, t_out)
967:         else:
968:             cmd = [find_ffmpeg_binary(), '-y', '-i', t_in, '-c', 'copy', '-map_metadata', '-1', '-map_metadata:s:a', '-1']
969:             for k, v in clean_tags.items():
970:                 if re.match(r'^[A-Za-z0-9_\-]+$', k):
971:                     cmd.extend(['-metadata', f"{k}={v}", '-metadata:s:a:0', f"{k}={v}"])
972:             cmd.append(t_out)
973:             r = subprocess.run(cmd, stdout=subprocess.PIPE, stderr=subprocess.PIPE)
974:             if r.returncode != 0 or not os.path.exists(t_out) or os.path.getsize(t_out) < 64:
975:                 shutil.copyfile(t_in, t_out)
976:         if tr and rev_act != 'strip_all':
977:             if rev_act in ('modify', 'strip_pocket') and sm_obj is not None:
978:                 for k in ('spd', 'tension'):
979:                     if k in rev_upd:
980:                         try: sm_obj[k] = float(rev_upd[k])
981:                         except Exception: pass
982:                 if 'origLen' in rev_upd:
983:                     try: sm_obj['origLen'] = int(rev_upd['origLen'])
984:                     except Exception: pass
985:                 if rev_act == 'strip_pocket':
986:                     p_mask = b""; sm_obj['pocketFrames'] = 0
987:                 m_zlib = zlib.compress(json.dumps(sm_obj, ensure_ascii=False).encode('utf-8'), level=9)
988:             ftr = struct.pack(JENNY_REV_FOOTER_FMT, b'JREV', 67, len(m_zlib), len(p_mask), b'JENNYV67')
989:             with open(t_out, 'ab') as af:
990:                 af.write(m_zlib)
991:                 if p_mask:
992:                     af.write(p_mask)
993:                 af.write(ftr)
994:         dst_fp = os.path.join(fdir, new_fn)
995:         shutil.move(t_out, dst_fp)
996:         if dst_fp != fp and os.path.exists(fp):
997:             try: os.remove(fp)
998:             except Exception: pass
999:         TRACK_META_CACHE_V71.pop(fp, None)
1000:         TRACK_META_CACHE_V71.pop(dst_fp, None)
1001:         return {"status": "ok", "old_filename": fn, "new_filename": new_fn, "tags": clean_tags}
1002:     except Exception as e:
1003:         response.status = 500
1004:         return {"status": "error", "error": str(e)}
1005:     finally:
1006:         for p in (t_in, t_out):
1007:             if p and os.path.exists(p):
1008:                 try: os.remove(p)
1009:                 except Exception: pass

1024: def calc_jrev_audio_stats(full_path, trailer):
1025:     try:
1026:         audio_end = int(trailer["audio_end"])
1027:         granule = 0
1028:         if audio_end > 28:
1029:             read_len = min(65536, audio_end)
1030:             with open(full_path, "rb") as f:
1031:                 if f.read(4) == b"OggS":
1032:                     f.seek(audio_end - read_len)
1033:                     tail = f.read(read_len)
1034:                     idx = tail.rfind(b"OggS\x00")
1035:                     if idx >= 0 and idx + 14 <= len(tail):
1036:                         granule = max(0, struct.unpack_from("<q", tail, idx + 6)[0])
1037:         smap = {}
1038:         try:
1039:             with open(full_path, "rb") as rf:
1040:                 rf.seek(trailer["map_offset"])
1041:                 smap = json.loads(zlib.decompress(rf.read(trailer["map_len"])).decode("utf-8"))
1042:         except Exception:
1043:             pass
1044:         sr = int(smap.get("sr") or 48000)
1045:         samples = granule if granule > 0 else int(smap.get("outLen") or 0)
1046:         if samples > 0 and sr > 0:
1047:             dur_sec = samples / float(sr)
1048:             hrs = int(dur_sec // 3600)
1049:             mins = int((dur_sec % 3600) // 60)
1050:             secs = dur_sec % 60
1051:             dur_str = f"{hrs:02d}:{mins:02d}:{secs:05.2f}"
1052:             br_str = f"{int(round((audio_end * 8.0) / (dur_sec * 1000.0)))} kb/s"
1053:             smp_str = f"{samples:,}".replace(",", " ")
1054:             return dur_sec, dur_str, br_str, smp_str
1055:     except Exception:
1056:         pass
1057:     return 0.0, "—", "—", "—"

1060: @route('/api/pcm_meta_v71/<filename:path>')
1061: def get_pcm_meta_v71(filename):
1062:     import re
1063:     fp = resolve_track_full_path_v71(filename)
1064:     response.content_type = 'application/json'
1065:     if not fp or not os.path.isfile(fp):
1066:         return json.dumps({"duration": 0, "size": 0})
1067:     if filename.lower().endswith('.xflac'):
1068:         xf_dur, xf_wav_sz = _get_xflac_fast_header_info_v87(fp)
1069:         return json.dumps({"duration": xf_dur, "size": xf_wav_sz})
1070:     tr = read_jenny_rev_trailer(fp)
1071:     if tr:
1072:         dur_sec, _, _, _ = calc_jrev_audio_stats(fp, tr)
1073:         if dur_sec > 0:
1074:             return json.dumps({"duration": dur_sec, "size": tr["audio_end"]})
1075:     dur_sec = 0.0

2375: def _sc_sort_transcodings_v107(trans_list):
2376:     ordered = []
2377:     for tr in (trans_list or []):
2378:         if tr.get("snipped"):
2379:             continue
2380:         tu = (tr.get("url") or "").strip()
2381:         fmt = tr.get("format") or {}
2382:         proto = (fmt.get("protocol") or "").lower()
2383:         mime = (fmt.get("mime_type") or "").lower()
2384:         preset = (tr.get("preset") or "").lower()
2385:         quality = (tr.get("quality") or "").lower()
2386:         # Отсекаем битые адаптивные плейлисты abr_sq (audio/mpegurl -> 404) и зашифрованные потоки
2387:         if not tu or "encrypted" in proto or "mpegurl" in mime or preset.startswith("abr"):
2388:             continue
2389: 
2390:         # Выстраиваем строгий рейтинг по реальному битрейту:
2391:         # 0: HQ 256k | 1: aac_160k (160 kbps) | 2: mp3_1_0 (128 kbps) | 3: прочие sq | 4: aac_96k (lq) | 5: opus (64 kbps)
2392:         if quality == "hq" or "256" in preset:
2393:             tier = 0
2394:         elif "160" in preset:
2395:             tier = 1
2396:         elif mime == "audio/mpeg" or preset.startswith("mp3"):
2397:             tier = 2
2398:         elif quality == "sq" and "opus" not in mime and "opus" not in preset:
2399:             tier = 3
2400:         elif "96" in preset or quality == "lq":
2401:             tier = 4
2402:         else:
2403:             tier = 5
2404: 
2405:         prog_bonus = 0 if proto == "progressive" else 1
2406:         ordered.append((tier, prog_bonus, tu, preset))
2407:     ordered.sort(key=lambda x: (x[0], x[1]))
2408:     return [x[2] for x in ordered]

2503: def _clean_concatenated_hls_mp3_bytes_v102(raw_bytes: bytes) -> bytes:
2504:     out = bytearray()
2505:     i, n = 0, len(raw_bytes)
2506:     while i < n:
2507:         idx = raw_bytes.find(b'ID3', i)
2508:         if idx == -1:
2509:             out.extend(raw_bytes[i:])
2510:             break
2511:         if idx + 10 <= n and raw_bytes[idx+3] in (2, 3, 4) and raw_bytes[idx+4] == 0 and all((b & 0x80) == 0 for b in raw_bytes[idx+6:idx+10]):
2512:             out.extend(raw_bytes[i:idx])
2513:             b6, b7, b8, b9 = raw_bytes[idx+6], raw_bytes[idx+7], raw_bytes[idx+8], raw_bytes[idx+9]
2514:             tag_len = 10 + ((b6 & 0x7F) << 21) + ((b7 & 0x7F) << 14) + ((b8 & 0x7F) << 7) + (b9 & 0x7F)
2515:             if idx + tag_len <= n:
2516:                 i = idx + tag_len
2517:                 continue
2518:         out.extend(raw_bytes[i:idx+3])
2519:         i = idx + 3
2520:     return bytes(out)

3341: # === 📂 JENNY V113: INSTANT .TORRENT FILE PARSER + BACKGROUND DAEMON SYNC ===
3342: def _bdecode_with_info_slice_v113(data: bytes):
3343:     info_slice = [0, 0]
3344:     def _parse( idx):
3345:         c = data[idx:idx+1]
3346:         if c == b'i':
3347:             end_i = data.index(b'e', idx + 1)
3348:             return int(data[idx+1:end_i]), end_i + 1
3349:         elif c == b'l':
3350:             idx += 1
3351:             arr = []
3352:             while data[idx:idx+1] != b'e':
3353:                 val, idx = _parse(idx)
3354:                 arr.append(val)
3355:             return arr, idx + 1
3356:         elif c == b'd':
3357:             idx += 1
3358:             d_out = {}
3359:             while data[idx:idx+1] != b'e':
3360:                 k, idx = _parse(idx)
3361:                 v_start = idx
3362:                 v, idx = _parse(idx)
3363:                 v_end = idx
3364:                 if k == b'info' and info_slice[1] == 0:
3365:                     info_slice[0], info_slice[1] = v_start, v_end
3366:                 d_out[k] = v
3367:             return d_out, idx + 1
3368:         elif c.isdigit():
3369:             colon = data.index(b':', idx)
3370:             length = int(data[idx:colon])
3371:             s_start = colon + 1
3372:             s_end = s_start + length
3373:             return data[s_start:s_end], s_end
3374:         else:
3375:             raise ValueError(f"Invalid bencode byte at {idx}")
3376:     root, _ = _parse(0)
3377:     return root, tuple(info_slice)

5: window.saveZonesToConfig = function() {
6:     if (!window.appConfig.scrubZones) window.appConfig.scrubZones = [];
7:     for(let i=1; i<=6; i++) {
8:         let enEl = document.getElementById('cfg_z' + i + '_en');
9:         let valEl = document.getElementById('cfg_z' + i + '_val');
10:         if (enEl && valEl) {
11:             window.appConfig.scrubZones[i-1] = {
12:                 en: enEl.checked,
13:                 val: parseFloat(valEl.value) || 1.0
14:             };
15:         }
16:     }
17:     localStorage.setItem('ytm_config', JSON.stringify(window.appConfig));
18:     if (typeof window.updateSettings === 'function') window.updateSettings();
19: };

21: window.checkZones = function(idx) {
22:     let activeCount = 0;
23:     for(let i=1; i<=6; i++) {
24:         let el = document.getElementById('cfg_z' + i + '_en');
25:         if(el && el.checked) activeCount++;
26:     }
27:     if(activeCount === 0) {
28:         let target = document.getElementById('cfg_z' + idx + '_en');
29:         if(target) target.checked = true;
30:     }
31:     window.saveZonesToConfig();
32: };

343: function bufferToWav(abuffer, len) {
344:     let numOfChan = abuffer.numberOfChannels,
345:         length = len * numOfChan * 2 + 44,
346:         buffer = new ArrayBuffer(length),
347:         view = new DataView(buffer),
348:         channels = [], i, sample,
349:         offset = 0,
350:         pos = 0;
351: 
352:     function setUint16(data) { view.setUint16(pos, data, true); pos += 2; }
353:     function setUint32(data) { view.setUint32(pos, data, true); pos += 4; }
354: 
355:     setUint32(0x46464952); setUint32(length - 8); setUint32(0x45564157);
356:     setUint32(0x20746d66); setUint32(16); setUint16(1); setUint16(numOfChan);
357:     setUint32(abuffer.sampleRate); setUint32(abuffer.sampleRate * 2 * numOfChan);
358:     setUint16(numOfChan * 2); setUint16(16);
359:     setUint32(0x61746164); setUint32(length - pos - 4);
360: 
361:     for(i = 0; i < abuffer.numberOfChannels; i++) channels.push(abuffer.getChannelData(i));
362: 
363:     while(pos < length) {
364:         for(i = 0; i < numOfChan; i++) {
365:             sample = Math.max(-1, Math.min(1, channels[i][offset]));
366:             sample = (0.5 + sample < 0 ? sample * 32768 : sample * 32767)|0;
367:             view.setInt16(pos, sample, true); pos += 2;
368:         }
369:         offset++;
370:     }
371:     return new Blob([buffer], {type: "audio/wav"});
372: }

1103: window.applyVisualThemeV37 = function() {
1104:     window.appConfig = window.appConfig || JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem('ytm_config') || '{}');
1105:     const key = window.appConfig.themeBorderKey || 'solid_purple';
1106:     const alphaPct = (window.appConfig.themeBorderAlpha !== undefined) ? parseInt(window.appConfig.themeBorderAlpha, 10) : 38;
1107:     const alpha = Math.max(0.1, Math.min(1.0, alphaPct / 100));

1110:     const root = document.documentElement;

1113:         document.body.setAttribute('data-border-mode', 'solid');
1114:         const [r, g, b] = preset.rgb;
1115:         root.style.setProperty('--border-uniform', `rgba(${r}, ${g}, ${b}, ${alpha})`);
1116:         root.style.setProperty('--border-main', `rgba(${r}, ${g}, ${b}, ${alpha})`);
1117:         root.style.setProperty('--border-accent', `rgba(${r}, ${g}, ${b}, ${Math.min(1, alpha + 0.15)})`);
1118:     } else {
1119:         document.body.setAttribute('data-border-mode', 'grad');
1120:         const [r1, g1, b1] = preset.c1;
1121:         const [r2, g2, b2] = preset.c2;
1122:         if (preset.c3) {
1123:             const [r3, g3, b3] = preset.c3;
1124:             root.style.setProperty('--border-grad', `linear-gradient(135deg, rgba(${r1},${g1},${b1},${alpha}), rgba(${r2},${g2},${b2},${alpha}), rgba(${r3},${g3},${b3},${alpha}))`);
1125:         } else {
1126:             root.style.setProperty('--border-grad', `linear-gradient(135deg, rgba(${r1},${g1},${b1},${alpha}), rgba(${r2},${g2},${b2},${alpha}))`);
1127:         }
1128:         root.style.setProperty('--border-uniform', `rgba(${r1}, ${g1}, ${b1}, ${alpha * 0.75})`);
1129:         root.style.setProperty('--border-main', `rgba(${r1}, ${g1}, ${b1}, ${alpha * 0.75})`);
1130:     }

1418: window.hexToRgbaV38 = function(hex, alpha) {
1419:     let c = String(hex || '#7341be').replace('#', '').trim();
1420:     if (c.length === 3) c = c[0]+c[0]+c[1]+c[1]+c[2]+c[2];
1421:     const num = parseInt(c, 16);
1422:     if (isNaN(num)) return `rgba(115, 65, 190, ${alpha})`;
1423:     return `rgba(${(num >> 16) & 255}, ${(num >> 8) & 255}, ${num & 255}, ${alpha})`;
1424: };

1750: window.parseHexToRgbV39 = function(hex) {
1751:     let c = String(hex || '').replace('#', '').trim();
1752:     if (c.length === 3) c = c[0]+c[0]+c[1]+c[1]+c[2]+c[2];
1753:     if (!/^[0-9a-fA-F]{6}$/.test(c)) return null;
1754:     const n = parseInt(c, 16);
1755:     return [(n >> 16) & 255, (n >> 8) & 255, n & 255];
1756: };
1757: 
1758: window.findNearestStandardColorV39 = function(targetHex, fallbackHex) {
1759:     const rgb = window.parseHexToRgbV39(targetHex) || window.parseHexToRgbV39(fallbackHex) || [115, 65, 190];
1760:     let best = window.STANDARD_PALETTE_V39[0];
1761:     let minDist = Infinity;
1762:     window.STANDARD_PALETTE_V39.forEach(item => {
1763:         if (item.hex === '#000000' && fallbackHex !== '#000000') return;
1764:         const pRgb = window.parseHexToRgbV39(item.hex);
1765:         if (!pRgb) return;
1766:         const d = Math.pow(rgb[0]-pRgb[0], 2) + Math.pow(rgb[1]-pRgb[1], 2) + Math.pow(rgb[2]-pRgb[2], 2);
1767:         if (d < minDist) {
1768:             minDist = d;
1769:             best = item;
1770:         }
1771:     });
1772:     return best;
1773: };

1869: // 2. УМНЫЙ ПАРСЕР НЕПОЛНОГО ИЛИ ОБОРВАННОГО JSON С АВТОПОДБОРОМ БЛИЖАЙШЕГО ЦВЕТА
1870: window.salvagePartialJsonV39 = function(rawText) {
1871:     let txt = String(rawText || '').trim();
1872:     if (!txt) return null;
1873: 
1874:     // Попытка 1: чистый JSON.parse
1875:     try {
1876:         const obj = JSON.parse(txt);
1877:         if (obj && typeof obj === 'object') return obj;
1878:     } catch (e) {}
1879: 
1880:     // Попытка 2: чиним оборванный конец (запятые, незакрытые кавычки и фигурную скобку)
1881:     let fixed = txt.replace(/,\s*$/, '');
1882:     if (!fixed.startsWith('{')) fixed = '{' + fixed;
1883:     const quoteCount = (fixed.match(/"/g) || []).length;
1884:     if (quoteCount % 2 !== 0) fixed += '"';
1885:     fixed = fixed.replace(/,\s*\}/g, '}');
1886:     if (!fixed.endsWith('}')) fixed += '}';
1887:     try {
1888:         const obj = JSON.parse(fixed);
1889:         if (obj && typeof obj === 'object') return obj;
1890:     } catch (e) {}
1891: 
1892:     // Попытка 3: Построчное вытаскивание всех распознаваемых пар ключ-значение регулярками
1893:     const extracted = {};
1894:     const kvRegex = /"?([a-zA-Z0-9_]+)"?\s*:\s*("[^"]*"|true|false|-?\d+(?:\.\d+)?|#[0-9a-fA-F]{3,6})/g;
1895:     let m;
1896:     while ((m = kvRegex.exec(txt)) !== null) {
1897:         const k = m[1];
1898:         let v = m[2];
1899:         if (v.startsWith('"') && v.endsWith('"')) v = v.slice(1, -1);
1900:         else if (v === 'true') v = true;
1901:         else if (v === 'false') v = false;
1902:         else if (!v.startsWith('#') && !isNaN(Number(v))) v = Number(v);
1903:         extracted[k] = v;
1904:     }
1905:     return Object.keys(extracted).length > 0 ? extracted : null;
1906: };
1907: 
1908: window.applySmartPartialThemeV39 = function(rawObj, ev) {
1909:     if (!rawObj || typeof rawObj !== 'object') return false;
1910: 
1911:     const defaults = window.DEFAULT_THEME_CONFIG_V38;
1912:     const colorKeys = ['resetBtnColor', 'ioBtnColor', 'checkboxColor', 'sliderColor', 'transportColor', 'bgColor'];
1913:     const allKeys = ['amoledMode', 'volSlider', 'themeBorderKey', 'themeBorderAlpha', ...colorKeys];
1914: 
1915:     // Находим любой валидный цвет внутри присланного JSON, чтобы искать ближайший стандартный оттенок к задумке автора
1916:     let referenceHex = null;
1917:     for (const ck of colorKeys) {
1918:         if (rawObj[ck] && window.parseHexToRgbV39(rawObj[ck])) {
1919:             referenceHex = rawObj[ck];
1920:             break;
1921:         }
1922:     }
1923: 
1924:     const missingRu = [];
1925:     const missingEn = [];
1926:     const finalTheme = { jenny_theme_v: "1.1" };
1927:     let usedNearestNameRu = null;
1928:     let usedNearestNameEn = null;
1929: 
1930:     allKeys.forEach(k => {
1931:         const isProvided = (rawObj[k] !== undefined && rawObj[k] !== null && rawObj[k] !== '');
1932:         if (isProvided) {
1933:             if (colorKeys.includes(k)) {
1934:                 // Если цвет указан криво, подбираем ближайший стандартный
1935:                 if (window.parseHexToRgbV39(rawObj[k])) {
1936:                     finalTheme[k] = rawObj[k];
1937:                 } else {
1938:                     const near = window.findNearestStandardColorV39(referenceHex, defaults[k]);
1939:                     finalTheme[k] = near.hex;
1940:                 }
1941:             } else {
1942:                 finalTheme[k] = rawObj[k];
1943:             }
1944:         } else {

2265: // Применение темы меняет ТОЛЬКО CSS-переменные, вообще не трогая аудио-движок
2266: window.applyVisualThemeV37 = function() {
2267:     window.appConfig = window.appConfig || {};
2268:     const key = window.appConfig.themeBorderKey || 'solid_purple';
2269:     const alphaPct = (window.appConfig.themeBorderAlpha !== undefined) ? parseInt(window.appConfig.themeBorderAlpha, 10) : 38;
2270:     const alpha = Math.max(0.1, Math.min(1.0, alphaPct / 100));
2271: 
2272:     const preset = window.THEME_PRESETS_V37[key] || window.THEME_PRESETS_V37.solid_purple;
2273:     const root = document.documentElement;
2274: 
2275:     if (preset.mode === 'solid') {
2276:         document.body.setAttribute('data-border-mode', 'solid');
2277:         const [r, g, b] = preset.rgb;
2278:         root.style.setProperty('--border-uniform', `rgba(${r}, ${g}, ${b}, ${alpha})`);
2279:         root.style.setProperty('--border-main', `rgba(${r}, ${g}, ${b}, ${alpha})`);
2280:         root.style.setProperty('--border-accent', `rgba(${r}, ${g}, ${b}, ${Math.min(1, alpha + 0.15)})`);
2281:     } else {
2282:         document.body.setAttribute('data-border-mode', 'grad');
2283:         const [r1, g1, b1] = preset.c1;
2284:         const [r2, g2, b2] = preset.c2;
2285:         if (preset.c3) {
2286:             const [r3, g3, b3] = preset.c3;
2287:             root.style.setProperty('--border-grad', `linear-gradient(135deg, rgba(${r1},${g1},${b1},${alpha}), rgba(${r2},${g2},${b2},${alpha}), rgba(${r3},${g3},${b3},${alpha}))`);
2288:         } else {
2289:             root.style.setProperty('--border-grad', `linear-gradient(135deg, rgba(${r1},${g1},${b1},${alpha}), rgba(${r2},${g2},${b2},${alpha}))`);
2290:         }
2291:         root.style.setProperty('--border-uniform', `rgba(${r1}, ${g1}, ${b1}, ${alpha * 0.75})`);
2292:         root.style.setProperty('--border-main', `rgba(${r1}, ${g1}, ${b1}, ${alpha * 0.75})`);
2293:     }
2294: 
2295:     if (typeof window.applyGroupColorsV38 === 'function') {
2296:         window.applyGroupColorsV38();
2297:     }
2298: };

2524: // 1. Защита от выбора черного/темного фона (#000000 и #0d1117) для кнопок и галочек в неполном JSON!
2525: window.findNearestStandardColorV39 = function(targetHex, fallbackHex) {
2526:     const isBgTarget = (fallbackHex === '#000000' || fallbackHex === '#0d1117');
2527:     const rgb = window.parseHexToRgbV39(targetHex) || window.parseHexToRgbV39(fallbackHex) || [115, 65, 190];
2528:     let best = window.STANDARD_PALETTE_V39[0];
2529:     let minDist = Infinity;
2530:     window.STANDARD_PALETTE_V39.forEach(item => {
2531:         // Для кнопок, галочек и ползунков НИКОГДА не подставляем чёрный или тёмно-синий фон, чтобы интерфейс не сливался!
2532:         if (!isBgTarget && (item.hex === '#000000' || item.hex === '#0d1117')) return;
2533:         const pRgb = window.parseHexToRgbV39(item.hex);
2534:         if (!pRgb) return;
2535:         const d = Math.pow(rgb[0]-pRgb[0], 2) + Math.pow(rgb[1]-pRgb[1], 2) + Math.pow(rgb[2]-pRgb[2], 2);
2536:         if (d < minDist) {
2537:             minDist = d;
2538:             best = item;
2539:         }
2540:     });
2541:     return best;
2542: };

3260: // Алгоритм V49:

3263: window.buildElasticHoseBufferV46 = function(srcBuffer, speed, tensionPct) {
3264:     if (!srcBuffer || !window.audioCtx) return srcBuffer;
3265:     const spd = Math.max(0.1, Math.min(100.0, parseFloat(speed) || 1.0));
3266:     const tension = Math.max(0.2, Math.min(2.0, (parseFloat(tensionPct) || 100) / 100));
3267: 
3268:     if (Math.abs(spd - 1.0) < 0.002) {
3269:         window._hoseSplicerCacheV46.speed = 1.0;
3270:         window._hoseSplicerCacheV46.srcBuffer = srcBuffer;
3271:         window._hoseSplicerCacheV46.lastBuildMs = 0;
3272:         window._hoseSplicerCacheV46.avgSeamErrMv = 0;
3273:         window._hoseSplicerCacheV46.splicedBuffer = srcBuffer;
3274:         window._hoseSplicerCacheV46.seamPointsOut = [];
3275:         return srcBuffer;
3276:     }
3277: 
3278:     const cache = window._hoseSplicerCacheV46;
3279:     if (cache.srcBuffer === srcBuffer && Math.abs(cache.speed - spd) < 0.002 && Math.abs(cache.tension - tension) < 0.02 && cache.splicedBuffer) {
3280:         return cache.splicedBuffer;
3281:     }
3282: 
3283:     const t0 = performance.now();
3284:     const sr = srcBuffer.sampleRate;
3285:     const numCh = srcBuffer.numberOfChannels;
3286:     const inLen = srcBuffer.length;
3287:     const outLen = Math.max(1024, Math.floor(inLen / spd));
3288:     const outBuffer = window.audioCtx.createBuffer(numCh, outLen, sr);
3289: 
3290:     const chIn = [];
3291:     const chOut = [];
3292:     for (let c = 0; c < numCh; c++) {
3293:         chIn.push(srcBuffer.getChannelData(c));
3294:         chOut.push(outBuffer.getChannelData(c));
3295:     }
3296: 
3297:     // Базовый шаг 18 мс с анти-резонансной модуляцией шага (чтобы не возникал монотонный гул на одной частоте!)
3298:     const baseStep = Math.max(512, Math.round(0.018 * sr));
3299:     const searchRad = Math.max(256, Math.round(0.012 * sr));
3300:     // Широкое 4.5 мс C2-скругление вдоль склона (216 сэмплов) — полностью убирает любые щелчки и гул на басу
3301:     const filletLen = Math.max(128, Math.round(0.0045 * sr));
3302: 
3303:     const blendCurve = new Float32Array(filletLen);
3304:     const tangDecay = new Float32Array(filletLen);
3305:     for (let i = 0; i < filletLen; i++) {
3306:         const t = i / filletLen;
3307:         const b = 0.5 * (1.0 - Math.cos(Math.PI * t));
3308:         blendCurve[i] = b;
3309:         const r = 1.0 - b;
3310:         tangDecay[i] = r * r;
3311:     }
3312: 
3313:     const in0 = chIn[0];
3314:     const in1 = numCh > 1 ? chIn[1] : in0;
3315: 
3316:     const initCopy = Math.min(baseStep, outLen, inLen);
3317:     for (let c = 0; c < numCh; c++) {
3318:         const inp = chIn[c];
3319:         const out = chOut[c];
3320:         for (let i = 0; i < initCopy; i++) out[i] = inp[i];
3321:     }
3322: 
3323:     let outPos = initCopy;
3324:     let inCursor = initCopy;
3325:     let seamCount = 0;
3326:     let totalSeamDiff = 0;
3327:     const seamPoints = [];
3328: 
3329:     const isFast = spd > 1.0;
3330:     const speedDelta = Math.abs(spd - 1.0);
3331:     const vertFactor = Math.min(0.28, speedDelta * tension * 0.30);
3332:     let smoothGain = 1.0;
3333: 
3334:     while (outPos + baseStep + filletLen + 256 < outLen) {
3335:         // Слегка варьируем длину шага (±15%), чтобы швы никогда не образовывали гудящую ноту!
3336:         const jitter = ((seamCount * 73) & 127) - 64;
3337:         const stepOut = baseStep + jitter * 2;
3338: 
3339:         let p1 = Math.round(inCursor);
3340:         const idealP2 = Math.round(outPos * spd);
3341: 
3342:         if (p1 < 32 || p1 + stepOut + filletLen + 32 >= inLen) break;
3343:         if (idealP2 < 32 || idealP2 + stepOut + filletLen + 32 >= inLen) break;

3345:         // 1. Привязываем первую точку разреза p1 к восходящему переходу через 0 (мембрана в нуле, угол 90° к склону)
3346:         let advK = 0;
3347:         for (let k = 0; k <= 36; k++) {
3348:             if (in0[inCursor + k - 1] <= 0.0 && in0[inCursor + k] >= 0.0) { advK = k; break; }
3349:         }
3350:         for (let k = 0; k < advK && outPos < outLen; k++) {

3352:             outPos++; inCursor++;
3353:         }
3354:         p1 = inCursor;
3355: 
3356:         const s1L = in0[p1 + 1] - in0[p1 - 1];
3357:         const s1R = in1[p1 + 1] - in1[p1 - 1];
3358:         // Низкочастотный (басовый) вектор наклона за 16 сэмплов
3359:         const bassSlope1L = in0[p1 + 12] - in0[p1 - 12];
3360: 
3361:         const minP2 = Math.max(32, idealP2 - searchRad);
3362:         const maxP2 = Math.min(inLen - stepOut - filletLen - 32, idealP2 + searchRad);
3363: 
3364:         let bestP2 = idealP2;
3365:         let bestCost = 1e9;
3366: 
3367:         // 2. Ищем на соседней дуге точку p2, где совпадает ВЕСЬ профиль волны (и высокая гитара, и длинный бас!)
3368:         for (let cand = minP2; cand <= maxP2; cand += 3) {
3369:             const s2L = in0[cand + 1] - in0[cand - 1];
3370:             const bassSlope2L = in0[cand + 12] - in0[cand - 12];
3371: 
3372:             // Запрещаем сшивать волны с разным направлением склона или в противофазе баса
3373:             if (s1L * s2L < 0 || bassSlope1L * bassSlope2L < 0) continue;
3374: 
3375:             // Сравниваем профиль дуги по 8 контрольным точкам вдоль склона
3376:             let profileErr = 0.0;
3377:             for (let w = -12; w <= 36; w += 6) {
3378:                 const dL = in0[cand + w] - in0[p1 + w];
3379:                 const dR = in1[cand + w] - in1[p1 + w];
3380:                 profileErr += dL * dL + dR * dR;
3381:             }
3382: 
3383:             const slopeDiff = Math.abs(s2L - s1L) + Math.abs((in1[cand + 1] - in1[cand - 1]) - s1R);
3384:             const cost = profileErr * 1.5 + slopeDiff * 2.5;
3385: 
3386:             if (cost < bestCost) {
3387:                 bestCost = cost;
3388:                 bestP2 = cand;
3389:             }
3390:         }
3391: 
3392:         // Посэмпловая доводка вокруг bestP2
3393:         for (let cand = Math.max(minP2, bestP2 - 2); cand <= Math.min(maxP2, bestP2 + 2); cand++) {
3394:             let profileErr = 0.0;
3395:             for (let w = -6; w <= 24; w += 6) {
3396:                 const dL = in0[cand + w] - in0[p1 + w];
3397:                 const dR = in1[cand + w] - in1[p1 + w];
3398:                 profileErr += dL * dL + dR * dR;
3399:             }
3400:             if (profileErr < bestCost) {
3401:                 bestCost = profileErr;
3402:                 bestP2 = cand;
3403:             }
3404:         }
3405: 
3406:         totalSeamDiff += Math.abs(in0[bestP2] - in0[p1]);
3407:         seamCount++;

3409:         if (!cache.seamLogs || seamCount === 1) cache.seamLogs = [];
3410:

3412:         let segPeak = 0.0;

3414:             const a = Math.max(Math.abs(in0[bestP2 + i]), Math.abs(in1[bestP2 + i]));

3424:         }

3426:             idx: seamCount,
3427:             outPos: outPos,
3428:             stepOut: stepOut,
3429:             advK: advK,
3430:             p1: p1,
3431:             p2: bestP2,
3432:             shift: bestP2 - p1,
3433:             filletLen: filletLen,
3434:             targetGain: targetGain,
3435:             t: (outPos * spd) / sr,
3436:             dy: Math.abs(in0[bestP2] - in0[p1]),
3437:             sA: s1L,
3438:             sB: in0[bestP2 + 1] - in0[bestP2 - 1]
3439:         });
3440: 
3441:         for (let c = 0; c < numCh; c++) {
3442:             const inp = chIn[c];
3443:             const out = chOut[c];
3444:             const dy = inp[bestP2] - inp[p1];
3445:             let localGain = smoothGain;
3446: 
3447:             for (let i = 0; i < stepOut; i++) {
3448:                 localGain = localGain * 0.997 + targetGain * 0.003;
3449:                 let v = inp[bestP2 + i];

3455:                     v = contVal * (1.0 - b) + pulledNew * b;

3459:             }

3476:     cache.srcBuffer = srcBuffer;

3481:     cache.avgSeamErrMv = seamCount > 0 ? (totalSeamDiff / seamCount) : 0;
3482:     cache.seamPointsOut = seamPoints;

4130: // ✂️ СЭМПЛ-РЕЗАК В /storage/emulated/0/Music/mp3_test
4131: window.encodeAudioBufferToWavB64V59 = function(audioBuf) {
4132:     const numCh = audioBuf.numberOfChannels, sr = audioBuf.sampleRate, len = audioBuf.length;
4133:     const blockAlign = numCh * 4, dataSize = len * blockAlign;
4134:     const buf = new ArrayBuffer(44 + dataSize), view = new DataView(buf);
4135:     const writeStr = (off, s) => { for (let i = 0; i < s.length; i++) view.setUint8(off + i, s.charCodeAt(i)); };
4136:     writeStr(0, 'RIFF'); view.setUint32(4, 36 + dataSize, true); writeStr(8, 'WAVE');
4137:     writeStr(12, 'fmt '); view.setUint32(16, 16, true); view.setUint16(20, 3, true);
4138:     view.setUint16(22, numCh, true); view.setUint32(24, sr, true);
4139:     view.setUint32(28, sr * blockAlign, true); view.setUint16(32, blockAlign, true); view.setUint16(34, 32, true);
4140:     writeStr(36, 'data'); view.setUint32(40, dataSize, true);
4141:     const chData = [];
4142:     for (let c = 0; c < numCh; c++) chData.push(audioBuf.getChannelData(c));
4143:     let offset = 44;
4144:     for (let i = 0; i < len; i++) {
4145:         for (let c = 0; c < numCh; c++) { view.setFloat32(offset, chData[c][i], true); offset += 4; }
4146:     }
4147:     const bytes = new Uint8Array(buf);
4148:     let binary = '';
4149:     for (let i = 0; i < bytes.length; i += 0x8000) binary += String.fromCharCode.apply(null, bytes.subarray(i, i + 0x8000));
4150:     return btoa(binary);
4151: };
