4860: window.startSpectrumLoopV62 = function() {
4861:     const st = window._jennySpecStateV62;
4862:     if (st.rafId) cancelAnimationFrame(st.rafId);
4863: 
4864:     const freqData = new Uint8Array(1024);
4865:     const numBars = 64;
4866: 
4867:     const draw = () => {
4868:         const sm = document.getElementById('specModal');
4869:         const cv = document.getElementById('jennyFftCanvasV62');
4870:         if (sm && sm.classList.contains('open') && cv && !st.frozen) {
4871:             const ctx = cv.getContext('2d');
4872:             const W = cv.width;
4873:             const H = cv.height;
4874:             const plotH = H - 18;
4875:             const plotX = 28;
4876:             const plotW = W - plotX - 4;
4877: 
4878:             ctx.fillStyle = '#05070a';
4879:             ctx.fillRect(0, 0, W, H);
4880: 
4881:             // Горизонтальная сетка децибел
4882:             ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(139,148,158,0.14)';
4883:             ctx.fillStyle = '#6e7681';
4884:             ctx.font = '9px monospace';
4885:             ctx.lineWidth = 1;
4886:             [
4887:                 { db: ' 0dB', y: 8 },
4888:                 { db: '-20',  y: Math.round(plotH * 0.33) },
4889:                 { db: '-45',  y: Math.round(plotH * 0.66) },
4890:                 { db: '-80',  y: plotH }
4891:             ].forEach(g => {
4892:                 ctx.beginPath();
4893:                 ctx.moveTo(plotX, g.y);
4894:                 ctx.lineTo(W - 2, g.y);
4895:                 ctx.stroke();
4896:                 ctx.fillText(g.db, 2, g.y + 3);
4897:             });
4898: 
4899:             // Подписи частот снизу (60 Гц, 230 Гц, 910 Гц, 3.6 кГц, 14 кГц)
4900:             const marks = [
4901:                 { lbl: '60',   f: 60 },
4902:                 { lbl: '230',  f: 230 },
4903:                 { lbl: '910',  f: 910 },
4904:                 { lbl: '3.6k', f: 3600 },
4905:                 { lbl: '14k',  f: 14000 }
4906:             ];
4907:             marks.forEach(m => {
4908:                 const normX = Math.log10(m.f / 20) / Math.log10(20000 / 20);
4909:                 const x = plotX + Math.round(normX * plotW);
4910:                 ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(88,166,255,0.12)';
4911:                 ctx.beginPath();
4912:                 ctx.moveTo(x, 4);
4913:                 ctx.lineTo(x, plotH);
4914:                 ctx.stroke();
4915:                 ctx.fillStyle = '#8b949e';
4916:                 ctx.fillText(m.lbl, x - 10, H - 4);
4917:             });
4918: 
4919:             const an = window.ensureSpectrumAnalysersV62();
4920:             if (an) {
4921:                 an.getByteFrequencyData(freqData);
4922:                 const sr = (window.audioCtx && window.audioCtx.sampleRate) ? window.audioCtx.sampleRate : 48000;
4923:                 const binCount = an.frequencyBinCount;
4924: 
4925:                 let subSum = 0, subCnt = 0;
4926:                 let midSum = 0, midCnt = 0;
4927:                 let highSum = 0, highCnt = 0;
4928: 
4929:                 const barW = Math.max(2, (plotW / numBars) - 1.2);
4930: 
4931:                 for (let i = 0; i < numBars; i++) {
4932:                     const fLow = 20 * Math.pow(1000, i / numBars);
4933:                     const fHigh = 20 * Math.pow(1000, (i + 1) / numBars);
4934:                     let b0 = Math.max(1, Math.floor((fLow * binCount * 2) / sr));
4935:                     let b1 = Math.min(binCount - 1, Math.ceil((fHigh * binCount * 2) / sr));
4936:                     if (b1 < b0) b1 = b0;
4937: 
4938:                     let maxVal = 0;
4939:                     for (let b = b0; b <= b1; b++) {
4940:                         if (freqData[b] > maxVal) maxVal = freqData[b];
4941:                     }
4942: 
4943:                     const fCenter = 0.5 * (fLow + fHigh);
4944:                     if (fCenter <= 200) { subSum += maxVal; subCnt++; }
4945:                     else if (fCenter <= 4000) { midSum += maxVal; midCnt++; }
4946:                     else { highSum += maxVal; highCnt++; }
4947: 
4948:                     if (maxVal >= st.peakHold[i]) {
4949:                         st.peakHold[i] = maxVal;
4950:                     } else {
4951:                         st.peakHold[i] = Math.max(0, st.peakHold[i] - st.peakDecay);
4952:                     }
4953: 
4954:                     const hBar = Math.round((maxVal / 255) * (plotH - 6));
4955:                     const hPeak = Math.round((st.peakHold[i] / 255) * (plotH - 6));
4956:                     const x = plotX + i * (plotW / numBars);
4957: 
4958:                     // Градиент столбика: фиолетовый бас -> изумрудная середина -> голубой воздух
4959:                     if (fCenter <= 220) ctx.fillStyle = '#a371f7';
4960:                     else if (fCenter <= 3800) ctx.fillStyle = '#3fb950';
4961:                     else ctx.fillStyle = '#58a6ff';
4962: 
4963:                     if (hBar > 0) {
4964:                         ctx.fillRect(x, plotH - hBar, barW, hBar);
4965:                     }
4966:                     if (hPeak > 1) {
4967:                         ctx.fillStyle = '#e3b341';
4968:                         ctx.fillRect(x, plotH - hPeak - 2, barW, 2);
4969:                     }
4970:                 }
4971: 
4972:                 const toDbStr = (avg) => avg < 1 ? '-∞ dB' : (-84 + (avg / 255) * 80).toFixed(1) + ' dB';
4973:                 const subEl = document.getElementById('fftSubTextV62');
4974:                 const midEl = document.getElementById('fftMidTextV62');
4975:                 const highEl = document.getElementById('fftHighTextV62');
4976:                 if (subEl) subEl.innerText = `🔊 Бас: ${toDbStr(subSum / Math.max(1, subCnt))}`;
4977:                 if (midEl) midEl.innerText = `🎤 СЧ: ${toDbStr(midSum / Math.max(1, midCnt))}`;
4978:                 if (highEl) highEl.innerText = `✨ ВЧ: ${toDbStr(highSum / Math.max(1, highCnt))}`;
4979:             }
4980:         }
4981:         st.rafId = requestAnimationFrame(draw);
4982:     };
4983:     st.rafId = requestAnimationFrame(draw);
4984: };

5720: window.reconstructOriginalBufferV67 = function(exportedBuf, smap, pocketBuf) {
5721:     if (!exportedBuf || !smap || !window.audioCtx) return null;
5722:     const sr = exportedBuf.sampleRate;
5723:     const numCh = exportedBuf.numberOfChannels;
5724:     const expLen = exportedBuf.length;
5725:     const origLen = Math.max(1024, parseInt(smap.origLen, 10) || Math.round(expLen * (parseFloat(smap.spd) || 1.0)));
5726:     const seams = smap.seams || [];
5727: 
5728:     const origBuf = window.audioCtx.createBuffer(numCh, origLen, sr);
5729: 
5730:     // 1. Если трек сохранялся в режиме Pitch-Shift (Винил / JBUF Shift / Web Shift) без разрезов —
5731:     // восстанавливаем исходную сетку 1.0x кубической интерполяцией Эрмита
5732:     if (seams.length === 0 && Math.abs((parseFloat(smap.spd) || 1.0) - 1.0) > 0.002) {
5733:         const ratio = expLen / origLen;
5734:         for (let c = 0; c < numCh; c++) {
5735:             const inp = exportedBuf.getChannelData(c);
5736:             const out = origBuf.getChannelData(c);
5737:             for (let i = 0; i < origLen; i++) {
5738:                 const pos = i * ratio;
5739:                 const idx = Math.floor(pos);
5740:                 const frac = pos - idx;
5741:                 const y0 = inp[Math.max(0, idx - 1)] || 0;
5742:                 const y1 = inp[Math.min(expLen - 1, idx)] || 0;
5743:                 const y2 = inp[Math.min(expLen - 1, idx + 1)] || 0;
5744:                 const y3 = inp[Math.min(expLen - 1, idx + 2)] || 0;
5745:                 const c0 = y1;
5746:                 const c1 = 0.5 * (y2 - y0);
5747:                 const c2 = y0 - 2.5 * y1 + 2.0 * y2 - 0.5 * y3;
5748:                 const c3 = 0.5 * (y3 - y0) + 1.5 * (y1 - y2);
5749:                 out[i] = ((c3 * frac + c2) * frac + c1) * frac + c0;
5750:             }
5751:         }
5752:         return origBuf;
5753:     }
5754: 
5755:     if (seams.length === 0) return exportedBuf;
5756: 
5757:     // 2. Пошаговая реконструкция эталонной волны 1.0x по карте швов JBUF 90° и карману обрезков
5758:     const filletLen = smap.filletLen || Math.max(128, Math.round(0.0045 * sr));
5759:     const feather = 24;
5760: 
5761:     for (let c = 0; c < numCh; c++) {

5764:         const pck = (pocketBuf && c < pocketBuf.numberOfChannels) ? pocketBuf.getChannelData(c) : null;
5765:

5768:         const initEnd = Math.min(s0[0], s0[3], expLen, origLen);
5769:         for (let i = 0; i < initEnd; i++) {
5770:             orig[i] = exp[i];
5771:         }
5772:         let filledUpTo = initEnd;
5773:         let smoothGain = 1.0;
5774: 
5775:         for (let k = 0; k < seams.length; k++) {
5776:             const s = seams[k];
5777:             const outPos = s[0];
5778:             const stepOut = s[1];
5779:             const advK = s[2];
5780:             const p1 = s[3];
5781:             const p2 = s[4];

5783:             const pckOff = s[6];

5786:             const nextOutPos = (k + 1 < seams.length) ? seams[k + 1][0] : expLen;
5787:             const blockLen = Math.max(0, Math.min(expLen - outPos, nextOutPos - outPos));
5788: 
5789:             // Предварительно просчитываем кривую огибающей localGain на этом шаге, чтобы точно обратить её
5790:             let localGain = smoothGain;
5791: 
5792:             // СЛУЧАЙ А: Ускорение (p2 > p1) — возвращаем вырезанный участок [p1 .. p2 + filletLen] из кармана pck
5793:             if (p2 > p1 && pck && pckOff >= 0 && pckLen > 0) {
5794:                 for (let j = 0; j < pckLen; j++) {

5801:                     } else {

5803:                     }
5804:                 }

5806:             }
5807: 
5808:             // Копируем чистый хвост блока из exp[outPos + i] в orig[p2 + i], отсекая клонированные участки и кроссфейды
5809:             for (let i = 0; i < blockLen; i++) {

5816:                 if (srcIdx >= expLen) break;

5819:

5827:                     orig[dstIdx] = orig[dstIdx] * (1.0 - w) + cleanVal * w;
5828:                 } else {
5829:                     orig[dstIdx] = cleanVal;
5830:                 }
5831:             }
5832: 
5833:             smoothGain = localGain;
5834:             filledUpTo = Math.max(filledUpTo, Math.min(origLen, p2 + blockLen));

5836:

5839:         let tailOut = lastSeam[0] + lastSeam[1];
5840:         let tailOrig = filledUpTo;
5841:         while (tailOrig < origLen && tailOut < expLen) {
5842:             orig[tailOrig++] = exp[tailOut++];
5843:         }
5844:     }
5845: 
5846:     return origBuf;

6280: window.measureBufferStatsV76 = function(buf) {
6281:     if (!buf) return { rms: 0.1, peak: 0.5, midRms: 0.1, sideRms: 0.05 };
6282:     const ch0 = buf.getChannelData(0);
6283:     const ch1 = buf.numberOfChannels > 1 ? buf.getChannelData(1) : ch0;
6284:     const len = ch0.length;
6285:     const step = Math.max(1, Math.floor(len / 50000));
6286:     let sumSq = 0, midSq = 0, sideSq = 0, peak = 0, cnt = 0;
6287:     for (let i = 0; i < len; i += step) {
6288:         const l = ch0[i], r = ch1[i];
6289:         const a = Math.max(Math.abs(l), Math.abs(r));
6290:         if (a > peak) peak = a;
6291:         if (l === 0 && r === 0) continue;
6292:         const m = 0.5 * (l + r), s = 0.5 * (l - r);
6293:         sumSq += 0.5 * (l * l + r * r);
6294:         midSq += m * m;
6295:         sideSq += s * s;
6296:         cnt++;
6297:     }
6298:     cnt = Math.max(1, cnt);
6299:     return {
6300:         rms: Math.sqrt(sumSq / cnt),
6301:         peak: Math.max(0.001, peak),
6302:         midRms: Math.sqrt(midSq / cnt),
6303:         sideRms: Math.sqrt(sideSq / cnt)
6304:     };
6305: };

6361: window.applyInverseDspCompensationV76 = async function(rawReconstructedBuf, smap, forceFullOffline) {
6362:     if (!rawReconstructedBuf || !window.audioCtx || !window.antiDspEnabledV76) return rawReconstructedBuf;
6363:     const isHugeBuf = (rawReconstructedBuf.duration > 360) && !forceFullOffline;
6364:     const dna = (smap && smap.dspDna) ? smap.dspDna : window.buildFallbackDspDnaFromConfigV76();
6365:     if (!dna) return rawReconstructedBuf;
6366: 
6367:     const sr = rawReconstructedBuf.sampleRate;
6368:     const numCh = rawReconstructedBuf.numberOfChannels;
6369:     const len = rawReconstructedBuf.length;
6370:     const workBuf = window.audioCtx.createBuffer(numCh, len, sr);
6371: 
6372:     // 1. Посэмпловая инверсия: обратный софт-клиппер (atanh) + возврат потолка padDb + возврат стерео-базы M/S
6373:     const k = 1.25;
6374:     const tanhK = Math.tanh(k);
6375:     const invPad = dna.opt_masterCeil ? (1.0 / window.dbToLinear(dna.padDb || -0.5)) : 1.0;
6376: 
6377:     let midRatio = 1.0, sideRatio = 1.0;
6378:     if (dna.origMidRms > 0.0005 && dna.postMidRms > 0.0005 && dna.origSideRms > 0.0001 && dna.postSideRms > 0.0001) {
6379:         const origMS = dna.origSideRms / dna.origMidRms;
6380:         const postMS = dna.postSideRms / dna.postMidRms;
6381:         if (postMS > 0.01) {
6382:             sideRatio = Math.max(0.35, Math.min(2.5, origMS / postMS));
6383:         }
6384:     } else if (dna.opt_msWidth) {
6385:         const w = Math.max(0.1, (parseFloat(dna.val_msWidth) || 130) / 100.0);
6386:         const fMid = (w <= 1.0) ? 1.0 : Math.max(0.72, 1.0 - (w - 1.0) * 0.12);
6387:         const fSide = (w <= 1.0) ? w : (1.0 + (w - 1.0) * 0.85);
6388:         sideRatio = fMid / Math.max(0.1, fSide);
6389:     }
6390: 
6391:     const ch0In = rawReconstructedBuf.getChannelData(0);
6392:     const ch1In = numCh > 1 ? rawReconstructedBuf.getChannelData(1) : ch0In;
6393:     const ch0Out = workBuf.getChannelData(0);
6394:     const ch1Out = numCh > 1 ? workBuf.getChannelData(1) : ch0Out;
6395: 
6396:     for (let i = 0; i < len; i++) {
6397:         let l = ch0In[i], r = ch1In[i];
6398:         if (dna.opt_masterCeil) {
6399:             const nl = Math.max(-0.992, Math.min(0.992, (l / 0.98) * tanhK));
6400:             const nr = Math.max(-0.992, Math.min(0.992, (r / 0.98) * tanhK));
6401:             l = (0.5 * Math.log((1 + nl) / (1 - nl)) / k) * invPad;
6402:             r = (0.5 * Math.log((1 + nr) / (1 - nr)) / k) * invPad;
6403:         }
6404:         if (numCh > 1) {
6405:             const m = 0.5 * (l + r);
6406:             const s = 0.5 * (l - r) * sideRatio;
6407:             ch0Out[i] = m + s;
6408:             ch1Out[i] = m - s;
6409:         } else {
6410:             ch0Out[i] = l;
6411:         }
6412:     }
6413: 
6414:     if (isHugeBuf) {
6415:         const curStats = window.measureBufferStatsV76(workBuf);
6416:         const targetRms = (dna.origRms && dna.origRms > 0.0005) ? dna.origRms : (curStats.rms * 0.75);
6417:         const scale = (curStats.rms > 0.0001) ? Math.max(0.15, Math.min(6.0, targetRms / curStats.rms)) : 1.0;
6418:         for (let c = 0; c < numCh; c++) {
6419:             const d = workBuf.getChannelData(c);
6420:             for (let i = 0; i < d.length; i++) d[i] = Math.max(-0.99, Math.min(0.99, d[i] * scale));
6421:         }
6422:         workBuf._antiDspAppliedV76 = true;
6423:         workBuf._dspDnaV76 = dna;
6424:         return workBuf;
6425:     }
6426:     // 2. Обратные частотные фильтры в OfflineAudioContext (Анти-Панч, Анти-EQ, Анти-СЧ, Анти-ДеЭссер, Анти-FIR)
6427:     const offCtx = new OfflineAudioContext(numCh, len, sr);
6428:     const src = offCtx.createBufferSource();
6429:     src.buffer = workBuf;
6430:     let cur = src;
6431: 
6432:     const addFilter = (type, freq, q, gainDb) => {
6433:         if (Math.abs(gainDb) < 0.05) return;
6434:         const f = offCtx.createBiquadFilter();
6435:         f.type = type;
6436:         f.frequency.value = freq;
6437:         if (q) f.Q.value = q;
6438:         f.gain.value = Math.max(-24, Math.min(24, gainDb));
6439:         cur.connect(f);
6440:         cur = f;
6441:     };
6442: 
6443:     // Инверсия бокового эксайтера Стерео-Ширины
6444:     if (dna.opt_msWidth && (parseFloat(dna.val_msWidth) || 100) > 100) {
6445:         const w = (parseFloat(dna.val_msWidth) || 130) / 100.0;
6446:         const boostDb = Math.min(10, (w - 1.0) * 4.5);
6447:         addFilter('peaking', 135, 0.9, -boostDb * 0.35);
6448:         addFilter('highshelf', 8500, 0.7, -boostDb * 0.45);
6449:     }

6451:     // Инверсия 3-точечного Панч-Хлыста (ровно противоположные знаки!)

6454:         addFilter('peaking', 85, 1.4, -pDb * 0.75);
6455:         addFilter('peaking', 230, 1.1, +pDb * 0.35);
6456:         addFilter('peaking', 2600, 1.0, -pDb * 0.95);

6466:         }
6467:         if (dna.opt_deEsser) {

6750: // === JENNY V78 DEEP SPECTRAL BLUEPRINT & HEAVY RESYNTHESIS ===
6751: window.captureSpectralBlueprintV78 = function(srcBuf) {
6752:     if (!srcBuf) return null;
6753:     const sr = srcBuf.sampleRate;
6754:     const ch0 = srcBuf.getChannelData(0);
6755:     const ch1 = srcBuf.numberOfChannels > 1 ? srcBuf.getChannelData(1) : ch0;
6756:     const len = ch0.length;
6757:     const win = Math.max(512, Math.round(0.04 * sr)); // окна по 40 мс
6758:     const hfCurve = [];
6759:     const sideCurve = [];
6760:     for (let p = 0; p + win <= len; p += win) {
6761:         let lowE = 0.00001, hfE = 0.00001, midE = 0.00001, sideE = 0.00001;
6762:         for (let i = p + 2; i < p + win; i += 2) {
6763:             const l = ch0[i], r = ch1[i];
6764:             const prevL = ch0[i - 1], prevR = ch1[i - 1];
6765:             const prev2L = ch0[i - 2], prev2R = ch1[i - 2];
6766:             // 2-я разность выделяет ВЧ-гармоники (6..20 кГц)
6767:             const hf = Math.abs((l - 2 * prevL + prev2L) + (r - 2 * prevR + prev2R)) * 0.25;
6768:             const body = (Math.abs(l) + Math.abs(r)) * 0.5;
6769:             hfE += hf;
6770:             lowE += body;
6771:             midE += Math.abs(0.5 * (l + r));
6772:             sideE += Math.abs(0.5 * (l - r));
6773:         }
6774:         // Квантуем отношение ВЧ/Тело и Side/Mid в компактные целые 0..255 для идеального сжатия LZMA
6775:         hfCurve.push(Math.min(255, Math.round((hfE / lowE) * 180)));
6776:         sideCurve.push(Math.min(255, Math.round((sideE / midE) * 120)));
6777:     }
6778:     return { win: win, hf: hfCurve, side: sideCurve };
6779: };

6782: window.captureExportDspDnaV76 = function(srcBuf, renderedBuf, cfg) {
6783:     const dna = _origCaptureDnaV76(srcBuf, renderedBuf, cfg);
6784:     if (dna && srcBuf) {

6786:     }

6790: window.runDeepSpectralResynthesisV78 = async function(buf, smap, isShortSlice) {
6791:     if (!buf || !smap || !smap.dspDna || !smap.dspDna.specBlueprint || !window.audioCtx) return buf;
6792:     if (buf.duration > 360 && !isShortSlice) return buf;
6793:     const bp = smap.dspDna.specBlueprint;
6794:     const sr = buf.sampleRate;
6795:     const numCh = buf.numberOfChannels;
6796:     const len = buf.length;
6797: 
6798:     // 1. Синтезируем гармонический ВЧ-слой через нелинейный эксайтер + фильтр верхних частот 5.5 кГц
6799:     const offCtx = new OfflineAudioContext(numCh, len, sr);
6800:     const src = offCtx.createBufferSource();
6801:     src.buffer = buf;
6802: 
6803:     const bpFilter = offCtx.createBiquadFilter();
6804:     bpFilter.type = 'bandpass';
6805:     bpFilter.frequency.value = 3800;
6806:     bpFilter.Q.value = 0.7;
6807: 
6808:     const shaper = offCtx.createWaveShaper();
6809:     const curve = new Float32Array(8193);
6810:     for (let i = 0; i < 8193; i++) {
6811:         const x = (i - 4096) / 4096;
6812:         curve[i] = x - 0.35 * x * x * x + 0.15 * (2 * x * x - 1);
6813:     }
6814:     shaper.curve = curve;
6815: 
6816:     const hpFilter = offCtx.createBiquadFilter();
6817:     hpFilter.type = 'highpass';
6818:     hpFilter.frequency.value = 5800;
6819:     hpFilter.Q.value = 0.707;
6820: 
6821:     src.connect(bpFilter);
6822:     bpFilter.connect(shaper);
6823:     shaper.connect(hpFilter);
6824:     hpFilter.connect(offCtx.destination);
6825:     src.start(0);
6826: 
6827:     const harmonicBuf = await offCtx.startRendering();
6828: 
6829:     // 2. Покадровая калибровка ВЧ-гармоник и стерео-панорамы строго по чертежу оригинала (с плавной интерполяцией)
6830:     const win = bp.win || Math.max(512, Math.round(0.04 * sr));
6831:     const hfArr = bp.hf || [];
6832:     const sideArr = bp.side || [];
6833: 
6834:     const c0 = buf.getChannelData(0);
6835:     const c1 = numCh > 1 ? buf.getChannelData(1) : c0;
6836:     const h0 = harmonicBuf.getChannelData(0);
6837:     const h1 = numCh > 1 ? harmonicBuf.getChannelData(1) : h0;
6838: 
6839:     let prevHfBoost = 0.0;
6840:     let prevSideScale = 1.0;
6841: 
6842:     for (let wIdx = 0; wIdx < hfArr.length; wIdx++) {
6843:         const p = wIdx * win;
6844:         if (p >= len) break;
6845:         const end = Math.min(len, p + win);
6846: 
6847:         let curLowE = 0.00001, curHfE = 0.00001, harmE = 0.00001, curMidE = 0.00001, curSideE = 0.00001;
6848:         for (let i = p + 2; i < end; i += 2) {
6849:             const l = c0[i], r = c1[i];
6850:             const hf = Math.abs((l - 2 * c0[i - 1] + c0[i - 2]) + (r - 2 * c1[i - 1] + c1[i - 2])) * 0.25;
6851:             curHfE += hf;
6852:             curLowE += (Math.abs(l) + Math.abs(r)) * 0.5;
6853:             harmE += (Math.abs(h0[i]) + Math.abs(h1[i])) * 0.5;
6854:             curMidE += Math.abs(0.5 * (l + r));
6855:             curSideE += Math.abs(0.5 * (l - r));
6856:         }
6857: 
6858:         const targetHfRatio = (hfArr[wIdx] || 0) / 180.0;
6859:         const actualHfRatio = curHfE / curLowE;
6860:         const missingHfEnergy = Math.max(0.0, targetHfRatio - actualHfRatio) * curLowE;
6861:         const targetHfBoost = Math.min(1.6, missingHfEnergy / Math.max(0.0001, harmE * 1.4));
6862: 
6863:         const targetSideRatio = (sideArr[wIdx] || 0) / 120.0;
6864:         const actualSideRatio = curSideE / curMidE;
6865:         const targetSideScale = (actualSideRatio > 0.02)
6866:             ? Math.max(0.6, Math.min(2.2, targetSideRatio / actualSideRatio))
6867:             : 1.0;
6868: 
6869:         const span = Math.max(1, end - p);
6870:         for (let i = p; i < end; i++) {
6871:             const t = (i - p) / span;
6872:             const hfGain = prevHfBoost * (1.0 - t) + targetHfBoost * t;
6873:             const sScale = prevSideScale * (1.0 - t) + targetSideScale * t;
6874: 
6875:             const l = c0[i] + h0[i] * hfGain;
6876:             const r = c1[i] + h1[i] * hfGain;
6877:             if (numCh > 1) {
6878:                 const m = 0.5 * (l + r);
6879:                 const s = 0.5 * (l - r) * sScale;
6880:                 c0[i] = Math.max(-0.99, Math.min(0.99, m + s));
6881:                 c1[i] = Math.max(-0.99, Math.min(0.99, m - s));
6882:             } else {
6883:                 c0[i] = Math.max(-0.99, Math.min(0.99, l));
6884:             }
6885:         }
6886:         prevHfBoost = targetHfBoost;
6887:         prevSideScale = targetSideScale;
6888:     }
6889:     return buf;
6890: };
6891: 
6892: // Подключаем глубокий ресинтез и запрос пароля (если файл зашифрован своим ключом) при распаковке
6893: const _origApplyInvV76 = window.applyInverseDspCompensationV76;
6894: window.applyInverseDspCompensationV76 = async function(rawReconstructedBuf, smap) {
6895:     const step1 = await _origApplyInvV76(rawReconstructedBuf, smap);
6896:     return await window.runDeepSpectralResynthesisV78(step1, smap);
6897: };

585:     try {
586:         window.AndroidBridge.updateMediaState(cleanTitle, !player.paused, displayPos, dur, spd);
587:     } catch (e) {}
588: };

64: window.parseDerivedTrackInfo = function(filename) {
65:     if (!filename || typeof filename !== 'string') return { isDerived: false, baseStem: '', origStem: '' };
66:     const cleanName = filename.trim();
67:     const lastDot = cleanName.lastIndexOf('.');
68:     const origStem = lastDot > 0 ? cleanName.substring(0, lastDot) : cleanName;
69:     let stem = origStem;
70:     const suffixRe = /(?:_x\d+(?:[.,]\d+)?(?:_[a-z0-9]+)*|_(?:slow|fast)(?:_[a-z0-9]+)*|_(?:jbuf90|jbuf_shift|jbuf|web_lock|web_shift|webapi|vinyl|neutral|pitchlock|bitperfect|psycho|ultra|hifi|restored)|_rev(?:ersed)?|_fx|_eq|_dsp|_master)+$/i;
71:     let prev = null;
72:     while (stem && stem !== prev) {
73:         prev = stem;
74:         stem = stem.replace(suffixRe, '');
75:     }
76:     return {
77:         isDerived: (stem.length > 0 && stem !== origStem),
78:         baseStem: stem,
79:         origStem: origStem
80:     };
81: };

4: window.startScrub = function(side, speed) {
5:     const player = document.getElementById('audioPlayer');
6:     if (!player) return;
7: 
8:     const wasReversedNow = Boolean(window.isReversed || (window.scrubState && window.scrubState.isPhysicallyReversed));
9:     const wantReverseNow = (side === 'left');
10: 
11:     window.scrubState.active = true;
12:     window.scrubState.side = side;
13:     window.scrubState.speed = speed;
14:     window.scrubState.isPhysicallyReversed = wantReverseNow;
15:     if (!wantReverseNow) {
16:         window.isReversed = false;
17:     }
18: 
19:     window.persistedPlaybackSpeed = speed;
20:     window.persistedPlaybackSide = side;
21: 
22:     let lockEl = document.getElementById('speedLockIndicator');
23:     if (lockEl) {
24:         lockEl.style.display = 'block';
25:         lockEl.innerText = `${window.scrubState.locked ? '🔒' : '🔄'} ${wantReverseNow ? '⏪' : '⏩'} x${speed}`;
26:     }
27: 
28:     if (wasReversedNow !== wantReverseNow && isFinite(player.duration) && player.duration > 0) {
29:         let flippedPos = player.duration - player.currentTime;
30:         if (!isFinite(flippedPos) || flippedPos < 0) flippedPos = 0;
31:         player.currentTime = Math.min(player.duration, flippedPos);
32:     }
33: 
34:     let pitchLockCheckbox = document.getElementById('cfg_pitchLock');
35:     let isPitchLocked = pitchLockCheckbox ? pitchLockCheckbox.checked : (window.appConfig && window.appConfig.pitchLock);
36: 
37:     try { player.playbackRate = Math.max(0.1, Math.min(16.0, speed)); } catch(e) {}
38:     player.preservesPitch = Boolean(isPitchLocked && !wantReverseNow && !(window.appConfig && window.appConfig.elasticHoseMode));
39: 
40:     if (typeof window.syncMasterPlaybackEngineV59 === 'function') {
41:         window.syncMasterPlaybackEngineV59(true);
42:     }
43: 
44:     if (player.paused) player.play().catch(e => {});
45: };

47: window.stopScrub = function(keepLockedSpeed = false) {
48:     const player = document.getElementById('audioPlayer');
49:     if (!window.scrubState.active && !window.scrubState.locked && !window.isReversed) return;
50: 
51:     const wasReversedNow = Boolean(window.isReversed || (window.scrubState && window.scrubState.isPhysicallyReversed));
52: 
53:     if (!keepLockedSpeed) {
54:         window.scrubState.active = false;
55:         window.scrubState.locked = false;
56:         window.scrubState.side = null;
57:         window.scrubState.speed = typeof window.getBaseSpeed === 'function' ? window.getBaseSpeed() : 1.0;
58:         window.scrubState.isPhysicallyReversed = false;
59:         window.persistedPlaybackSpeed = null;
60:         window.persistedPlaybackSide = 'right';
61: 
62:         let lockEl = document.getElementById('speedLockIndicator');
63:         if (lockEl) lockEl.style.display = 'none';
64:     } else {
65:         window.scrubState.active = false;
66:     }
67: 
68:     const nowReversed = Boolean(window.isReversed || (window.scrubState && window.scrubState.isPhysicallyReversed));
69: 
70:     if (player) {
71:         let baseSpd = (keepLockedSpeed && window.persistedPlaybackSpeed)
72:             ? window.persistedPlaybackSpeed
73:             : (typeof window.getBaseSpeed === 'function' ? window.getBaseSpeed() : 1.0);
74: 
75:         if (wasReversedNow !== nowReversed && isFinite(player.duration) && player.duration > 0) {
76:             player.currentTime = Math.max(0, Math.min(player.duration, player.duration - player.currentTime));
77:         }
78: 
79:         let pitchLockCheckbox = document.getElementById('cfg_pitchLock');
80:         let isPitchLocked = pitchLockCheckbox ? pitchLockCheckbox.checked : (window.appConfig && window.appConfig.pitchLock);
81: 
82:         player.playbackRate = baseSpd;
83:         player.preservesPitch = Boolean(isPitchLocked && !nowReversed && !(window.appConfig && window.appConfig.elasticHoseMode));
84: 
85:         if (typeof window.syncMasterPlaybackEngineV59 === 'function') {
86:             window.syncMasterPlaybackEngineV59(false);
87:         }
88:         if (player.paused) player.play().catch(e => {});
89:     }

116:     function generateArc() {
117:         arcContainer.innerHTML = '';
118:         arcItems = [];
119:         circleAngles = [];
120: 
121:         let activeZones = [];
122:         for (let i = 1; i <= 6; i++) {
123:             let en = document.getElementById('cfg_z' + i + '_en');
124:             let val = document.getElementById('cfg_z' + i + '_val');
125:             if (en && en.checked && val) {
126:                 activeZones.push(parseFloat(val.value) || 1.0);
127:             }
128:         }
129:         if (activeZones.length === 0) activeZones = [1.0];
130: 
131:         let isLeftHanded = Boolean(window.appConfig && window.appConfig.leftHandedMode);
132:         const W = window.innerWidth;
133:         const H = window.innerHeight;
134: 
135:         const eqBtn = document.getElementById('btn-eqModal');
136:         if (eqBtn) {
137:             const eqRect = eqBtn.getBoundingClientRect();
138:             currentAnchor.x = eqRect.left + eqRect.width / 2;
139:             currentAnchor.y = eqRect.top + eqRect.height / 2;
140:         } else {
141:             currentAnchor.y = H - 135;
142:             currentAnchor.x = isLeftHanded ? 31 : (W - 31);
143:         }
144: 
145:         // Строим плавную дугу вокруг опорной точки (от середины экрана через край вниз к доку)
146:         // и параметризуем её по длине дуги, чтобы расстояние между кружками было идеально равным!
147:         const startDeg = -108; // Верхний кружок (ниже поиска, правее центра)
148:         const endDeg   = -204; // Нижний кружок (внизу у панели навигации)
149:         const rTop     = Math.min(W * 0.76, H * 0.35);
150:         const rMid     = Math.min(W * 0.78, H * 0.36);
151:         const rBot     = Math.min(W * 0.58, H * 0.26);
152: 
153:         function sampleCurvePoint(u) {
154:             const deg = startDeg + u * (endDeg - startDeg);
155:             const rad = deg * Math.PI / 180;
156:             // Плавный профиль радиуса: широкий изгиб посередине и аккуратный заход вниз
157:             const r = (1 - u) * (1 - u) * rTop + 2 * (1 - u) * u * rMid + u * u * rBot;
158:             const dxRH = r * Math.cos(rad);
159:             const dy = r * Math.sin(rad);
160:             const x = currentAnchor.x + (isLeftHanded ? -dxRH : dxRH);
161:             const y = currentAnchor.y + dy;
162:             return {
163:                 x: Math.max(30, Math.min(W - 30, x)),
164:                 y: Math.max(150, Math.min(H - 32, y))
165:             };
166:         }
167: 
168:         const STEPS = 240;
169:         const samples = [];
170:         let totalLen = 0;
171:         for (let k = 0; k <= STEPS; k++) {
172:             const pt = sampleCurvePoint(k / STEPS);
173:             if (k > 0) {
174:                 totalLen += Math.hypot(pt.x - samples[k - 1].x, pt.y - samples[k - 1].y);
175:             }
176:             samples.push({ x: pt.x, y: pt.y, s: totalLen });
177:         }
178: 
179:         const count = activeZones.length;
180:         const positions = [];
181:         for (let i = 0; i < count; i++) {
182:             const targetS = count === 1 ? (totalLen * 0.5) : (totalLen * (i / (count - 1)));
183:             let best = samples[0];
184:             for (let k = 0; k < samples.length; k++) {
185:                 if (samples[k].s >= targetS) {
186:                     best = samples[k];
187:                     break;
188:                 }
189:             }
190:             positions.push(best);
191:         }
192: 
193:         activeZones.forEach((val, index) => {
194:             if (index >= positions.length) return;
195: 
196:             let el = document.createElement('div');
197:             el.className = 'arc-item';
198:             el.innerText = 'x' + (val % 1 === 0 ? val.toFixed(1) : val.toString());
199:             el.dataset.val = val;
200: 
201:             el.style.left = `${positions[index].x - 24}px`;
202:             el.style.top = `${positions[index].y - 24}px`;
203: 
204:             let angle = Math.atan2(positions[index].y - currentAnchor.y, positions[index].x - currentAnchor.x) * 180 / Math.PI;
205:             circleAngles.push(angle);
206: 
207:             arcContainer.appendChild(el);
208:             arcItems.push(el);
209:         });
210: 
211:         arcContainer.style.display = 'block';
212:         setTimeout(() => { arcContainer.style.opacity = '1'; }, 10);
213: 
214:         drawDebugWheel(currentAnchor.x, currentAnchor.y, circleAngles);
215:     }
216:

280:     function handleTouchMove(e) {
281:         let curX = getX(e);
282:         let curY = getY(e);
283:         let deltaY = curY - startY;
284: 
285:         if (scrubSide === 'center') {
286:             if (Math.abs(deltaY) > 15 && pressTimer) {
287:                 clearTimeout(pressTimer);
288:                 pressTimer = null;
289:             }
290:             return;
291:         }
292: 
293:         let threshold = window.innerHeight * 0.05; 
294: 
295:         if (Math.abs(deltaY) > threshold || isScrubbing) {
296:             isSeekingAllowed = false; 
297:             if (pressTimer) { clearTimeout(pressTimer); pressTimer = null; }
298: 
299:             if (!isScrubbing) {
300:                 isScrubbing = true;

225: window.sortTrackArrayForTabV71 = function(tracksArr, tabId) {
226:     window.ensurePlaylistStateV71();
227:     const isCustomTab = (tabId === 'fav' || String(tabId).startsWith('pl_'));
228:     const defM = isCustomTab ? 'custom' : 'mtime';
229:     const smap = window.appConfig.playlistSortMapV71 || {};
230:     const sc = smap[tabId] || { mode: defM, dir: defM === 'custom' ? 'asc' : 'desc' };
231:     const mode = sc.mode || defM;
232:     const mul = sc.dir === 'asc' ? 1 : -1;
233:     const stats = window.appConfig.trackPlayStatsV71 || {};
234:     const arr = [...tracksArr];
235:     if (mode === 'custom') return sc.dir === 'desc' ? arr.reverse() : arr;
236: 
237:     arr.sort((a, b) => {
238:         const ma = window.getTrackMetaV71(a);
239:         const mb = window.getTrackMetaV71(b);
240:         if (mode === 'name') return String(a).toLowerCase().localeCompare(String(b).toLowerCase()) * mul;
241:         if (mode === 'mtime') return ((ma.mtime || 0) - (mb.mtime || 0)) * mul;
242:         if (mode === 'duration') return ((ma.dur || 0) - (mb.dur || 0)) * mul;
243:         if (mode === 'size') return ((ma.size || 0) - (mb.size || 0)) * mul;
244:         if (mode === 'plays') return (((stats[a] && stats[a].count) || 0) - ((stats[b] && stats[b].count) || 0)) * mul;
245:         return 0;
246:     });
247:     return arr;
248: };

915: // === V71.4 INSTANT HORIZON SPLICER FOR LONG TRACKS (5ms ZERO-LAG JBUF) & MODAL HEADER CLEANUP ===

917: window._horizonSliceTimerV71 = null;

919: // Вырезает окно [startSec .. startSec + winSec] из гигантского буфера в маленький AudioBuffer (при необходимости разворачивая для реверса)
920: window.extractWindowBufferV71 = function(srcBuf, startSec, winSec, isRev) {
921:     if (!srcBuf || !window.audioCtx) return null;
922:     const player = document.getElementById('audioPlayer');
923:     const sr = srcBuf.sampleRate;
924:     const numCh = srcBuf.numberOfChannels;
925:     const totalLen = srcBuf.length;
926:     const dur = srcBuf.duration;
927: 
928:     if (!isRev) {
929:         let cleanStart = Math.max(0, Math.min(dur - 0.05, startSec));
930:         let startFrame = Math.min(totalLen - 256, Math.max(0, Math.floor(cleanStart * sr)));
931:         let frameCount = Math.max(256, Math.min(Math.floor(winSec * sr), totalLen - startFrame));
932:         let subBuf = window.audioCtx.createBuffer(numCh, frameCount, sr);
933:         for (let c = 0; c < numCh; c++) {
934:             subBuf.getChannelData(c).set(srcBuf.getChannelData(c).subarray(startFrame, startFrame + frameCount));
935:         }
936:         return subBuf;
937:     } else {
938:         // При реверсе player.currentTime = dur - realForwardSec, поэтому позиция в прямом буфере = dur - startSec
939:         const refDur = (player && isFinite(player.duration) && player.duration > 0) ? player.duration : dur;
940:         let forwardPosSec = Math.max(0.15, Math.min(dur, refDur - startSec));
941:         let revEndFrame = Math.min(totalLen, Math.max(256, Math.floor(forwardPosSec * sr)));
942:         let frameCount = Math.max(256, Math.min(Math.floor(winSec * sr), revEndFrame));
943:         let subBuf = window.audioCtx.createBuffer(numCh, frameCount, sr);
944:         for (let c = 0; c < numCh; c++) {
945:             const inp = srcBuf.getChannelData(c);
946:             const out = subBuf.getChannelData(c);
947:             for (let i = 0; i < frameCount; i++) {
948:                 out[i] = inp[revEndFrame - 1 - i];
949:             }
950:         }
951:         return subBuf;
952:     }
953: };

1491: // Универсальный детектор зажатия 180 мс для горизонтальных лент (не мешает свайпу прокрутки и коротким тапам)
1492: window.attachStripLongPressV73 = function(stripEl, onLongPress) {
1493:     if (!stripEl || stripEl._longPressBoundV73) return;
1494:     stripEl._longPressBoundV73 = true;
1495: 
1496:     let timer = null;
1497:     let startX = 0;
1498:     let startY = 0;
1499:     let moved = false;
1500: 
1501:     const clearTimer = () => {
1502:         if (timer) {
1503:             clearTimeout(timer);
1504:             timer = null;
1505:         }
1506:     };
1507: 
1508:     // Блокируем случайный click по чипу после срабатывания 180 мс зажатия
1509:     stripEl.addEventListener('click', (e) => {
1510:         if (window._suppressNextStripClickV73) {
1511:             e.stopPropagation();
1512:             e.preventDefault();
1513:             window._suppressNextStripClickV73 = false;
1514:         }
1515:     }, true);
1516: 
1517:     stripEl.addEventListener('touchstart', (e) => {
1518:         if (!e.touches || e.touches.length !== 1) return;
1519:         moved = false;
1520:         startX = e.touches[0].clientX;
1521:         startY = e.touches[0].clientY;
1522:         clearTimer();
1523:         timer = setTimeout(() => {
1524:             timer = null;
1525:             if (!moved) {
1526:                 window._suppressNextStripClickV73 = true;
1527:                 setTimeout(() => { window._suppressNextStripClickV73 = false; }, 450);
1528:                 try { navigator.vibrate(35); } catch (err) {}
1529:                 onLongPress(e);
1530:             }
1531:         }, 180);
1532:     }, { passive: true });
1533: 
1534:     stripEl.addEventListener('touchmove', (e) => {
1535:         if (!timer || !e.touches || e.touches.length === 0) return;
1536:         const dx = Math.abs(e.touches[0].clientX - startX);
1537:         const dy = Math.abs(e.touches[0].clientY - startY);
1538:         if (dx > 10 || dy > 10) {
1539:             moved = true;
1540:             clearTimer();
1541:         }
1542:     }, { passive: true });
1543: 
1544:     stripEl.addEventListener('touchend', clearTimer, { passive: true });
1545:     stripEl.addEventListener('touchcancel', clearTimer, { passive: true });
1546: };

1618: // Точная фильтрация треков внутри текущего выделенного объекта (по имени файла, артисту и альбому)
1619: window.filterTracks = function(query) {
1620:     const sInp = document.getElementById('trackSearchInput');
1621:     const rawQ = (query !== undefined && query !== null) ? String(query) : (sInp ? sInp.value : '');
1622:     const lowerQuery = rawQ.trim().toLowerCase();
1623: 
1624:     const clrBtn = document.getElementById('btnClearTrackSearchV73');
1625:     if (clrBtn) {
1626:         clrBtn.style.display = rawQ.length > 0 ? 'inline-flex' : 'none';
1627:     }
1628: 
1629:     const uList = document.getElementById('unifiedList');
1630:     if (!uList) return;
1631:

1633:     let totalRows = 0;

1635:     uList.querySelectorAll('.track-row-capsule').forEach(cap => {
1636:         const wrapper = cap.parentElement;

1639:         if (!trackName) return;
1640:

1642:         if (window.isTrackAllowedByFormatSlots && !window.isTrackAllowedByFormatSlots(trackName)) {
1643:             wrapper.style.display = 'none';
1644:             return;
1645:         }
1646:

1648:         if (!lowerQuery) {
1649:             wrapper.style.display = 'block';
1650:             visibleCount++;
1651:             return;
1652:         }
1653: 
1654:         const meta = window.getTrackMetaV71 ? window.getTrackMetaV71(trackName) : { artist: '', album: '' };
1655:         const haystack = (trackName + ' ' + (meta.artist || '') + ' ' + (meta.album || '')).toLowerCase();
1656:         const isMatch = haystack.includes(lowerQuery);
1657:         wrapper.style.display = isMatch ? 'block' : 'none';

1664:     }

1671:             emptySearchMsg.style.cssText = 'padding:18px 10px;color:#8b949e;text-align:center;font-size:12.5px;';

1673:         }

1675:             `По запросу «${rawQ.trim()}» в текущем разделе ничего не найдено`,
1676:             `No tracks matching "${rawQ.trim()}" in current view`
1677:         );
1678:         emptySearchMsg.style.display = 'block';
1679:     } else if (emptySearchMsg) {
1680:         emptySearchMsg.style.display = 'none';
1681:     }
1682: };

14288:     float lumaLod(sampler2D t, vec2 uv, float lod) {
14289:         return dot(textureLod(t, clamp(uv, 0.001, 0.999), lod).rgb, vec3(0.299, 0.587, 0.114));

14292:     vec2 estimateLayerFlow(vec2 uv, float lod, float stepScale, vec2 priorFlow) {
14293:         vec2 st = u_texel * stepScale;
14294:         vec2 uvPrev = clamp(uv - priorFlow * 0.5, 0.001, 0.999);
14295:         vec2 uvCurr = clamp(uv + priorFlow * 0.5, 0.001, 0.999);
14296: 
14297:         float pC = lumaLod(u_prevTex, uvPrev, lod);
14298:         float cC = lumaLod(u_currTex, uvCurr, lod);
14299: 
14300:         float pR = lumaLod(u_prevTex, uvPrev + vec2(st.x, 0.0), lod);
14301:         float pL = lumaLod(u_prevTex, uvPrev - vec2(st.x, 0.0), lod);
14302:         float pD = lumaLod(u_prevTex, uvPrev + vec2(0.0, st.y), lod);
14303:         float pU = lumaLod(u_prevTex, uvPrev - vec2(0.0, st.y), lod);
14304: 
14305:         float cR = lumaLod(u_currTex, uvCurr + vec2(st.x, 0.0), lod);
14306:         float cL = lumaLod(u_currTex, uvCurr - vec2(st.x, 0.0), lod);
14307:         float cD = lumaLod(u_currTex, uvCurr + vec2(0.0, st.y), lod);
14308:         float cU = lumaLod(u_currTex, uvCurr - vec2(0.0, st.y), lod);
14309: 
14310:         float Ix = 0.25 * ((pR - pL) + (cR - cL));
14311:         float Iy = 0.25 * ((pD - pU) + (cD - cU));
14312:         float It = cC - pC;
14313: 
14314:         float mag2 = Ix * Ix + Iy * Iy + 0.0012;
14315:         vec2 dFlow = clamp((-It / mag2) * vec2(Ix, Iy), -3.5, 3.5) * st;
14316:         return priorFlow + dFlow;
14317:     }
14318: 
14319:     float blockResidual(vec2 uv, vec2 flow, float lod) {
14320:         vec2 p0 = clamp(uv - flow * 0.5, 0.001, 0.999);
14321:         vec2 p1 = clamp(uv + flow * 0.5, 0.001, 0.999);
14322:         vec3 d0 = abs(textureLod(u_currTex, p1, lod).rgb - textureLod(u_prevTex, p0, lod).rgb);
14323:         float eC = max(d0.r, max(d0.g, d0.b));
14324:         vec2 ox = vec2(u_texel.x * 2.5, 0.0);
14325:         vec2 oy = vec2(0.0, u_texel.y * 2.5);
14326:         float eX = abs(lumaLod(u_currTex, p1 + ox, lod) - lumaLod(u_prevTex, p0 + ox, lod)) +
14327:                    abs(lumaLod(u_currTex, p1 - ox, lod) - lumaLod(u_prevTex, p0 - ox, lod));
14328:         float eY = abs(lumaLod(u_currTex, p1 + oy, lod) - lumaLod(u_prevTex, p0 + oy, lod)) +
14329:                    abs(lumaLod(u_currTex, p1 - oy, lod) - lumaLod(u_prevTex, p0 - oy, lod));
14330:         return eC * 0.55 + (eX + eY) * 0.1125;
14331:     }

14333:     void main() {

14345:         vec2 flowCoarse = estimateLayerFlow(uv, 3.0, 6.0, vec2(0.0));
14346:         vec2 flowMid    = estimateLayerFlow(uv, 2.0, 3.0, flowCoarse);

14358:         // Радиальный вектор от центра экрана (для сцен разлета звезд / зума камеры)
14359:         vec2 radialDir = (uv - vec2(0.5)) * u_texel * (maxRad * 0.85);
14360:         float errRad = blockResidual(uv, radialDir, 1.5);
14361:         if (errRad < bestErr) { bestErr = errRad; bestFlow = radialDir; }
14362: 
14363:         const vec2 dirs[8] = vec2[8](
14364:             vec2(1.0, 0.0), vec2(-1.0, 0.0), vec2(0.0, 1.0), vec2(0.0, -1.0),
14365:             vec2(0.707, 0.707), vec2(-0.707, 0.707), vec2(0.707, -0.707), vec2(-0.707, -0.707)
14366:         );
14367:         for (int i = 0; i < 8; i++) {
14368:             vec2 candWide = dirs[i] * u_texel * (maxRad * 0.65);
14369:             float eW = blockResidual(uv, candWide, 2.2);
14370:             if (eW < bestErr) { bestErr = eW; bestFlow = candWide; }
14371:         }
14372:         vec2 baseWide = bestFlow;
14373:         for (int i = 0; i < 8; i++) {
14374:             vec2 candMid = baseWide + dirs[i] * u_texel * (maxRad * 0.25);
14375:             float eM = blockResidual(uv, candMid, 1.2);
14376:             if (eM < bestErr) { bestErr = eM; bestFlow = candMid; }
14377:         }
14378: 
14379:         bestFlow = estimateLayerFlow(uv, 0.8, 1.2, bestFlow);
14380: 
14381:         // ШАГ 3: Forward-Backward проверка заслонов (Occlusion)
14382:         float fwdErr = abs(lumaLod(u_currTex, uv + bestFlow, 1.0) - lumaLod(u_prevTex, uv, 1.0));
14383:         float bwdErr = abs(lumaLod(u_prevTex, uv - bestFlow, 1.0) - lumaLod(u_currTex, uv, 1.0));
14384:         float occAsym = clamp(abs(fwdErr - bwdErr) * 3.5, 0.0, 1.0);
14385: 
14386:         vec2 maxUv = u_texel * maxRad;
14387:         vec2 normFlow = clamp(bestFlow / max(maxUv, vec2(1e-5)), -1.0, 1.0);
14388:         float conf = clamp((zeroErr - bestErr) * 6.5 + coarseWake * 2.5, 0.0, 1.0);
14389: 
14390:         outMV = vec4(normFlow * 0.5 + 0.5, conf, occAsym);
14391:     }`;
14392: 
14393:     // ШАГ 4 (1080p, 120 Гц): ДВИЖЕНИЕ ПОЛНЫХ ОРИГИНАЛЬНЫХ КАДРОВ + ЗАСЛОНЫ + РЕЗКОСТЬ ГРАНИЦ (CAS)
14394:     const FS_WARP_PASS = `#version 300 es
14395:     precision highp float;
14396:     in vec2 v_uv;
14397:     uniform sampler2D u_prevTex;
14398:     uniform sampler2D u_currTex;
14399:     uniform sampler2D u_mvTex;
14400:     uniform float u_alpha;
14401:     uniform vec2 u_texel;
14402:     uniform float u_flowScale;
14403:     uniform float u_ghostGate;
14404:     uniform float u_detailGuard;
14405:     uniform float u_bridgeSpread;
14406:     uniform float u_searchRadius;
14407:     uniform float u_inkGuard;
14408:     uniform float u_splitPos;
14409:     out vec4 outColor;
14410: 
14411:     float luma(vec3 c) {
14412:         return dot(c, vec3(0.299, 0.587, 0.114));
14413:     }
14414: 
14415:     vec4 readMV(vec2 uv, vec2 maxUv) {
14416:         vec4 m = texture(u_mvTex, clamp(uv, 0.002, 0.998));
14417:         vec2 fl = (m.rg - 0.5) * 2.0 * maxUv;
14418:         return vec4(fl, m.b, m.a);
14419:     }
14420: 
14421:     void main() {
14422:         vec2 uv = clamp(v_uv, vec2(0.001), vec2(0.999));
14423: 
14424:         if (abs(u_splitPos) > 0.001) {
14425:             float sp = abs(u_splitPos);
14426:             bool isOrigSide = (u_splitPos > 0.0) ? (uv.x < sp) : (uv.x >= sp);
14427:             if (isOrigSide) {
14428:                 outColor = textureLod(u_prevTex, uv, 0.0);
14429:                 return;
14430:             }
14431:         }
14432: 
14433:         if (u_alpha >= 0.995) {
14434:             outColor = textureLod(u_currTex, uv, 0.0);
14435:             return;
14436:         }
14437: 
14438:         vec4 cPrev = textureLod(u_prevTex, uv, 0.0);
14439:         vec4 cCurr = textureLod(u_currTex, uv, 0.0);
14440:         vec4 smoothFallback = mix(cPrev, cCurr, smoothstep(0.12, 0.88, u_alpha));
14441: 
14442:         vec3 rawDiff = abs(cCurr.rgb - cPrev.rgb);
14443:         float pixelDiff = max(rawDiff.r, max(rawDiff.g, rawDiff.b));
14444: 
14445:         float maxRad = clamp(u_searchRadius, 4.0, 48.0);
14446:         vec2 maxUv = u_texel * maxRad;
14447:         vec4 mC = readMV(uv, maxUv);
14448: 
14449:         if (pixelDiff < 0.0045 && mC.z < 0.07) {
14450:             outColor = mix(cPrev, cCurr, u_alpha);
14451:             return;
14452:         }
14453: 
14454:         vec2 blockFlow = mC.xy;
14455:         float occMask = mC.w;
14456:         if (u_bridgeSpread > 0.01) {
14457:             vec2 mvStep = vec2(1.0 / 240.0, 1.0 / 135.0) * (0.5 + u_bridgeSpread);
14458:             vec4 mL = readMV(uv - vec2(mvStep.x, 0.0), maxUv);
14459:             vec4 mR = readMV(uv + vec2(mvStep.x, 0.0), maxUv);
14460:             vec4 mU = readMV(uv - vec2(0.0, mvStep.y), maxUv);
14461:             vec4 mD = readMV(uv + vec2(0.0, mvStep.y), maxUv);
14462: 
14463:             float wC = mC.z * 3.0 + 0.15;
14464:             float wL = mL.z * u_bridgeSpread;
14465:             float wR = mR.z * u_bridgeSpread;
14466:             float wU = mU.z * u_bridgeSpread;
14467:             float wD = mD.z * u_bridgeSpread;
14468:             blockFlow = (mC.xy * wC + mL.xy * wL + mR.xy * wR + mU.xy * wU + mD.xy * wD) / (wC + wL + wR + wU + wD);
14469: 
14470:             if (mC.z < 0.08) {
14471:                 vec4 mMax = mL;
14472:                 if (mR.z > mMax.z) mMax = mR;
14473:                 if (mU.z > mMax.z) mMax = mU;
14474:                 if (mD.z > mMax.z) mMax = mD;
14475:                 if (mMax.z > 0.20) {
14476:                     blockFlow = mix(blockFlow, mMax.xy, u_bridgeSpread * 0.65);
14477:                 }
14478:             }
14479:         }
14480:         blockFlow *= abs(u_flowScale);
14481: 
14482:         vec2 s1 = u_texel * 1.5;
14483:         float lR = 0.5 * (luma(textureLod(u_currTex, uv + vec2(s1.x, 0.0), 0.0).rgb) + luma(textureLod(u_prevTex, uv + vec2(s1.x, 0.0), 0.0).rgb));
14484:         float lL = 0.5 * (luma(textureLod(u_currTex, uv - vec2(s1.x, 0.0), 0.0).rgb) + luma(textureLod(u_prevTex, uv - vec2(s1.x, 0.0), 0.0).rgb));
14485:         float lD = 0.5 * (luma(textureLod(u_currTex, uv + vec2(0.0, s1.y), 0.0).rgb) + luma(textureLod(u_prevTex, uv + vec2(0.0, s1.y), 0.0).rgb));
14486:         float lU = 0.5 * (luma(textureLod(u_currTex, uv - vec2(0.0, s1.y), 0.0).rgb) + luma(textureLod(u_prevTex, uv - vec2(0.0, s1.y), 0.0).rgb));
14487:         float Ix = (lR - lL) * 0.33;
14488:         float Iy = (lD - lU) * 0.33;
14489:         float It = luma(cCurr.rgb) - luma(cPrev.rgb);
14490:         vec2 microFlow = clamp((-It / (Ix * Ix + Iy * Iy + 0.0018)) * vec2(Ix, Iy) * abs(u_flowScale), -3.5, 3.5) * u_texel;
14491: 
14492:         vec4 bPrev = textureLod(u_prevTex, clamp(uv - blockFlow * u_alpha, 0.001, 0.999), 0.0);
14493:         vec4 bCurr = textureLod(u_currTex, clamp(uv + blockFlow * (1.0 - u_alpha), 0.001, 0.999), 0.0);
14494:         vec3 bDiff = abs(bCurr.rgb - bPrev.rgb);
14495:         float errBlock = max(bDiff.r, max(bDiff.g, bDiff.b));
14496: 
14497:         vec4 mPrev = textureLod(u_prevTex, clamp(uv - microFlow * u_alpha, 0.001, 0.999), 0.0);
14498:         vec4 mCurr = textureLod(u_currTex, clamp(uv + microFlow * (1.0 - u_alpha), 0.001, 0.999), 0.0);
14499:         vec3 mDiff = abs(mCurr.rgb - mPrev.rgb);
14500:         float errMicro = max(mDiff.r, max(mDiff.g, mDiff.b));
14501: 
14502:         float preferMicro = clamp((errBlock - errMicro + 0.012) * 8.0, 0.0, 1.0) * u_detailGuard;
14503:         vec4 wPrev = mix(bPrev, mPrev, preferMicro);
14504:         vec4 wCurr = mix(bCurr, mCurr, preferMicro);
14505:         float resW = mix(errBlock, errMicro, preferMicro);
14506: 
14507:         // В зонах заслона (Occlusion) уменьшаем смешивание двух кадров, чтобы не было двойных ореолов
14508:         float blendWeight = mix(u_alpha, (u_alpha < 0.5 ? 0.15 : 0.85), occMask * 0.65);
14509:         vec4 warped = mix(wPrev, wCurr, blendWeight);
14510: 
14511:         // Фильтр сохранения четкости контуров и CAS-резкости на промежуточных фазах
14512:         float midWindow = 4.0 * u_alpha * (1.0 - u_alpha);
14513:         float lMin = min(luma(wPrev.rgb), luma(wCurr.rgb));
14514:         float inkKeep = (1.0 - smoothstep(0.05, 0.22, lMin)) * clamp(u_inkGuard, 0.0, 0.85) * midWindow;
14515:         warped = mix(warped, min(wPrev, wCurr), inkKeep);
14516: 
14517:         // Contrast-Adaptive Sharpening (CAS) компенсация билинейного сглаживания
14518:         vec3 casDetail = (cPrev.rgb * (1.0 - u_alpha) + cCurr.rgb * u_alpha) - smoothFallback.rgb;
14519:         warped.rgb = clamp(warped.rgb + casDetail * (0.22 * midWindow * u_detailGuard), 0.0, 1.0);
14520: 
14521:         float gate = max(0.03, u_ghostGate * 1.5);
14522:         float trust = 1.0 - smoothstep(gate * 0.60, gate * 1.35, resW);
14523: 
14524:         outColor = mix(smoothFallback, warped, trust);
14525:     }`;

14527:     function compileProgram(vsSrc, fsSrc) {
14528:         const vs = gl.createShader(gl.VERTEX_SHADER);
14529:         gl.shaderSource(vs, vsSrc);
14530:         gl.compileShader(vs);
14531:         if (!gl.getShaderParameter(vs, gl.COMPILE_STATUS)) return null;
14532: 
14533:         const fs = gl.createShader(gl.FRAGMENT_SHADER);
14534:         gl.shaderSource(fs, fsSrc);
14535:         gl.compileShader(fs);
14536:         if (!gl.getShaderParameter(fs, gl.COMPILE_STATUS)) return null;
14537: 
14538:         const p = gl.createProgram();
14539:         gl.attachShader(p, vs);
14540:         gl.attachShader(p, fs);
14541:         gl.linkProgram(p);
14542:         return gl.getProgramParameter(p, gl.LINK_STATUS) ? p : null;
14543:     }

14545:     function createTex(isMV) {
14546:         const t = gl.createTexture();
14547:         gl.bindTexture(gl.TEXTURE_2D, t);
14548:         gl.texParameteri(gl.TEXTURE_2D, gl.TEXTURE_WRAP_S, gl.CLAMP_TO_EDGE);
14549:         gl.texParameteri(gl.TEXTURE_2D, gl.TEXTURE_WRAP_T, gl.CLAMP_TO_EDGE);
14550:         if (isMV) {
14551:             gl.texParameteri(gl.TEXTURE_2D, gl.TEXTURE_MIN_FILTER, gl.LINEAR);
14552:             gl.texParameteri(gl.TEXTURE_2D, gl.TEXTURE_MAG_FILTER, gl.LINEAR);
14553:         } else {
14554:             gl.texParameteri(gl.TEXTURE_2D, gl.TEXTURE_MIN_FILTER, gl.LINEAR_MIPMAP_LINEAR);
14555:             gl.texParameteri(gl.TEXTURE_2D, gl.TEXTURE_MAG_FILTER, gl.LINEAR);
14556:             gl.texParameteri(gl.TEXTURE_2D, gl.TEXTURE_BASE_LEVEL, 0);
14557:             gl.texParameteri(gl.TEXTURE_2D, gl.TEXTURE_MAX_LEVEL, 3);
14558:         }
14559:         return t;
14560:     }

14688:     function isDuplicateVideoFrame(vid) {
14689:         try {
14690:             const tun = window._jennyTunerV190 || {};
14691:             const tol = Number.isFinite(tun.dupThresh) ? Math.round(tun.dupThresh) : 10;
14692:             if (tol <= 0) {
14693:                 consecutiveSkippedDups = 0;
14694:                 activePairSpanFrames = 1;
14695:                 return false;
14696:             }
14697:             // Сверхлегкая матрица 16x9 (144 точки) — минимум задержки на чтение
14698:             const PW = 16, PH = 9, NPX = PW * PH;
14699:             if (!dupProbeCanvas) {
14700:                 dupProbeCanvas = document.createElement('canvas');
14701:                 dupProbeCanvas.width = PW;
14702:                 dupProbeCanvas.height = PH;
14703:                 dupProbeCtx = dupProbeCanvas.getContext('2d', { willReadFrequently: true });
14704:                 lastUniqueThumbLuma = new Uint8Array(NPX);
14705:             }
14706:             dupProbeCtx.drawImage(vid, 0, 0, PW, PH);
14707:             const rgba = dupProbeCtx.getImageData(0, 0, PW, PH).data;
14708:             if (!hasValidFramePair) {
14709:                 for (let i = 0, p = 0; i < NPX; i++, p += 4) {
14710:                     lastUniqueThumbLuma[i] = (rgba[p] * 77 + rgba[p + 1] * 150 + rgba[p + 2] * 29) >> 8;
14711:                 }
14712:                 return false;
14713:             }
14714: 
14715:             let samePixels = 0;
14716:             for (let i = 0, p = 0; i < NPX; i++, p += 4) {
14717:                 const y = (rgba[p] * 77 + rgba[p + 1] * 150 + rgba[p + 2] * 29) >> 8;
14718:                 if (Math.abs(y - lastUniqueThumbLuma[i]) <= tol) {
14719:                     samePixels++;
14720:                 }
14721:             }
14722:             const sameRatio = samePixels / NPX;
14723: 
14724:             // ЗАЩИТА СНЯТА: отсекаем дубли без лимита подряд, пока >= 95% пикселей лежат в коридоре +-tol!
14725:             if (sameRatio >= 0.95) {
14726:                 consecutiveSkippedDups++;
14727:                 window._jennySkippedDupsTotal = (window._jennySkippedDupsTotal || 0) + 1;
14728:                 return true;
14729:             }
14730: 
14731:             for (let i = 0, p = 0; i < NPX; i++, p += 4) {
14732:                 lastUniqueThumbLuma[i] = (rgba[p] * 77 + rgba[p + 1] * 150 + rgba[p + 2] * 29) >> 8;
14733:             }
14734:             activePairSpanFrames = consecutiveSkippedDups + 1;
14735:             consecutiveSkippedDups = 0;
14736:             return false;
14737:         } catch (e) {
14738:             return false;
14739:         }
14740:     }

14742:     function runMotionVectorPass() {
14743:         if (!gl || !progMV || !fboMV || !hasValidFramePair) return;
14744:         const tun = window._jennyTunerV190 || {};
14745:         const searchRad = Number.isFinite(tun.searchRadius) ? tun.searchRadius : 15.0;

14766:     function onNewDecodedVideoFrame(vid, now) {

14771:             const q = vid.getVideoPlaybackQuality();

14824:         window.computeExactVideoSplitUvV208 = function(vid, stageRatio) {
14825:         const r = Math.max(0.02, Math.min(0.98, Number(stageRatio) || 0.5));
14826:         if (!vid || !glCanvas) return r;
14827:         const stage = document.getElementById('jennyVideoStageV130') || vid.parentElement;
14828:         if (!stage) return r;
14829: 
14830:         const stageW = stage.clientWidth || glCanvas.clientWidth || 1;
14831:         const stageH = stage.clientHeight || glCanvas.clientHeight || 1;
14832:         const vw = vid.videoWidth || glCanvas.width || 1;
14833:         const vh = vid.videoHeight || glCanvas.height || 1;
14834:         if (stageW < 16 || stageH < 16 || vw < 16 || vh < 16) return r;
14835: 
14836:         const fit = (vid.style && vid.style.objectFit) || (window._vidStateV130 && window._vidStateV130.fitMode) || 'contain';
14837:         if (fit === 'fill') return r;
14838: 
14839:         const stageAspect = stageW / stageH;
14840:         const vidAspect = vw / vh;
14841:         let renderW = stageW;
14842:         let padX = 0.0;
14843: 
14844:         if (fit === 'contain') {
14845:             if (stageAspect > vidAspect) {
14846:                 renderW = stageH * vidAspect;
14847:                 padX = (stageW - renderW) * 0.5;
14848:             }
14849:         } else if (fit === 'cover') {
14850:             if (stageAspect < vidAspect) {
14851:                 renderW = stageH * vidAspect;
14852:                 padX = (stageW - renderW) * 0.5;
14853:             }
14854:         }
14855: 
14856:         const lineStageX = r * stageW;
14857:         const uvX = (lineStageX - padX) / Math.max(1.0, renderW);
14858:         return Math.max(0.001, Math.min(0.999, uvX));

14887:         const totalSteps = Math.max(2, Math.min(60, Math.round((expectedSpanMs / 1000.0) * effFps)));

16290:     function recordComparativeTickV210(glCtx, fromOffMode) {
16291:         var now = performance.now();
16292:         var dt = now - lastTickTime;
16293:         lastTickTime = now;
16294: 
16295:         var up = fromOffMode ? 0 : uploadedSinceLastDraw;
16296:         if (!fromOffMode) uploadedSinceLastDraw = 0;
16297: 
16298:         var vEl = document.getElementById('jennyVideoElV130') || document.querySelector('video');
16299:         var dec = (window._jv207Diag && window._jv207Diag.engineDecCount > 0 && !fromOffMode)
16300:             ? window._jv207Diag.engineDecCount
16301:             : -1;
16302:         if (dec < 0 && vEl && typeof vEl.getVideoPlaybackQuality === 'function') {
16303:             var q = vEl.getVideoPlaybackQuality();
16304:             if (q) dec = q.totalVideoFrames;
16305:         }
16306:         var vTime = vEl ? window.getEffectiveVideoCurrentTimeV210(vEl) : 0;
16307:         var spd = (vEl && vEl.playbackRate > 0.01) ? vEl.playbackRate : 1.0;
16308: 
16309:         var origChanged = false;
16310:         if (dec >= 0 && prevTrackDec >= 0) {
16311:             if (dec < prevTrackDec || (dec - prevTrackDec) > 300) {
16312:                 prevTrackDec = dec;
16313:                 prevTrackVTime = vTime;
16314:                 lastOrigChangeTs = now;
16315:                 origHoldTicks = 1;
16316:             } else if (dec > prevTrackDec) {
16317:                 origChanged = true;
16318:             }
16319:         } else if (Math.abs(vTime - prevTrackVTime) > 0.002) {
16320:             origChanged = true;
16321:         }
16322:         if (prevTrackDec < 0 && dec >= 0) {
16323:             prevTrackDec = dec;
16324:             prevTrackVTime = vTime;
16325:             lastOrigChangeTs = now;
16326:         }
16327: 
16328:         var origSpanMs = now - lastOrigChangeTs;
16329:         if (origChanged) {
16330:             prevTrackDec = dec;
16331:             prevTrackVTime = vTime;
16332:             lastOrigChangeTs = now;
16333:             origHoldTicks = 1;
16334:         } else {
16335:             origHoldTicks++;
16336:         }
16337: 
16338:         var diag = window._jv207Diag || { step: 1, totalSteps: 4, alpha: lastCapturedAlpha, expectedSpanMs: 33.33 };
16339:         var curAlpha = fromOffMode ? 0.0 : lastCapturedAlpha;
16340: 
16341:         historyDt[histIdx] = dt;
16342:         historyAlpha[histIdx] = curAlpha;
16343:         historyNewFrame[histIdx] = origChanged ? 1 : up;
16344:         histIdx = (histIdx + 1) % 120;
16345: 
16346:         if (!isLogging) return;
16347: 
16348:         var totSteps = diag.totalSteps || 4;
16349:         var stepNum = diag.step || Math.max(1, Math.round(curAlpha * totSteps));
16350:         var expMs = diag.expectedSpanMs || (33.33 / spd);
16351: 
16352:         if (up) lastGeneratorStallTicks = 0;
16353:         else if (curAlpha >= 0.995) lastGeneratorStallTicks++;
16354:         else lastGeneratorStallTicks = 0;
16355: 
16356:         var modeNow = (window._jv166Metrics && window._jv166Metrics.mode) || 'off';
16357:         var origCol = origChanged
16358:             ? ("dec:" + String(dec).padEnd(6, ' ') + " НОВЫЙ(" + origSpanMs.toFixed(1).padStart(5, ' ') + "ms)")
16359:             : ("dec:" + String(dec).padEnd(6, ' ') + " ждёт " + origSpanMs.toFixed(1).padStart(5, ' ') + "ms #" + String(origHoldTicks).padEnd(2, ' '));
16360:         var genCol = (modeNow === 'off' || fromOffMode)
16361:             ? "OFF (дефолтный плеер)"
16362:             : ((up ? "tex:1" : (origChanged ? "tex:DUP" : "tex:0")).padEnd(7, ' ') + " | " + String(stepNum).padStart(2, '0') + "/" + String(totSteps).padStart(2, '0') + " | a:" + curAlpha.toFixed(3));
16363:         var verdict = (origChanged && up) ? "📸 НОВЫЙ КАДР (ОРИГ -> ГЕН синхронно)" : ((curAlpha >= 0.995 && lastGeneratorStallTicks >= 2) ? "⚠️ Ожидание кадра декодера" : "🟢 ГЕН плавно двигает");
16364: 
16365:         logEntries.push({
16366:             idx: logEntries.length + 1,
16367:             dt: dt,
16368:             vTime: vTime,
16369:             origChanged: origChanged,
16370:             origSpanMs: origSpanMs,
16371:             texUp: up,
16372:             stalled: (lastGeneratorStallTicks >= 2) ? 1 : 0,
16373:             origCol: origCol,
16374:             genCol: genCol,
16375:             verdict: verdict
16376:         });
16377: 
16378:         var btn = document.getElementById('jennyLog120Btn');
16379:         if (btn && (logEntries.length % 120 === 1)) {
16380:             btn.textContent = '⏳ ' + (Math.floor(logEntries.length / 120) + 1) + '/3...';
16381:         }
16382: 
16383:         if (logEntries.length >= TOTAL_LOG_FRAMES) {
16384:             isLogging = false;
16385:             var lines = logEntries.map(function(e) {
16386:                 return String(e.idx).padStart(3, ' ') + " | " + e.dt.toFixed(2).padStart(6, ' ') + "ms | " + e.vTime.toFixed(4) + "s | " + e.origCol + " | " + e.genCol + " | " + e.verdict;
16387:             });
16388:             var out = "=== JENNY V210 СРАВНИТЕЛЬНЫЙ ЛОГ (360 ТИКОВ) ===\n" + getMediaPassport(vEl, glCtx) + lines.join("\n");
16389:             if (navigator.clipboard && navigator.clipboard.writeText) navigator.clipboard.writeText(out).catch(function(){});
